title.zh: 卷105之三 天象志一之三
title.raw: 卷105之三 天象志一之三 Volume 105c Treatise 1: Celestial Phenomena 3

sentences.zh: 三年三月，有星孛于奎，歷閣道，至紫微西蕃，入北斗魁，犯太陽守，循下台，轥南宮，履帝坐，遂由端門以出。

translations.literal: In the third year, third month, a broom star appeared at Kui, passed through the Celestial Passageway, reached the western portion of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, entered the head of the Northern Dipper, transgressed the Sun Guard, followed the Lower Terrace, trampled the Southern Palace, tread upon the Emperor's Seat, and finally exited through the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the third month, a comet appeared at Kui, crossed the Celestial Passageway, reached the western quarter of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, entered the head of the Northern Dipper, passed the Sun Guard star, traced the Lower Terrace, swept over the Southern Palace, crossed the Emperor's Seat, and finally departed through the Duan Gate.

sentences.zh: 奎是封豨，剝氣所由生也。

translations.literal: Kui is the enclosure of swine—the place where stripping qi is generated.
translations.idiomatic: Kui is the pen of swine, the constellation where the qi of decline and stripping takes form.

sentences.zh: 又殷徐州之次，桓玄國焉，劉裕興焉。

translations.literal: It also corresponds to the seat of Xu Province; there Huan Xuan established his state, and Liu Yu rose to power.
translations.idiomatic: It also marks the celestial seat of Xu Province—the region where Huan Xuan built his power and Liu Yu rose to prominence.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：君德之不建，人之無援，且有權其列蕃，盜其名器之守而荐食之者矣；

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: The ruler's virtue is not established, the people lack support, and there are those who will seize the ranked territories, steal the guardianship of titles and insignia, and feed upon them repeatedly;
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that the ruler's virtue had not been established, the people had no one to rely upon, and there were those who would seize the ranked domains, steal the guardianship of titles and insignia, and devour them one after another;

sentences.zh: 又將由其天步，席其帝庭，而出號施令焉。

translations.literal: Furthermore they will proceed by their heavenly steps, occupy the imperial court, and issue commands and proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: and who would then, by their own celestial course, take seat in the imperial court and issue commands and proclamations.

sentences.zh: 至四年二月甲寅，有大流星眾多西行，歷牛、虛、危，絕漢津，貫太微、紫微。

translations.literal: By the fourth year, second month, day jiayin, numerous large meteors moved westward, passing through Ox, Empty, and Rooftop, crossing the Celestial River ford, and piercing through the Supreme Palace Enclosure and Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: By the fourth year, in the second month, on the day jiayin, many large meteors streaked westward through Ox, Empty, and Rooftop, crossing the Celestial River ford and piercing the Supreme Palace Enclosure and the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 虛、危主靜人，牽牛主農政，皆負海之陽國也。

translations.literal: Empty and Rooftop govern the common people, the Oxherd governs agricultural administration—all are yang realms facing the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Empty and Rooftop govern the common people, the Oxherd governs agricultural affairs—all are southern realms facing the sea.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：黎元喪其所食，失其所係命，卒至流亡矣；

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: The common people have lost their sustenance, lost what their lives depend upon, and will ultimately be reduced to exile;
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to say that the common people would lose their livelihood, lose what their lives depended upon, and ultimately be driven into exile;

sentences.zh: 上不能恤，又將播遷以從之。

translations.literal: The ruler cannot provide relief and will likewise be forced to wander in displacement to follow them.
translations.idiomatic: the ruler would be unable to succor them and would himself be forced to wander in exile after them.

sentences.zh: 其後晉人有孫恩之難，而桓玄踵之，三吳連兵荐饑，西奔死亡者萬計，竟篡晉主而流之尋陽，既又劫之以奔江陵。

translations.literal: Afterwards among the Jin people there was the calamity of Sun En, and Huan Xuan followed in his wake; the Three Wu regions suffered continuous warfare and repeated famine; those who fled westward and died numbered in the tens of thousands; he ultimately usurped the Jin ruler and exiled him to Xunyang, then abducted him to flee to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Afterwards the Jin realm suffered Sun En's rebellion, which Huan Xuan followed; the Three Wu regions endured continuous warfare and repeated famine; tens of thousands died fleeing westward; Huan Xuan ultimately usurped the Jin throne, exiled the emperor to Xunyang, and then seized him and fled with him to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲三月甲子，月生齒。

translations.literal: 〈In the third month, day jiazi of that year, the moon grew serrated edges.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the third month of that year, on the day jiazi, the moon developed serrated edges.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有賊臣」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a treacherous minister."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be a treacherous minister."

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，月犯天關。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day dingmao, the moon transgressed the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day dingmao, the moon transgressed the Celestial Gate.

sentences.zh: 關，所以制畿封國也，月犯之，是為兵起于郊甸。

translations.literal: The Gate is what controls the capital and enfeoffed states; when the moon transgresses it, this signifies armies rising in the royal domain.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate governs the capital and the enfeoffed states; when the moon transgresses it, armies rise in the royal domain.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，月又犯東蕃上相。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day jiazi, the moon again transgressed the senior minister of the eastern enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day jiazi, the moon again transgressed the senior minister star of the eastern enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占同二年。

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as in the second year.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication is the same as in the second year.

sentences.zh: 既而桓玄戡金陵，殺司馬元顯、太傅道子。

translations.literal: Soon after, Huan Xuan conquered Jinling, killing Sima Yuanyao and the Grand Tutor Daozi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Huan Xuan seized Jinling and killed Sima Yuanyao and the Grand Tutor Daozi.

sentences.zh: 是歲秀容胡帥亦聚眾反，[3]伏誅。〉

translations.literal: In that year a Xiu Rong chieftain also gathered followers in rebellion, [3] and was executed.〉
translations.idiomatic: That same year a Xiu Rong chieftain also gathered followers in rebellion, [3] and was executed.〉

sentences.zh: 五年四月辛丑，月掩辰星，在東井。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, fourth month, day xinchou, the moon concealed Mercury in the Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the fourth month, on the day xinchou, the moon concealed Mercury in the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 月為陰國之兵，辰象戰鬬。

translations.literal: The moon represents the army of the yin realm, while Mercury signifies warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The moon represents the armies of the yin realm, and Mercury signifies battle.

sentences.zh: 占曰「所直野軍大起，戰不勝，亡地，家臣死」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The field army in the sector will greatly rise, battle will not be victorious, territory will be lost, and household retainers will die."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The field army in that sector will rise in force, battle will not be won, territory will be lost, and household retainers will die."

sentences.zh: 冬十月，帝伐秦師于蒙坑，大敗之，遂舉乾壁，關中大震。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, the Emperor attacked Qin forces at Mengkeng, crushing them; he then took Qianbi, and Guanzhong was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, the Emperor attacked Qin forces at Mengkeng and crushed them; he then captured Qianbi, and all of Guanzhong was shaken.

sentences.zh: 其上將姚平赴水死。

translations.literal: Their chief general Yao Ping threw himself into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: Their chief general Yao Ping threw himself into the water and drowned.

sentences.zh: 〈是月戊申，月暈左角。

translations.literal: 〈In that month, day wushen, a halo appeared on the moon's left horn.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In that month, on the day wushen, a halo appeared on the moon's left horn.

sentences.zh: 太史令晁崇奏：「角蟲將死。」

translations.literal: Grand Astrologer Chao Chong memorialized: "Horn creatures will die."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Astrologer Chao Chong memorialized: "Horn creatures will die."

sentences.zh: 上慮牛疫，乃命諸將併重焚車。

translations.literal: The Emperor, fearing bovine plague, ordered the generals jointly to burn their transport wagons heavily.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, fearing bovine plague, ordered the generals to burn their heavy transport wagons together.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕北引。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the imperial carriage departed northward.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, the imperial carriage set out northward.

sentences.zh: 牛大疫，死者十有八九，官車所御巨犗數百，同日斃於路側，首尾相屬，麋鹿亦多死者。〉

translations.literal: Bovine plague broke out; eight or nine out of ten died; several hundred great oxen used for the official carriages died on the same day beside the road, one after another in succession; many elk also died.〉
translations.idiomatic: Bovine plague broke out; eight or nine out of ten died; several hundred great oxen harnessed to the official carriages collapsed on the same day beside the road, one after another in a long line; many elk died as well.〉

sentences.zh: 五年三月戊子，太白犯五諸侯，晝見經天；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, third month, day wuzi, Venus transgressed the Five Feudal Lords and was visible crossing the meridian during daytime;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the third month, on the day wuzi, Venus transgressed the Five Feudal Lords and was visible crossing the sky at midday;

sentences.zh: 九月己未，又犯進賢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day jiwei, it again transgressed Promote Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiwei, it again transgressed Promote Worthies.

sentences.zh: [4]太白為強侯之誡，犯五諸侯，所以興霸形也。

translations.literal: [4] Venus is the warning against powerful lords; transgressing the Five Feudal Lords signifies the form of hegemonic ascendancy.
translations.idiomatic: [4] Venus is the warning against powerful feudatories; transgressing the Five Feudal Lords reveals the shape of hegemonic rise.

sentences.zh: 是時桓玄擅征伐之柄，專殺諸侯，以弱其本朝，卒以干君之明而代奪之。

translations.literal: At this time Huan Xuan monopolized the power of military campaigns, arbitrarily executing feudal lords to weaken his own court, and ultimately contended against the ruler's clarity to seize and replace him.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Huan Xuan monopolized the power of military campaigns, executing feudal lords at will to weaken his own court, and ultimately challenged the ruler's authority and usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 故皇天著誡焉，若曰：夫進賢興功，大司馬之官守也，而今自殘之，君於何有焉。

translations.literal: Therefore High Heaven displayed the warning, as if to say: Promoting worthies and establishing merit are the official duties of the Grand Marshal, yet now he destroys them himself—what does the ruler have left?
translations.idiomatic: Therefore High Heaven displayed this warning, as if to say: Promoting worthies and establishing merit are the official duties of the Grand Marshal, yet now he destroys them himself—what then remains for the ruler?

sentences.zh: 是冬十月，客星白若粉絮，出自南宮之西，十二月入太微，亂氣所由也。

translations.literal: That winter, tenth month, a guest star white as powdered cotton emerged from the west of the Southern Palace; in the twelfth month it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure—the source of rebellious qi.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, a guest star white as powdered cotton emerged from the west of the Southern Palace; in the twelfth month it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure—the source of rebellious qi.

sentences.zh: 以距乏之氣而乘粹陽之天庭，適足以驅除焉爾。

translations.literal: With the qi of exhaustion and scarcity it rose upon the pure yang heavenly court, sufficient only to drive out and expel.
translations.idiomatic: Rising with the qi of exhaustion and scarcity upon the pure yang heavenly court, it was sufficient only to drive out and expel.

sentences.zh: 明年，竟篡晉室，得諸侯而不終。

translations.literal: In the following year, he ultimately usurped the Jin throne, gained the feudal lords, yet did not last to the end.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he usurped the Jin throne, gained the feudal lords, yet did not endure to the end.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲五月丙申，月犯太微；

translations.literal: 〈In the fifth month, day bingshen of that year, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the fifth month of that year, on the day bingshen, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure;

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，又如之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day yimao, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day yimao, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 月者太陰，臣象，太微正陽之庭，不當橫行其中，是謂朝庭間隙，強臣不制，亦桓玄之誡也。

translations.literal: The moon is the Great Yin, the emblem of ministers; the Supreme Palace Enclosure is the court of proper yang—it ought not to be traversed sideways within it; this is called gaps in the court, uncontrolled powerful ministers—also a warning regarding Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: The moon is the Great Yin, the emblem of ministers; the Supreme Palace Enclosure is the court of proper yang—it ought not to be crossed sideways within it; this signifies gaps in the court and uncontrolled powerful ministers—a warning regarding Huan Xuan as well.

sentences.zh: 又占曰「貴人有坐之者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication also says: "Noble persons will suffer punishment."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication also reads: "Noble persons will be punished."

sentences.zh: 明年七月，鎮西大將軍、毗陵王順以罪還第，亦是也。〉

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the following year, Prince of Piling Shun, General Who Guards the West, was sent back to his residence on account of crime—this too applies.〉
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the following year, Prince Shun of Piling, General Who Guards the West, was sent back to his residence on account of crime—this too applies.〉

sentences.zh: 天賜二年四月己卯，月犯鎮星，在東壁；

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianci, fourth month, day jimao, the moon transgressed the Sentinel Star in Eastern Wall;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianci, in the fourth month, on the day jimao, the moon transgressed the Sentinel Star in Eastern Wall;

sentences.zh: 七月己未又如之；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day jiwei, it did so again;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day jiwei, it did so again;

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳又掩之，在室。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day dingsi, it again concealed it, in Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day dingsi, it again concealed it in Chamber.

sentences.zh: 夫室星，所以造宮廟而鎮司空也。

translations.literal: The Chamber star is what builds ancestral temples and stabilizes the Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The Chamber star governs the building of ancestral temples and stabilizes the Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 占曰「土功之事興」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Earthworks will be undertaken."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Earthworks will be undertaken."

sentences.zh: 明年六月，發八部人，自五百里內繕修都城，魏於是始有邑居之制度。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the following year, men from the Eight Departments within five hundred li were mobilized to repair the capital city; Wei thereby first established the institutions of settled urban dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the following year, men from the Eight Departments within five hundred li were mobilized to repair the capital; Wei thereby first established the institutions of urban settlement.

sentences.zh: 或曰，北宮後庭，人主所以庇衞其身也，鎮主后妃之位，存亡之基。

translations.literal: Some say: The rear court of the Northern Palace is where the ruler shelters himself; the Sentinel governs the position of empresses and consorts—the foundation of survival or extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Some say that the rear court of the Northern Palace is where the ruler shelters himself, and the Sentinel governs the position of empresses and consorts—the foundation of survival or extinction.

sentences.zh: 而是時堅冰之漸著矣，故犯又掩再三焉。

translations.literal: At this time the gradual advance of hard ice was already manifest; hence the transgressions and concealments occurred again and again.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the gradual advance of hard ice was already manifest; hence the transgressions and concealments occurred again and again.

sentences.zh: 占曰「臣賊君邦，大喪」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Ministers rebel against the ruler's state—great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Ministers rebel against the ruler's state—great mourning."

sentences.zh: 是歲三月丁酉，月犯心前星；

translations.literal: In the third year, third month, day dingyou, the moon transgressed the anterior star of Heart;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the third month, on the day dingyou, the moon transgressed the anterior star of Heart;

sentences.zh: 三年二月，月犯心後星；

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, the moon transgressed the posterior star of Heart;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the second month, the moon transgressed the posterior star of Heart;

sentences.zh: 四年二月，又如之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, second month, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the second month, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 心主嫡庶之禮。

translations.literal: Heart governs the rites between principal and secondary wives.
translations.idiomatic: Heart governs the rites between principal and secondary wives.

sentences.zh: 占曰「亂臣犯主，儲君失位，庶子惡之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Rebellious ministers violate the ruler, the heir loses position, and secondary sons are detested."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Rebellious ministers violate the ruler, the heir loses his position, and secondary sons are detested."

sentences.zh: 先是，天興六年冬十月至元年四月，月再掩軒轅。

translations.literal: Previously, from the tenth month of the sixth year of Tianxing through the fourth month of the first year, the moon twice concealed Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, from the tenth month of the sixth year of Tianxing through the fourth month of the first year of Tianci, the moon twice concealed Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有亂易政，后妃執其咎」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be disorder changing the government; empresses and consorts bear the blame."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be disorder changing the government; empresses and consorts bear the blame."

sentences.zh: 三年五月壬寅，熒惑犯氐。

translations.literal: In the third year, fifth month, day renyin, Mars transgressed Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the fifth month, on the day renyin, Mars transgressed Di.

sentences.zh: 氐，宿宮也。

translations.literal: Di is the palace lodgings.
translations.idiomatic: Di is the lodging palace.

sentences.zh: 天戒若曰：是時蠱惑人主而興內亂之萌矣，亦自我天視而修省焉。

translations.literal: Heaven's warning seemed to say: At this time sorcery will bewitch the ruler and the seeds of internal disorder will arise—also to be observed and corrected from Heaven's perspective.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's warning seemed to say that at this time sorcery would bewitch the ruler and the seeds of internal disorder would arise—also a summons to observe and correct from Heaven's perspective.

sentences.zh: 及六年七月，宣穆后以強死，太子微行人間，既而有清河、萬人之難。

translations.literal: By the sixth year, seventh month, Empress Dowager Xuande died a violent death; the Crown Prince went into hiding among the people; subsequently came the calamities of Qinghe and the Ten Thousand.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth year, in the seventh month, Empress Dowager Xuande died a violent death; the Crown Prince went into hiding among the people; subsequently came the calamities of Qinghe and the Ten Thousand.

sentences.zh: 〈二年八月，火犯斗；

translations.literal: 〈In the eighth month of the second year, fire transgressed Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the eighth month of the second year, Mars transgressed Dipper;

sentences.zh: 丁亥，又犯建。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, it again transgressed Establishment.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, it again transgressed Establishment.

sentences.zh: [5]為大人之事，建為經綸之始，此天所以建創業君。

translations.literal: [5] Dipper governs great affairs; Establishment marks the beginning of statecraft—this is how Heaven establishes a founding ruler.
translations.idiomatic: [5] Dipper governs great affairs; Establishment marks the beginning of statecraft—this is how Heaven establishes a founding ruler.

sentences.zh: 時劉裕且傾晉祚，而清河之釁方作矣，帝猶不悟。

translations.literal: At that time Liu Yu was about to overturn the Jin throne, while the Qinghe rebellion was just beginning; yet the Emperor still did not perceive it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liu Yu was about to overturn the Jin throne, while the Qinghe rebellion was just beginning; yet the Emperor still did not perceive it.

sentences.zh: 至是歲九月，火犯哭星。

translations.literal: By the ninth month of that year, fire transgressed the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: By the ninth month of that year, Mars transgressed the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 其象若曰：將以內亂，至于哭泣之事焉。

translations.literal: The sign seemed to say: Internal disorder will follow, reaching matters of lamentation and weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The sign seemed to say that internal disorder would follow, reaching matters of lamentation and weeping.

sentences.zh: 由是言之，皇天所以訓劫殺之主熟矣，而罕能敦復以自悟，悲夫！〉

translations.literal: From this it may be said: High Heaven's instruction to rulers beset by usurpation is already clear, yet few can earnestly return to righteousness and awaken themselves—alas!〉
translations.idiomatic: From this it may be said that High Heaven's instruction to rulers beset by usurpation is already clear, yet few can earnestly return to righteousness and awaken themselves—alas!〉

sentences.zh: 二年八月甲子，熒惑犯少微；

translations.literal: In the second year, eighth month, day jiazi, Mars transgressed Lesser Apex;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the eighth month, on the day jiazi, Mars transgressed Lesser Apex;

sentences.zh: 庚寅，犯右執法；

translations.literal: On day gengyin, it transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, it transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: 癸卯，犯左執法；

translations.literal: On day guimao, it transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, it transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: [6]十一月丙戌，太白掩釣鈐。

translations.literal: [6] In the eleventh month, day bingxu, Venus concealed the Hook and Seal.
translations.idiomatic: [6] In the eleventh month, on the day bingxu, Venus concealed the Hook and Seal.

sentences.zh: 皆南邦之謫也。

translations.literal: All are the relegation of the southern realm.
translations.idiomatic: All are the celestial markers of the southern realm.

sentences.zh: 火象方伯，金為強侯，少微以官賢材而輔南宮之化，執法者威令所由行也。

translations.literal: Fire represents the regional lord, metal the powerful feudatory; Lesser Apex is for recruiting worthy talent to assist in the Southern Palace's transformation; Enforcement Officers are where authority and command proceed from.
translations.idiomatic: Fire represents the regional lord, metal the powerful feudatory; Lesser Apex is for recruiting worthy talent to assist the Southern Palace's transformation; the Enforcement Officers are where authority and command proceed from.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：夫祿去公室，所由來漸矣，始則奮其賢材以為其本朝，終以干其鈐鎋而席其威令焉。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Emoluments departing from the ducal house have been coming gradually; at first they exert their worthy talents for their own court, and ultimately they will challenge their seals and seals of authority and occupy their commands.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to say that emoluments departing from the ducal house had been coming gradually; at first they exerted their worthy talents for their own court, and ultimately they would challenge the seals of authority and occupy their commands.

sentences.zh: 至三年十二月丙午，月掩太白于危。

translations.literal: By the twelfth month, day bingwu of the third year, the moon concealed Venus in Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: By the twelfth month of the third year, on the day bingwu, the moon concealed Venus in Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 危，齊分也。

translations.literal: Rooftop is the allotment of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Rooftop is the celestial allotment of Qi.

sentences.zh: 占曰「其國以戰亡」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "That state will perish through war."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "That state will perish through war."

sentences.zh: 丁未，金、火皆入羽林。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, both metal and fire entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, both Venus and Mars entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，太白晝見奎。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Venus was visible during daytime at Kui.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Venus was visible during daytime at Kui.

sentences.zh: 是謂或稱王師而干君明者。

translations.literal: This signifies one who claims to be the King's army yet contends against the ruler's clarity.
translations.idiomatic: This signifies one who claims to be the royal army yet contends against the ruler's authority.

sentences.zh: 占曰「天下兵起，魯邦受之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies rise throughout the realm; the Lu state receives it."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armies rise throughout the realm; the Lu state receives the blow."

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，金、火、土、水聚于奎、婁。

translations.literal: In the second month, day guihai, metal, fire, earth, and water gathered at Kui and Bond.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day guihai, Venus, Mars, Saturn, and Mercury gathered at Kui and Bond.

sentences.zh: 徐魯之分也。

translations.literal: This is the allotment of Xu and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: This is the celestial allotment of Xu and Lu.

sentences.zh: 四神聚謀，所以革衰替之政，定霸王之命。

translations.literal: The four spirits gathering in counsel is what reforms fading governance and fixes the mandate of hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: The four spirits gathering in counsel is what reforms fading governance and fixes the mandate of hegemony.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，金晝見于參。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day jichou, metal was visible during daytime in Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, Venus was visible during daytime in Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 天意若曰：是將自植攻伐，以震其主，而代奪之云爾。

translations.literal: Heaven's intent seemed to say: This one will plant aggression on his own account, to shock his ruler, and seize and replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's intent seemed to say that this one would plant aggression on his own account, shock his ruler, and seize and replace him.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，熒惑犯執法；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day xinchou, Mars transgressed the Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day xinchou, Mars transgressed the Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: 九月，遂犯進賢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, it then transgressed Promote Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, it then transgressed Promote Worthies.

sentences.zh: 與桓氏同占。

translations.literal: Same prognostication as the Huan clan.
translations.idiomatic: The same prognostication as for the Huan clan.

sentences.zh: 是時，南燕慕容氏兼有齊魯之墟，不務修德，而驟侵晉淮、泗。

translations.literal: At this time Murong of Southern Yan held the ruins of Qi and Lu, did not attend to cultivating virtue, but suddenly invaded Jin territory along the Huai and Si.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Murong of Southern Yan held the territories of Qi and Lu, did not attend to cultivating virtue, but suddenly invaded Jin territory along the Huai and Si.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，劉裕以晉師伐之，大敗燕師于臨朐，進克廣固，執慕容超以歸，戕諸建康。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, fourth month, Liu Yu with Jin forces attacked them, crushing the Yan army at Linqu, advancing to take Guanggu, capturing Murong Chao and bringing him back, executing him at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the fourth month, Liu Yu with Jin forces attacked them, crushing the Yan army at Linqu, advancing to capture Guanggu, seizing Murong Chao and bringing him back, and executing him at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 於是專其兵威，荐食藩輔，篡奪之形由此而著云。

translations.literal: Thereupon he monopolized military might, repeatedly devouring the frontier supports—the form of usurpation thereby became manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he monopolized military might, repeatedly devouring the frontier supports—the shape of usurpation thereby became manifest.

sentences.zh: 〈二年三月，月掩左執法；

translations.literal: 〈In the second year, third month, the moon concealed the Left Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the second year, in the third month, the moon concealed the Left Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: 三年四月，又犯西蕃上將；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, third month, it again transgressed the senior general of the western enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the fourth month, it again transgressed the senior general of the western enclosure;

sentences.zh: 己未，犯房次相；

translations.literal: On day jiwei, it transgressed the secondary minister of the Fang lodging;
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, it transgressed the secondary minister of the Fang lodging;

sentences.zh: 六月，火犯房次將。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, fire transgressed the secondary general of the Fang lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Mars transgressed the secondary general of the Fang lodging.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，太尉穆崇薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, Grand Commandant Mu Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, Grand Commandant Mu Chong died.

sentences.zh: 四年，誅定陵公和跋，殺司空庾岳。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Duke of Dingling He Ba was executed, and Minister of Works Yu Yue was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the Duke of Dingling He Ba was executed, and Minister of Works Yu Yue was killed.

sentences.zh: 又四年六月，火犯水左翼。

translations.literal: Again in the sixth month of the fourth year, fire transgressed the left wing of Water.
translations.idiomatic: Again in the sixth month of the fourth year, Mars transgressed the left wing of Water.

sentences.zh: 八月，金掩火，犯左執法。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, metal concealed fire and transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Venus concealed Mars and transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大兵在楚，執法當之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great armies are in Chu; the Enforcement Officer will be struck."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great armies are in Chu; the Enforcement Officer will be struck."

sentences.zh: 至五年，火犯天江。

translations.literal: By the fifth year, fire transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth year, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 占曰「水賊作亂」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Water bandits will rise in rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Water bandits will rise in rebellion."

sentences.zh: 六月，金犯上將，又犯左執法。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, metal transgressed the Senior General and again transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Venus transgressed the Senior General and again transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer.

sentences.zh: 其後廬循作亂於上流，晉將何無忌戰死，左僕射孟昶仰藥卒，劉裕自伐齊奔命，僅乃克之。〉

translations.literal: Afterwards Lu Xun rebelled in the upper reaches; the Jin general He Wuji died in battle, Left Deputy Director Meng Chang took poison and died, Liu Yu himself was campaigning against Qi and rushed to respond, barely subduing them.〉
translations.idiomatic: Afterwards Lu Xun rebelled in the upper reaches; the Jin general He Wuji died in battle, Left Deputy Director Meng Chang took poison and died, Liu Yu himself was campaigning against Qi and rushed to respond, barely subduing the rebellion.〉

sentences.zh: 六年六月，金、火再入太微，犯帝座，蓬、孛、客星及他不可勝紀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, sixth month, metal and fire again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and transgressed the Emperor's Seat; fuzzy stars, broom stars, guest stars, and others beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, Venus and Mars again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and transgressed the Emperor's Seat; fuzzy stars, broom stars, guest stars, and others too numerous to record.

sentences.zh: 太史上言，且有骨肉之禍，更政立君，語在帝紀。

translations.literal: The court astrologers reported that there would be kin calamity, a change of government, and the establishment of a new ruler—the account is in the Annals of Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: The court astrologers reported that there would be calamity among kin, a change of government, and the establishment of a new ruler—the account is in the Annals of Emperors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，太祖崩。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, Emperor Taizu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Emperor Taizu died.

sentences.zh: 夫前事之感大，即後事之災深，故帝之季年妖怪特甚。

translations.literal: Where the resonance of prior events is great, the calamity of subsequent events is deep; hence in the Emperor's final years portents were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Where the resonance of prior events is great, the calamity of subsequent events runs deep; hence in the Emperor's final years portents were especially severe.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲二月至九月，月三犯昴。

translations.literal: 〈In that year, from the second month to the ninth month, the moon thrice transgressed Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In that year, from the second month through the ninth month, the moon thrice transgressed Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 昴為白衣會，宮車晏駕之徵也。

translations.literal: Hairy Head is the white-robed assembly—the sign of the imperial carriage's delayed departure.
translations.idiomatic: Hairy Head is the white-robed assembly—the sign that the imperial carriage will delay its departure.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，金犯木於奎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day xinchou, metal transgressed wood at Kui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day xinchou, Venus transgressed Jupiter at Kui.

sentences.zh: 占曰「其君有兵死者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Their ruler will die by arms."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Their ruler will die by arms."

sentences.zh: 既而慕容超戮于晉。

translations.literal: Soon after, Murong Chao was executed by Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, Murong Chao was put to death by Jin.

sentences.zh: 是歲四月，火犯水于東井。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of that year, fire transgressed water at the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of that year, Mars transgressed Mercury at the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 其冬，赫連氏攻安定，秦主興自將救之，自是侵伐不息。

translations.literal: That winter, the Helian clan attacked Anding; the Qin ruler Yao Xing personally led forces to rescue it; from then on invasion and warfare did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, the Helian clan attacked Anding; the Qin ruler Yao Xing personally led forces to the rescue; from then on invasion and warfare did not cease.

sentences.zh: 或曰「水火之合，內亂之形也」。

translations.literal: Some say: "The conjunction of water and fire is the form of internal disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Some say: "The conjunction of water and fire is the shape of internal disorder."

sentences.zh: 時朱提王悅謀反，賜死。〉

translations.literal: At the time Prince Yue of Zhuti plotted rebellion and was ordered to die.〉
translations.idiomatic: At the time Prince Yue of Zhuti plotted rebellion and was ordered to take his own life.〉

sentences.zh: 太宗永興二年五月己亥，月掩昴。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxing under Emperor Taizong, fifth month, day jihai, the moon concealed Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxing under Emperor Taizong, in the fifth month, on the day jihai, the moon concealed Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 昴為髦頭之兵，虜君憂之。

translations.literal: Hairy Head is the helmet-headed armies; barbarian rulers worry over it.
translations.idiomatic: Hairy Head is the helmet-headed armies; barbarian rulers are troubled by it.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠕蠕社崘圍長孫嵩于牛川，上自將擊之，社崘遁走，道死。

translations.literal: That month, the Rouran She Lun besieged Chunyu Song at Niuchuan; the Emperor personally led forces to attack him; She Lun fled and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Rouran chieftain She Lun besieged Chunyu Song at Niuchuan; the Emperor personally led forces to attack him; She Lun fled and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 〈六月甲午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: 〈In the sixth month, day jiawu, Venus was visible during the day.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the sixth month, on the day jiawu, Venus was visible during the day.

sentences.zh: 占曰「為不臣」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "This signifies a disloyal subject."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This signifies a disloyal subject."

sentences.zh: 七月，月犯鬼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰「亂臣在內」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Rebellious ministers are within."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Rebellious ministers are within."

sentences.zh: 明年五月，昌黎王慕容伯兒謀反，誅之。〉

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year, Prince Murong Bo'er of Changli plotted rebellion and was executed.〉
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the following year, Prince Murong Bo'er of Changli plotted rebellion and was put to death.〉

sentences.zh: 是歲三月至秋八月，月三掩南斗第五星。

translations.literal: From the third month of that year to the eighth month of autumn, the moon thrice concealed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: From the third month of that year through the eighth month of autumn, the moon thrice concealed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 斗，吳分也。

translations.literal: The Dipper is Wu's territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is the territorial division of Wu.

sentences.zh: 且曰：強大之臣有干天祿者，大人憂之。

translations.literal: Moreover it says: When powerful ministers interfere with Heaven's emolument, great men worry over it.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover it says: When powerful ministers interfere with Heaven's emolument, great men are troubled by it.

sentences.zh: 是月乙未，太白犯少微，晝見；

translations.literal: In that month, day yiwei, Venus transgressed Lesser Micro and was visible during the day;
translations.idiomatic: In that month, on the day yiwei, Venus transgressed Lesser Micro and was visible during the day;

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，進犯左執法。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day jiayin, it advanced to transgress the Left Enforcement Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiayin, it advanced to transgress the Left Enforcement Officer.

sentences.zh: 占曰「且有杖其霸刑，以戮社稷之衞而專威令者，徵在南朔」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be one who wields hegemonic punishment, slays the guardians of the altars of state, and monopolizes awe and commands—the omen manifests in the south and north."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be one who wields hegemonic punishment, slays the guardians of the altars of state, and monopolizes awe and commands—the omen manifests in the south and north."

sentences.zh: 先是，三月丁卯，月掩房次將；

translations.literal: Previously, in the third month, day dingmao, the moon concealed the secondary general of the Fang lodging;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the third month, on the day dingmao, the moon concealed the secondary general of the Fang lodging;

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，又如之；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day jichou, it did so again;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day jichou, it did so again;

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，犯心前星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day jiashen, it transgressed the anterior star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jiashen, it transgressed the anterior star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 占曰「服軛者當之，君失馭，徵在豫州」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Those who wear the yoke will be struck; the ruler loses the reins; the omen manifests in Yuzhou."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Those who wear the yoke will be struck; the ruler loses the reins; the omen manifests in Yuzhou."

sentences.zh: 時劉裕謀弱晉室，四年九月，專殺僕射謝混，因襲荊州刺史劉毅于江陵，夷之。

translations.literal: At the time Liu Yu plotted to weaken the Jin house; in the fourth year, ninth month, he personally killed Director of the Secretariat Xie Hun, then attacked Jingzhou Inspector Liu Yi at Jiangling and exterminated him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Liu Yu plotted to weaken the Jin house; in the fourth year, in the ninth month, he personally killed Director of the Secretariat Xie Hun, then attacked Jingzhou Inspector Liu Yi at Jiangling and exterminated him.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，又誅晉豫州刺史諸葛長人，其君託食而已。

translations.literal: In the third month of the following year, he again executed Jin Yuzhou Inspector Zhuge Changren; their ruler existed only by relying on others for sustenance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the following year, he again executed Jin Yuzhou Inspector Zhuge Changren; their ruler existed only at others' pleasure.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲八月壬子，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: 〈In the eighth month of that year, day renzi, Venus transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the eighth month of that year, on the day renzi, Venus transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: [8]占曰「有亂易政，女君憂」。

translations.literal: [8] The prognostication says: "There will be disorder changing the government; the lady ruler grieves."
translations.idiomatic: [8] The prognostication reads: "There will be disorder changing the government; the lady ruler grieves."

sentences.zh: 三年十一月丙午，金犯哭星。

translations.literal: In the third year, eleventh month, day bingwu, metal transgressed the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the eleventh month, on the day bingwu, Venus transgressed the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 午，秦地。

translations.literal: Wu—Qin territory.
translations.idiomatic: Wu corresponds to Qin territory.

sentences.zh: 四年八月戊申，月犯哭星。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, eighth month, day wushen, the moon transgressed the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the eighth month, on the day wushen, the moon transgressed the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 申，晉地。

translations.literal: Shen—Jin territory.
translations.idiomatic: Shen corresponds to Jin territory.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉后王氏死；

translations.literal: In that month, the Jin empress Wang died;
translations.idiomatic: In that month, the Jin empress of the Wang clan died;

sentences.zh: 其後姚主薨。〉

translations.literal: Afterwards the Yao ruler died.〉
translations.idiomatic: Afterwards the Yao ruler died.〉

sentences.zh: 三年六月庚子，月犯歲星，在畢；

translations.literal: In the third year, sixth month, day gengzi, the moon transgressed Jupiter in Net;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the sixth month, on the day gengzi, the moon transgressed Jupiter in Net;

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，又犯之，在參；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day yiwei, it again transgressed it in Three Stars;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day yiwei, it again transgressed it in Three Stars;

sentences.zh: 四年正月又蝕，在畢。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year it again eclipsed it in Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year it again eclipsed it in Net.

sentences.zh: 直徼垣之陽，參在山河之右。

translations.literal: Directly south of the encircling wall; Three Stars lies to the right of the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Directly south of the encircling wall; Three Stars lies to the right of the mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 歲星所以阜農事安萬人也。

translations.literal: Jupiter is what enriches agricultural affairs and settles the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter is what enriches agricultural affairs and settles the myriad people.

sentences.zh: 占曰「月仍犯之，邊萌阻兵而荐饑」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The moon repeatedly transgressing it—frontier sprouts blocked by armies and repeated famine."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When the moon repeatedly transgresses it, frontier communities are blocked by armies and famine returns again and again."

sentences.zh: 是歲六月癸巳，金、木合于東井；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of that year, day guisi, metal and wood conjoined at the Eastern Well;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of that year, on the day guisi, Venus and Jupiter conjoined at the Eastern Well;

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，金犯土于井。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day jiashen, metal transgressed earth at the Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day jiashen, Venus transgressed Saturn at the Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰「其國內兵，有白衣之會」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armed conflict within the state; there will be a white-robed assembly."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armed conflict within the state; there will be a white-robed assembly."

sentences.zh: 十一月，土犯井；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, earth transgressed the Well;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Saturn transgressed the Well;

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，土犯鉞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day guimao, earth transgressed the Battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day guimao, Saturn transgressed the Battle-axe.

sentences.zh: 土主疆理之政，存亡之機也，是為土地分裂，有戮死之君，徵在秦邦。

translations.literal: Earth governs the administration of territorial boundaries—the hinge of survival and destruction; this signifies land divided, a ruler executed, the omen manifest in Qin territory.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn governs the administration of territorial boundaries—the hinge of survival and destruction; this signifies land divided, a ruler executed, the omen manifest in Qin territory.

sentences.zh: 至五年二月丙午，火、土皆犯井。

translations.literal: By the fifth year, second month, day bingwu, fire and earth both transgressed the Well.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth year, in the second month, on the day bingwu, Mars and Saturn both transgressed the Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰「國有兵喪之禍，主出走」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The state will suffer calamity of arms and mourning; the ruler will flee."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state will suffer calamity of arms and mourning; the ruler will flee."

sentences.zh: 是月壬辰，歲、鎮、熒惑、太白聚于井。

translations.literal: In that month, day renchen, Jupiter, Saturn, Mars, and Venus gathered at the Well.
translations.idiomatic: In that month, on the day renchen, Jupiter, Saturn, Mars, and Venus gathered at the Well.

sentences.zh: 將以建霸國之命也，其地君子憂，小人流。

translations.literal: This was about to establish the mandate of a hegemonic state; in that region gentlemen worried and common folk scattered.
translations.idiomatic: This was about to establish the mandate of a hegemonic state; in that region gentlemen worried and common folk scattered.

sentences.zh: 又自三年四月至五年三月，熒惑三干鬼。

translations.literal: Also from the fourth month of the third year to the third month of the fifth year, Mars thrice transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Also from the fourth month of the third year through the third month of the fifth year, Mars thrice transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 主命者將夭而國徙焉。

translations.literal: The bearer of the mandate would die young and the state would migrate.
translations.idiomatic: The bearer of the mandate would die young and the state would migrate.

sentences.zh: 是時雍州假王霸之號者六國，而赫連氏據朔方之地，尤為強暴，荐食關中，秦人奔命者殆路。

translations.literal: At this time in Yongzhou six states falsely assumed hegemon and king titles; the Helian clan held Shuofang, especially violent, repeatedly devouring Guanzhong; Qin people rushing to respond nearly filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: At this time in Yongzhou six states falsely assumed hegemon and king titles; the Helian clan held Shuofang and was especially violent, repeatedly devouring Guanzhong; Qin people rushing to respond nearly filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 間歲，姚興薨而難作于內。

translations.literal: Within a year Yao Xing died and turmoil arose within.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year Yao Xing died and turmoil arose within.

sentences.zh: 明年，劉裕以晉師伐之，秦師連戰敗績，執姚泓以歸，戕諸建康。

translations.literal: The following year Liu Yu with Jin forces attacked them; the Qin armies suffered repeated defeats; Yao Hong was captured and brought back and executed at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Liu Yu with Jin forces attacked them; the Qin armies suffered repeated defeats; Yao Hong was captured and brought back and executed at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 既而遺守內攜，長安淪覆焉。

translations.literal: Soon after the remaining garrison had internal discord, and Chang'an fell.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after the remaining garrison turned against itself, and Chang'an fell.

sentences.zh: 或曰：自上黨並河、山之北，皆鬼星、參、畢之郊也。

translations.literal: Some say: From Shangdang along the north of the river and mountains—all are the suburbs of Ghost, Three Stars, and Net.
translations.idiomatic: Some say: From Shangdang along the north of the river and mountains—all lie within the suburbs of Ghost, Three Stars, and Net.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，上黨羣盜外叛。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, fourth month, bandits of Shangdang rebelled outward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the fourth month, bandits of Shangdang rebelled outward.

sentences.zh: 六月，濩澤人劉逸自稱三巴王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Liu Yi of Huoze styled himself King of Sanba.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Liu Yi of Huoze styled himself King of Sanba.

sentences.zh: 七月，河西胡曹龍入蒲子，號大單于。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Hexi Hu Cao Long entered Puzi and titled himself Great Chanyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Hexi Hu chieftain Cao Long entered Puzi and titled himself Great Chanyu.

sentences.zh: 十月，將軍劉潔、魏勤擊吐京叛胡失利，勤力戰死，潔為所虜。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Generals Liu Jie and Wei Qin attacked the rebellious Hu of Tujing but failed; Qin fought to the death, and Jie was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Generals Liu Jie and Wei Qin attacked the rebellious Hu of Tujing but failed; Qin fought to the death, and Jie was captured.

sentences.zh: 明年，赫連屈孑寇蒲子、三城，諸將擊走之。

translations.literal: The following year Helian Qujie raided Puzi and Sancheng; the generals drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Helian Qujie raided Puzi and Sancheng; the generals drove them off.

sentences.zh: 其餘災波及晉、魏，仍其兵革之禍。

translations.literal: The remaining calamities spread to Jin and Wei, continuing the disaster of arms.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining calamities spread to Jin and Wei, continuing the disaster of arms.

sentences.zh: 〈二年九月，土犯畢，為疆埸之兵。

translations.literal: 〈In the second year, ninth month, earth transgressed Net—frontier border armies.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the second year, in the ninth month, Saturn transgressed Net—frontier border armies.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，木犯土于參。

translations.literal: In the third year, seventh month, wood transgressed earth at Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the seventh month, Jupiter transgressed Saturn at Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 占曰「戰敗，亡地，國君死」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Defeat in battle, lost territory, the state ruler dies."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Defeat in battle, lost territory, the state ruler dies."

sentences.zh: 四年十月，月掩天關。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, tenth month, the moon concealed the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the tenth month, the moon concealed the Celestial Gate.

sentences.zh: 其災同上。

translations.literal: The calamity was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The calamity was the same as above.

sentences.zh: 參，外主巴蜀。

translations.literal: Three Stars externally governs Ba and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Three Stars externally governs Ba and Shu.

sentences.zh: 其後晉師伐蜀，戮其主譙縱。

translations.literal: Afterwards Jin forces attacked Shu and executed its ruler Qiao Zong.
translations.idiomatic: Afterwards Jin forces attacked Shu and executed its ruler Qiao Zong.

sentences.zh: 先是，四年閏月，月犯熒惑，在昴；

translations.literal: Previously, in the intercalary month of the fourth year, the moon transgressed Mars in Hairy Head;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the intercalary month of the fourth year, the moon transgressed Mars in Hairy Head;

sentences.zh: 七月，又蝕之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, it again eclipsed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, it again eclipsed it.

sentences.zh: 五年，將軍奚斤討越勤，大破之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, General Xi Jin campaigned against Yue Qin and crushed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, General Xi Jin campaigned against Yue Qin and crushed them.

sentences.zh: 明年，禿髮氏降于西秦，其君傉檀戮死。〉

translations.literal: The following year the Tufa clan submitted to Western Qin; their ruler Rutan was executed.〉
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Tufa clan submitted to Western Qin; their ruler Rutan was put to death.〉

sentences.zh: 神瑞元年二月，填入東井，犯天尊，旱祥也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shenrui, second month, Saturn entered the Eastern Well and transgressed Celestial Esteem—an omen of drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shenrui, in the second month, Saturn entered the Eastern Well and transgressed Celestial Esteem—an omen of drought.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：土失其性，水源將壅焉；

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Earth loses its nature, and water sources will be blocked;
translations.idiomatic: The celestial signs seemed to say that earth loses its nature and water sources will be blocked;

sentences.zh: 施于天尊，所以福矜寡之萌也。

translations.literal: Applied to Celestial Esteem, this was to bless the orphaned and widowed sprouts.
translations.idiomatic: Applied to Celestial Esteem, this was to bless the orphaned and widowed sprouts.

sentences.zh: 先是，去年九月至于五月，歲再犯軒轅大星；

translations.literal: Previously, from the ninth month of the previous year until the fifth month, Jupiter twice transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, from the ninth month of the previous year until the fifth month, Jupiter twice transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅至二年三月，填再犯鬼積尸。

translations.literal: From the eighth month, day gengyin, to the third month of the second year, Saturn twice transgressed Ghost Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: From the eighth month, on the day gengyin, through the third month of the second year, Saturn twice transgressed Ghost Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 歲星主農事，軒轅主雪霜風雨之神，返覆由之，所以告黃祇也。

translations.literal: Jupiter governs agricultural affairs; Chariot Shaft governs the spirits of frost, snow, wind, and rain—going back and forth through it, thus informing the Yellow Earth deity.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter governs agricultural affairs; Chariot Shaft governs the spirits of frost, snow, wind, and rain—going back and forth through it, thus informing the Yellow Earth deity.

sentences.zh: 土爰稼穡，鬼為物之精氣，是謂稼穡潛耗，人將以饉而死焉。

translations.literal: Earth loves crops; Ghost is the refined qi of things—this means crops are secretly depleted and people will die of famine.
translations.idiomatic: Earth loves crops; Ghost is the refined qi of things—this means crops are secretly depleted and people will die of famine.

sentences.zh: 一曰大旱。

translations.literal: One interpretation: great drought.
translations.idiomatic: One interpretation: great drought.

sentences.zh: 是後，京師比歲霜旱，五穀不登，詔人就食山東，以粟帛賑乏，語在崔浩傳。

translations.literal: Afterwards the capital year after year suffered frost and drought; the five grains did not mature; an edict sent people to seek food east of the mountains, with grain and cloth to relieve the destitute—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Afterwards the capital year after year suffered frost and drought; the five grains did not mature; an edict sent people to seek food east of the mountains, with grain and cloth to relieve the destitute—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.

sentences.zh: 〈先是，月犯歲于畢。

translations.literal: 〈Previously, the moon transgressed Jupiter at Net.
translations.idiomatic: 〈Previously, the moon transgressed Jupiter at Net.

sentences.zh: 占曰「饑在晉代，亦其徵」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Famine in Jin and Dai—also its sign."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Famine in Jin and Dai—also its sign."

sentences.zh: 又鬼主秦，旱在秦邦。

translations.literal: Also Ghost governs Qin; drought is in Qin territory.
translations.idiomatic: Also Ghost governs Qin; drought is in Qin territory.

sentences.zh: 至二年，太史奏，熒惑在匏瓜中，一夜忽亡失之，後出東井，語在崔浩傳。

translations.literal: By the second year the court astrologers reported that Mars was in Gourd; in one night it suddenly vanished, later emerging from the Eastern Well—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.
translations.idiomatic: By the second year the court astrologers reported that Mars was in Gourd; in one night it suddenly vanished, later emerging from the Eastern Well—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.

sentences.zh: 既而關中大旱，昆明枯涸。〉

translations.literal: Soon after, Guanzhong suffered great drought, and Kunming dried up.〉
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, Guanzhong suffered a great drought, and Kunming Lake dried up.〉

sentences.zh: 是歲四月癸丑，流星晝見中天，西行。

translations.literal: That year, fourth month, day guichou, a meteor was seen at midday at the center of heaven, moving westward.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the fourth month, on the day guichou, a meteor was seen at midday at the zenith, moving westward.

sentences.zh: 占曰「營頭所首，野有覆軍，流血西行，謫在秦邦」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Where the army camp's head points, in the wild there will be armies overturned; blood flows moving westward; punishment falls upon the state of Qin."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Where the army camp's head points, armies will be overturned in the wild; blood will flow westward; heaven's punishment will fall upon the state of Qin."

sentences.zh: 而魏人覿之，亦王師之戒也。

translations.literal: Yet the people of Wei observed it—also a warning concerning the royal army.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the people of Wei observed it—also a warning concerning the royal army.

sentences.zh: 天若戒魏師曰：是擁眾而西，固欲干君之明而代奪之爾，姑息人以觀變，無庸禦焉。

translations.literal: Heaven seemed to warn the Wei army, saying: They gather multitudes and march west, truly intending to assault the ruler's clarity and seize the throne in his stead—indulge the people and wait to observe the change; there is no need to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven seemed to warn the Wei army, saying: They gather multitudes and march west, truly intending to assault the ruler's clarity and seize the throne in his stead—indulge the people and wait to observe the change; there is no need to resist.

sentences.zh: 先是五年三月，月犯太白于參；

translations.literal: Previously, in the third month of the fifth year, the moon transgressed Venus at Three Stars;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the third month of the fifth year, the moon transgressed Venus at Three Stars;

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，又犯之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day gengshen, it again transgressed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day gengshen, it again transgressed it.

sentences.zh: 參，魏分野。

translations.literal: Three Stars is Wei's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Three Stars is Wei's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 占曰「強侯作難，國戰不勝」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Powerful feudatories raise trouble; battle in the state will not succeed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Powerful feudatories raise trouble; battle in the state will not succeed."

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，月犯左角；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day jichou, the moon transgressed the Left Horn;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jichou, the moon transgressed the Left Horn;

sentences.zh: 是歲三月壬申，又蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third month of that year, day renshen, it again eclipsed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of that year, on the day renshen, it again eclipsed it.

sentences.zh: 是謂以剛晉之兵合戰而偏將戮，徵在兗州。

translations.literal: This means Jin's hard troops will join in battle and a lieutenant general will be executed—the sign is in Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: This means Jin's hard troops will join in battle and a lieutenant general will be executed—the sign appears in Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，太白入畢，月犯畢而再入之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Venus entered Net; the moon transgressed Net and entered it again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, Venus entered Net; the moon transgressed Net and entered it again.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大戰不勝，邊將憂，魏邦受之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great battle not won; frontier generals worry; Wei state receives it."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great battle will not be won; frontier generals will worry; the Wei state will receive the blow."

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，有星孛于昴南。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day jisi, a broom star appeared south of Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day jisi, a comet appeared south of Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：且有驅除之雄，勿用距之于朔方矣。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: There will be a hero of expulsion—do not use force to resist him at the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial signs seemed to say: There will be a hero of expulsion—do not use force to resist him on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 明年七月，劉裕以舟師泝河。

translations.literal: The following year, seventh month, Liu Yu led naval forces upstream along the river.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the seventh month, Liu Yu led naval forces upstream along the river.

sentences.zh: 九月，裕陷我滑臺，兗州刺史尉建以畏懦斬。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Yu captured our Huatai; Yanzhou Inspector Wei Jian was executed for cowardice and timidity.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Yu captured our Huatai; Yanzhou Inspector Wei Jian was executed for cowardice and timidity.

sentences.zh: 時崔浩欲勿戰，上難違眾議，詔司徒嵩率師迓之，及晉人戰于畔城，魏師敗績，語在崔浩傳。

translations.literal: At this time Cui Hao wished not to fight; the emperor found it difficult to defy the multitude's counsel and ordered Minister over the Masses Song to lead troops to meet them; they fought Jin forces at Pancheng and the Wei army suffered a great defeat—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Cui Hao wished not to fight; the emperor found it difficult to defy the multitude's counsel and ordered Minister over the Masses Song to lead troops to meet them; they fought Jin forces at Pancheng and the Wei army suffered a great defeat—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.

sentences.zh: 裕既定關中，遽歸受禪，既而赫連氏并之，遂竊尊號云。

translations.literal: Yu had just secured Guanzhong when he hastily returned to receive the abdication; soon after the Helian clan absorbed it and usurped an imperial title.
translations.idiomatic: Yu had just secured Guanzhong when he hastily returned to receive the abdication; soon after the Helian clan absorbed it and usurped an imperial title.

sentences.zh: 〈自元年正月至泰常元年十月，月三犯畢，再入之，再犯畢陽星。

translations.literal: 〈From the first month of the first year through the tenth month of the first year of Taichang, the moon thrice transgressed Net, twice entered it, and twice transgressed the yang star of Net.
translations.idiomatic: 〈From the first month of the first year through the tenth month of the first year of Taichang, the moon thrice transgressed Net, twice entered it, and twice transgressed the yang star of Net.

sentences.zh: 占曰「邊兵起，貴人有死者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Frontier armies rise; a noble person will die."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Frontier armies will rise; a noble person will die."

sentences.zh: 元年十二月，蠕蠕犯塞，上自將，大破之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year, the Rouran raided the border; the emperor led personally and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year, the Rouran raided the border; the emperor led personally and routed them.

sentences.zh: 二年，上黨胡反，詔五將討平之。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Hu of Shangdang rebelled; an edict sent five generals to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the Hu of Shangdang rebelled; an edict sent five generals to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 泰常元年，長樂、河間、南陽王皆薨。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taichang, the Princes of Changle, Hejian, and Nanyang all died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taichang, the Princes of Changle, Hejian, and Nanyang all died.

sentences.zh: 二年，豫章王又薨，常山霍季聚眾反，伏誅。〉

translations.literal: In the second year, the Prince of Yuzhang also died; Huo Ji of Changshan gathered a host and rebelled and was executed.〉
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the Prince of Yuzhang also died; Huo Ji of Changshan gathered a host and rebelled and was executed.〉

sentences.zh: 二年四月辛巳，有星孛于天市。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, day xinsi, a broom star appeared in the Heavenly Market.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, on the day xinsi, a comet appeared in the Heavenly Market.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，彗星出天市，掃帝座，在房心北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day jiashen, a comet emerged from the Heavenly Market, swept the Emperor's Seat, north of Heart and Heart's Companion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jiashen, a comet emerged from the Heavenly Market, swept the Emperor's Seat, north of Heart and Heart's Companion.

sentences.zh: 市所以建國均人心，宋分也。

translations.literal: The Market is where a state is established and hearts are balanced—it is Song's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: The Market is where a state is established and hearts are balanced—it is Song's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 國且殊號，人將更主，其革而為宋乎？

translations.literal: The state will soon change its title; the people will have a new master—is it to be transformed into Song?
translations.idiomatic: The state will soon change its title; the people will have a new master—is it to be transformed into Song?

sentences.zh: 先是，往歲七月，月犯鈎鈐；

translations.literal: Previously, in the seventh month of the year before, the moon transgressed the Hook and Seal;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the seventh month of the year before, the moon transgressed the Hook and Seal;

sentences.zh: 十一月，月食房上相；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the moon eclipsed the prime minister star of the Fang lodging;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the moon eclipsed the prime minister star of the Fang lodging;

sentences.zh: 至元年二月，又如之。

translations.literal: By the second month of the first year, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: By the second month of the first year, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：尚尸鈐鍵之位，君憑而尊之者，又將及矣。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Still holding the position of the hook-and-lock, the one whom the ruler relies upon and honors—will soon attain it.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial signs seemed to say: Still holding the position of the hook-and-lock, the one whom the ruler relies upon and honors will soon attain it.

sentences.zh: 是歲八月，金、木合于翼。

translations.literal: That year, eighth month, metal and wood conjoined at Wings.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the eighth month, Venus and Jupiter conjoined at Wings.

sentences.zh: 占曰「且有內兵，楚邦受之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be internal armies; the state of Chu receives it."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be internal armies; the state of Chu will receive the blow."

sentences.zh: 至泰常二年正月，晉荊州刺史司馬休之、雍州刺史魯宗之為劉裕所襲，皆出奔走。

translations.literal: By the first month of the second year of Taichang, Jin's Inspector of Jingzhou Sima Xiuzhi and Inspector of Yongzhou Lu Zongzhi were attacked by Liu Yu; both fled outward.
translations.idiomatic: By the first month of the second year of Taichang, Jin's Inspector of Jingzhou Sima Xiuzhi and Inspector of Yongzhou Lu Zongzhi were attacked by Liu Yu; both fled into exile.

sentences.zh: [9]是歲十月，鎮星守太微，七十餘日。

translations.literal: [9] That year, tenth month, Saturn stationed at the Supreme Palace Enclosure for more than seventy days.
translations.idiomatic: [9] That year, in the tenth month, Saturn stationed at the Supreme Palace Enclosure for more than seventy days.

sentences.zh: 占曰「易代立王」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Dynasty changes; a king is established."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The dynasty changes; a king is established."

sentences.zh: 其三年三月癸丑，太白犯五諸侯，如桓氏之占。

translations.literal: In the third year, third month, day guichou, Venus transgressed the Five Feudal Lords—as in the prognostication regarding the Huan clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the third month, on the day guichou, Venus transgressed the Five Feudal Lords—as in the prognostication regarding the Huan clan.

sentences.zh: 七月，有流星孛于少微，以入太微。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, a meteor-broom star appeared at Lesser Apex and entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a meteor-broom star appeared at Lesser Apex and entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 自劉氏之霸，三變少微以加南宮矣。

translations.literal: Since the Liu clan's hegemony, three times Lesser Apex has changed to reach the Southern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Liu clan's hegemony, three times Lesser Apex has shifted to reach the Southern Palace.

sentences.zh: 始以方伯專之，中則霸形干之，又今孛政除之。

translations.literal: At first regional lords monopolized it; midway hegemonic form assaulted it; now again the broom star's governance removes it.
translations.idiomatic: At first regional lords monopolized it; midway hegemonic form assaulted it; now again the broom star's governance removes it.

sentences.zh: 馴而三積，堅冰至焉。

translations.literal: Tamed yet thrice accumulating—hard ice arrives.
translations.idiomatic: Step by step, three accumulations—and solid ice forms.

sentences.zh: 是月，辰星見東方，在翼，甚明大。

translations.literal: That month, Mercury appeared in the east at Wings, very bright and large.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Mercury appeared in the east at Wings, very bright and large.

sentences.zh: 翼，楚邦也，是為冢臣干明，賊人其昌。

translations.literal: Wings is the state of Chu—this means a minister holding the tomb assaults the brightness; the villain's people will flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Wings is the state of Chu—this means a powerful minister assaults the ruler's light; the villain's faction will flourish.

sentences.zh: 〈先是，五年十一月壬子，辰星出而明盛非常。

translations.literal: 〈Previously, in the eleventh month of the fifth year, day renzi, Mercury emerged and was extraordinarily bright.
translations.idiomatic: 〈Previously, in the eleventh month of the fifth year, on the day renzi, Mercury emerged and was extraordinarily bright.

sentences.zh: 至泰常二年十二月庚戌，辰星過時而見，光色明盛。

translations.literal: By the twelfth month of the second year of Taichang, day gengxu, Mercury appeared out of season; its light and color were bright and splendid.
translations.idiomatic: By the twelfth month of the second year of Taichang, on the day gengxu, Mercury appeared out of season; its light and color were bright and splendid.

sentences.zh: 是為強臣有不還令者。

translations.literal: This means a powerful minister has one who does not return his orders.
translations.idiomatic: This means a powerful minister has a subordinate who does not return his orders.

sentences.zh: 至是又如之，亦三至焉。

translations.literal: By this time it was again like this—also three times in all.
translations.idiomatic: By this time it was again like this—also three times in all.

sentences.zh: 或曰辰星以負北海，亦魏將大興之兆。〉

translations.literal: Some say Mercury bearing upon the Northern Sea is also a sign that Wei will greatly rise.〉
translations.idiomatic: Some say Mercury bearing upon the Northern Sea is also a sign that Wei will greatly rise.〉

sentences.zh: 九月，長彗星孛于北斗，轢紫微，辛酉，入南宮，凡八十餘日。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, a long comet broom star appeared at the Northern Dipper, trampled the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; on day xinyou it entered the Southern Palace—for more than eighty days in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, a long comet appeared at the Northern Dipper, trampled the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; on the day xinyou it entered the Southern Palace—for more than eighty days in all.

sentences.zh: 十二月，彗星出自天津，入太微，逕北斗，干紫宮，犯天棓，八十餘日，及天漢乃滅，語在崔浩傳。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, a comet emerged from the Celestial Ford, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, passed directly through the Northern Dipper, assaulted the Purple Palace, transgressed the Celestial Club—for more than eighty days until reaching the Celestial River it vanished—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, a comet emerged from the Celestial Ford, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, passed directly through the Northern Dipper, assaulted the Purple Palace, transgressed the Celestial Club—for more than eighty days until reaching the Celestial River it vanished—the account is in the Biography of Cui Hao.

sentences.zh: 是歲，晉安帝殂，後年而宋篡之。

translations.literal: That year, Emperor An of Jin died; two years later Song usurped the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Emperor An of Jin died; two years later Song usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 夫晉室雖微，泰始之遺俗也，蓋皇天有以原始篤終，以哀王道之淪喪，故猶著二微之戒焉。

translations.literal: Though the house of Jin was weak, it was still the legacy of Taishi—surely High Heaven had cause to return to the origin and see it through to the end, lamenting the fall of the royal way, and so still displayed the warnings of the two Lesser Apexes.
translations.idiomatic: Though the house of Jin was weak, it was still the legacy of Taishi—surely High Heaven had cause to return to the origin and see it through to the end, lamenting the fall of the royal way, and so still displayed the warnings of the two Lesser Apexes.

sentences.zh: 〈神瑞二年四月，木入南宮，加右執法；

translations.literal: 〈In the fourth month of the second year of Shenrui, wood entered the Southern Palace, adjoining the Right Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the fourth month of the second year of Shenrui, Jupiter entered the Southern Palace, adjoining the Right Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: 五月，火又如之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, fire did likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Mars did likewise.

sentences.zh: 八月，金入自掖門，掩左執法；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, metal entered from the Rear Gate and concealed the Left Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Venus entered from the Rear Gate and concealed the Left Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: 泰常元年六月，又由掖門入太微。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Taichang, it again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure by the Rear Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Taichang, it again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure by the Rear Gate.

sentences.zh: 五月，火犯執法。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, fire transgressed the Enforcement Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Mars transgressed the Enforcement Officer.

sentences.zh: 是冬，土守天尊而月掩之。

translations.literal: That winter, earth stationed at Celestial Esteem and the moon concealed it.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Saturn stationed at Celestial Esteem and the moon concealed it.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，土又入太微，犯執法，因留二百餘日。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, earth again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, transgressed the Enforcement Officer, and remained for more than two hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year, Saturn again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, transgressed the Enforcement Officer, and remained for more than two hundred days.

sentences.zh: 九月，金又犯右執法。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, metal again transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Venus again transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer.

sentences.zh: 十月，火犯上將，因留左掖門內二十日，乃逆行；

translations.literal: In the tenth month, fire transgressed the Senior General, remaining within the Left Rear Gate for twenty days, then moving retrograde;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Mars transgressed the Senior General, remaining within the Left Rear Gate for twenty days, then moving retrograde;

sentences.zh: 四年三月，出西蕃，又還入之，繞填星成句己；

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, it exited the western enclosure, then returned and entered again, circling Saturn to form a hook-and-loop;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year, it exited the western enclosure, then returned and entered again, circling Saturn to form a hook-and-loop;

sentences.zh: 四月丙午，行端門出。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, day bingwu, it passed out through the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day bingwu, it passed out through the Duan Gate.

sentences.zh: [10]皆晉氏之謫也。

translations.literal: [10] All were punishments upon the house of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: [10] All were heaven's punishments upon the house of Jin.

sentences.zh: 自晉滅之後，太微有變多應魏國也。〉

translations.literal: After Jin's extinction, changes in the Supreme Palace Enclosure mostly corresponded to the state of Wei.〉
translations.idiomatic: After Jin's extinction, changes in the Supreme Palace Enclosure mostly corresponded to the state of Wei.〉

sentences.zh: 泰常三年十月辛巳，有大流星出昴，歷天津，乃分為三，須臾有聲。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Taichang, day xinsi, a great meteor emerged from Hairy Head, passed through the Celestial Ford, then split into three; in a moment there was a sound.
