translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of Taichang, on the day xinsi, a great meteor emerged from Hairy Head, passed through the Celestial Ford, then split into three; in a moment there was a sound.

sentences.zh: 占曰「車騎滿野，非喪即會」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Chariots and horsemen fill the wild—if not mourning, then assembly."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Chariots and horsemen fill the wild—if not mourning, then assembly."

sentences.zh: 明年四月，帝有事于東廟，蕃服之君以其職來祭者，蓋數百國也。

translations.literal: The following year, fourth month, the emperor performed rites at the Eastern Temple; lords of tribute states came to offer sacrifice according to their offices—perhaps several hundred states.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the fourth month, the emperor performed rites at the Eastern Temple; lords of tribute states came to offer sacrifice according to their offices—perhaps several hundred states.

sentences.zh: 是歲正月己酉，月犯軒轅；

translations.literal: That year, first month, day jiyou, the moon transgressed Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the first month, on the day jiyou, the moon transgressed Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 四月壬申，又犯填星，在張；

translations.literal: In the fourth month, day renshen, it again transgressed Saturn, at Spread;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day renshen, it again transgressed Saturn at Spread;

sentences.zh: 四年五月，辰星又犯軒轅。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Mercury again transgressed Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Mercury again transgressed Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 占曰「國有喪，女君受之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The state has mourning; the lady sovereign receives it."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state has mourning; the lady sovereign receives it."

sentences.zh: 明年五月，貴人姚氏薨，是為昭哀皇后。

translations.literal: The following year, fifth month, the honored consort Lady Yao died—she was Empress Zhao'ai.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the fifth month, the honored consort Lady Yao died—she was Empress Zhao'ai.

sentences.zh: 六月，貴嬪杜氏薨，是為密后。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the honored concubine Lady Du died—she was Empress Mi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the honored concubine Lady Du died—she was Empress Mi.

sentences.zh: 〈先是，二年九月，火犯軒轅；

translations.literal: 〈Previously, in the ninth month of the second year, Mars transgressed Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: 〈Previously, in the ninth month of the second year, Mars transgressed Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 三年八月，金又犯之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, Venus again transgressed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year, Venus again transgressed it.

sentences.zh: 占同也。〉

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same.〉
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication is the same.〉

sentences.zh: 五年十一月乙卯，熒惑犯填星，在角。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year, day yimao, Mars transgressed Saturn at Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year, on the day yimao, Mars transgressed Saturn at Horn.

sentences.zh: 角，外朝也，土為紀綱，火主內亂，會于天門，王綱將紊焉。

translations.literal: Horn is the outer court; earth is the cords and net of rule; fire governs internal disorder—meeting at the Celestial Gate, the king's net will be tangled.
translations.idiomatic: Horn is the outer court; Saturn is the cords and net of rule; Mars governs internal disorder—meeting at the Celestial Gate, the king's net will be tangled.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有死君逐主，后妃憂之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a dead ruler and a driven-out sovereign; the empress and consorts worry over it."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be a dead ruler and a driven-out sovereign; the empress and consorts will worry over it."

sentences.zh: 十二月，月蝕熒惑，在亢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the moon eclipsed Mars in Neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the moon eclipsed Mars in Neck.

sentences.zh: 亢，內庭也。

translations.literal: Neck is the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: Neck is the inner court.

sentences.zh: 占曰「君薨而亂作于內，貴臣以兵死」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The ruler dies and disorder arises within; a noble minister dies by arms."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The ruler dies and disorder arises within; a noble minister dies by arms."

sentences.zh: 是月，客星見于翼。

translations.literal: That month, a guest star appeared at Wings.
translations.idiomatic: That month, a guest star appeared at Wings.

sentences.zh: 翼，楚邦也。

translations.literal: Wings is the state of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Wings is the state of Chu.

sentences.zh: 占曰「國更服，邊有急，將軍或謀反者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The state changes its garment; the border has urgency; a general may plot rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state changes its garment; the border has urgency; a general may plot rebellion."

sentences.zh: 六年二月，月食南斗杓星。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, the moon eclipsed the ladle star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year, the moon eclipsed the ladle star of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 十月乙酉，金、土鬬于亢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day yiyou, metal and earth battled at Neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day yiyou, Venus and Saturn battled at Neck.

sentences.zh: 占曰「內兵且喪，更立王公」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Internal armies and mourning; a new prince or duke is installed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Internal armies and mourning; a new prince or duke is installed."

sentences.zh: 又兗州，陳、鄭之墟也，有攻城野戰之象焉。

translations.literal: Also Yan Province is the ruins of Chen and Zheng—there are signs of storming cities and fighting in the wild.
translations.idiomatic: Also Yan Province is the ruins of Chen and Zheng—there are signs of storming cities and fighting in the wild.

sentences.zh: 至七年正月，犯南斗；

translations.literal: By the first month of the seventh year, it transgressed the Southern Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: By the first month of the seventh year, it transgressed the Southern Dipper;

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，又犯之。

translations.literal: In the third month, day renxu, it again transgressed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day renxu, it again transgressed it.

sentences.zh: 斗為人君受命，又吳分。

translations.literal: The Dipper is where the human ruler receives the mandate; also Wu's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is where the human ruler receives the mandate; also Wu's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 是歲五月，宋武殂。

translations.literal: That year, fifth month, Emperor Wu of Song died.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the fifth month, Emperor Wu of Song died.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，魏師侵宋北鄙。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, Wei forces invaded Song's northern marches.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, Wei forces invaded Song's northern marches.

sentences.zh: 十一月，攻滑臺，克之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, they attacked Huatai and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, they attacked Huatai and captured it.

sentences.zh: 明年，拔虎牢，陷金墉，屠許昌，遂啟河南之地。

translations.literal: The following year, they took Hulao, captured Jinyong, sacked Xuchang, and then opened the lands south of the River.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, they took Hulao, captured Jinyong, sacked Xuchang, and then opened the lands south of the River.

sentences.zh: 八年，宋太后蕭氏死，既大臣專權，遷殺其主，卒皆伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Empress Dowager Xiao of Song died; thereafter ministers monopolized power, successively killed their ruler, and in the end all were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Empress Dowager Xiao of Song died; thereafter ministers seized power, deposed and killed their ruler one after another, and in the end all were executed.

sentences.zh: 〈自五年八月至七年十二月，熒惑一守軒轅，再犯進賢，再犯房星，月一犯軒轅及房。

translations.literal: 〈From the eighth month of the fifth year through the twelfth month of the seventh year, Mars once stationed at Chariot Shaft, twice transgressed Advancement of the Worthy, twice transgressed the Chamber star; the moon once transgressed Chariot Shaft and Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: 〈From the eighth month of the fifth year through the twelfth month of the seventh year, Mars stationed once at Chariot Shaft, transgressed Advancement of the Worthy twice, and transgressed the Chamber star twice; the moon transgressed Chariot Shaft and Chamber once.

sentences.zh: 皆女君大臣之戒。

translations.literal: All were warnings regarding the lady sovereign and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: All were heavenly warnings concerning the empress dowager and powerful ministers.

sentences.zh: 是時陽平、河南王，太尉穆觀相次薨，而宋氏廷臣乘釁以侮其主，竟以誅死云。

translations.literal: At this time the Prince of Yangping and Prince of Henan, and Grand Commander Mu Guan, died in succession; Song court ministers seized the opportunity to insult their ruler, and in the end were all put to death.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Prince of Yangping, the Prince of Henan, and Grand Commander Mu Guan died in succession, while Song court ministers seized the opportunity to humiliate their sovereign—and in the end were all executed.

sentences.zh: 或曰火犯土、亢為饑疾。

translations.literal: Some say fire transgressing earth and Neck portends famine and pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Some hold that Mars transgressing Saturn and Neck portends famine and pestilence.

sentences.zh: 時官軍陷武牢，會軍大疫，死者十二三。

translations.literal: At that time government forces captured Wulao; an army-wide pestilence struck, and one or two out of ten died.
translations.idiomatic: At that time government forces took Wulao, but a great pestilence swept the army, killing perhaps one or two soldiers in ten.

sentences.zh: 是冬，詔稟饑人。〉

translations.literal: That winter, an edict ordered grain distributed to the starving.〉
translations.idiomatic: That winter, an edict ordered grain distributed to the famine-stricken.〉

sentences.zh: 六年六月壬午，有大流星出紫宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, sixth month, day renwu, a large meteor emerged from the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the day renwu, a large meteor emerged from the Purple Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰「上且行幸，若有大君之使」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The ruler will soon tour on campaign, as if a great lord's emissary."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will soon set out on tour, as though a great lord's mission were at hand."

sentences.zh: 明年，駕幸橋山，祠黃帝，東過幽州，命使者觀省風俗。

translations.literal: The following year, the imperial carriage visited Qiaoshan, offered sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor, passed east through You Province, and ordered envoys to observe and inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, the emperor visited Qiaoshan, offered sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor, traveled east through You Province, and dispatched envoys to observe local customs.

sentences.zh: 十月，上南征。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the emperor marched south on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the emperor launched a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 八年春，步自鄴宮，遂絕靈昌，至東郡，觀兵成臯，反自河內，登太行山，幸高都，飲至晉陽焉。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year, he walked from the palace at Ye, crossed Lingchang, reached Dong Commandery, reviewed troops at Chenggao, returned via Henei, climbed the Taihang Mountains, visited Gaodu, and held a victory banquet at Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year, he walked from the palace at Ye, crossed Lingchang, reached Dong Commandery, reviewed troops at Chenggao, returned by way of Henei, climbed the Taihang Mountains, visited Gaodu, and held a victory banquet at Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 七年二月辛巳，有星孛于虛、危，向河津。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, day xinsi, a broom star appeared at Empty and Rooftop, heading toward the River ford.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year, on the day xinsi, a comet appeared at Empty and Rooftop, heading toward the River ford.

sentences.zh: 占曰「玄枵所以飾喪紀也，宗廟並起，司人疑更謀，有易政之象」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Dark Emblem is what adorns mourning rites; ancestral temples rise together; the Minister of Works suspects renewed plotting; there is a sign of changing the government."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Dark Emblem adorns the rites of mourning; ancestral temples rise together; the Minister of Works suspects new intrigue; there are signs of a change in government."

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，彗星出室，掃北斗，及于□門。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day jiayin, a comet emerged from Room, swept the Northern Dipper, and reached □ Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day jiayin, a comet emerged from Room, swept over the Northern Dipper, and reached □ Gate.

sentences.zh: 占曰「內宮幾室，主命將，易塞垣，有土功之事，其地又齊、衞也」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The inner palace nearly touches Room; it commands appointing generals, changing border walls, earthworks—and the territory is also Qi and Wei."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The inner palace nearly reaches Room; it governs the appointment of generals, changes to border walls, and earthworks—and the territory affected is Qi and Wei as well."

sentences.zh: 八年正月，彗星出奎南長三丈，東南掃河。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, a comet emerged south of Kui three zhang in length, sweeping southeast toward the River.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, a comet emerged south of Kui three zhang long, sweeping southeast across the River.

sentences.zh: 奎為荐食之兵，徐方之地。

translations.literal: Kui is repeatedly devouring armies; the land of Xu region.
translations.idiomatic: Kui is the seat of repeatedly devouring armies and the land of Xu.

sentences.zh: 占曰「西北之兵伐之，君絕嗣，天下饑」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies from the northwest attack it; the ruler loses his heir; the realm suffers famine."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Northwestern armies will attack; the ruler will lose his heir; famine will spread across the realm."

sentences.zh: 七年十二月，帝命壽光侯叔孫建徇定齊地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, the emperor ordered Marquis Shouguang Shusun Jian to pacify and settle Qi territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, the emperor ordered Marquis Shouguang Shusun Jian to pacify and settle Qi territory.

sentences.zh: 八年春，築長城，距五原二千餘里，置守卒，以備蠕蠕。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year, they built the Long Wall more than two thousand li from Wuyuan, stationed border guards to guard against the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year, they built the Long Wall more than two thousand li from Wuyuan and stationed border guards against the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，大饑。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, famine struck hard.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，上崩于西宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day jisi, the emperor died at the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day jisi, the emperor died in the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 明年，宋廢其主。

translations.literal: The following year, Song deposed their ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Song deposed their ruler.

sentences.zh: 由是南邦日蹙，齊衞之地盡為兵衝。

translations.literal: Thereupon the southern realm daily shrank; Qi and Wei lands all became battlegrounds.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the southern realm shrank day by day, and the lands of Qi and Wei became nothing but battlegrounds.

sentences.zh: 及世祖即政，遂荒淮沂以負東海云。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took power, he then extended the frontier along the Huai and Yi rivers to reach the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to power, he pushed the frontier from the Huai and Yi rivers all the way to the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 〈八年二月丙寅，火守斗，亦南邦之謫也。

translations.literal: 〈In the second month of the eighth year, day bingyin, fire stationed at the Dipper—also punishment upon the southern realm.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the second month of the eighth year, on the day bingyin, Mars stationed at the Dipper—also heaven's punishment upon the southern realm.

sentences.zh: 十一月，彗星孛于土司空。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, a comet broom star appeared at Earth Master of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, a comet appeared at Earth Master of Works.

sentences.zh: 司空主疆理邦域，且曰有土功哭泣事。

translations.literal: The Minister of Works governs demarcating state territory; moreover it signifies earthworks and weeping affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Works governs the demarcation of state territory; it also signifies earthworks and mourning.

sentences.zh: 後年，赫連屈孑薨，太武征之，取新秦之地，由是征伐四克，提封萬里云。〉

translations.literal: In the year after next, Helian Qufen died; Emperor Taiwu marched against him, took the lands of New Qin; thereafter campaigns succeeded on all four sides, and territorial bounds extended ten thousand li.〉
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, Helian Qufen died; Emperor Taiwu marched against him and seized the lands of New Qin; thereafter his campaigns succeeded on every front, and his territorial bounds extended ten thousand li.〉

sentences.zh: 二年五月，太白晝見經天。

translations.literal: In the second year, fifth month, Venus was visible during the day crossing the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the fifth month, Venus was visible during the day crossing the sky.

sentences.zh: 占曰「時謂亂紀，革人更王」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The times are called disordering the era; the people are changed and the king is replaced."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The times are called an age of disorder; the people are overturned and the ruler is replaced."

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，火入羽林，守六十餘日。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day jichou, fire entered the Feathered Forest and stationed for more than sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day jichou, Mars entered the Feathered Forest and remained for more than sixty days.

sentences.zh: 占曰「禁兵大起，且有反臣之戒」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Forbidden armies rise in great numbers, and there is a warning of a rebellious minister."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The imperial guard armies will rise in force, and there is a warning of a rebellious minister."

sentences.zh: 三年十月，有流星出西南而東北行，光明燭地，有聲如雷，鳥獸盡駭。

translations.literal: In the third year, tenth month, a meteor emerged in the southwest and moved northeast; its light illuminated the earth; there was a sound like thunder; birds and beasts were all terrified.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the tenth month, a meteor emerged in the southwest and streaked northeast, its light illuminating the ground, its sound like thunder; birds and beasts were terrified.

sentences.zh: 占曰「所發之野有破國遷君，西南直夏而首于代都焉。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "In the wilderness where it rose there will be a state destroyed and a ruler displaced; from the southwest it points straight at Xia and its head at the capital of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "In the wilderness where it rose a state will be destroyed and a ruler displaced; from the southwest it points straight at Xia, its head at the capital of Dai.

sentences.zh: 著而有聲，盛怒也」。

translations.literal: Striking down with sound is great wrath."
translations.idiomatic: Striking the earth with thunderous sound betokens great wrath."

sentences.zh: 四年五月辛酉，金、水合于西方。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, fifth month, day xinyou, metal and water conjoined in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the fifth month, on the day xinyou, Venus and Mercury conjoined in the west.

sentences.zh: 占曰「兵起，大戰」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies rise; great battle."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armies rise; a great battle ensues."

sentences.zh: 先是，三年正月，宋人有謝氏之難，王卒盡出。

translations.literal: Previously, in the first month of the third year, Song suffered the turmoil of the Xie clan; princes and commoners all fled outward.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the first month of the third year, Song was shaken by the turmoil of the Xie clan; princes and commoners alike fled into exile.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，上伐赫連昌，入其郛，徙萬餘家以歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, the emperor attacked Helian Chang, entered his outer city, and relocated more than ten thousand households back.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, the emperor attacked Helian Chang, entered his outer city, and relocated more than ten thousand households home.

sentences.zh: 是歲復攻之，六月，大敗昌于城下，昌奔上邽，遂拔統萬，盡收夏器用，虜其母弟妻子，由是威加四隣，北夷讋焉。

translations.literal: That year they attacked again; in the sixth month, they greatly defeated Chang below the city; Chang fled to Shanggui; they then captured Tongwan, gathered all Xia vessels and implements, captured his mother, younger brother, wife, and children; thereby prestige extended to the four neighbors, and northern barbarians cowered.
translations.idiomatic: That year they attacked again; in the sixth month they routed Chang below the city walls. Chang fled to Shanggui; they then took Tongwan, seized all Xia vessels and implements, and captured his mother, younger brother, wife, and children. Thereafter their prestige reached the four borders, and the northern barbarians cowered in awe.

sentences.zh: 神䴥元年五月癸未，太白犯天街。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shenjuan, fifth month, day guiwei, Venus transgressed the Celestial Street.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shenjuan, in the fifth month, on the day guiwei, Venus transgressed the Celestial Street.

sentences.zh: 占曰「六夷髦頭滅」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The six barbarian helmet-headed armies are destroyed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The six barbarian peoples and the helmet-headed armies are destroyed."

sentences.zh: 二年五月，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the second year, fifth month, Venus was visible during the day.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the fifth month, Venus was visible during the day.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大兵且興，強國有弱者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great armies are about to rise; among strong states there will be weak ones."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great armies are about to rise; among strong states some will grow weak."

sentences.zh: 是月，上北征蠕蠕，大破之，虜獲以鉅萬計，遂降高車，以實漠南，闢地數千里云。

translations.literal: That month, the emperor marched north against the Rouran and routed them; captives and booty numbered in the tens of thousands; they then subjugated the Gaoche, to fill the southern desert, opening territory several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor marched north against the Rouran and inflicted a crushing defeat; captives and booty numbered in the tens of thousands. They then subjugated the Gaoche to populate the southern desert and opened territory several thousand li.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，火犯井、鬼，入軒轅。

translations.literal: In the third year, sixth month, fire transgressed Well and Ghost, entering Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the sixth month, Mars transgressed Well and Ghost and entered Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 占曰「秦憂兵亂，有死君。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Qin worries over armies and disorder; there will be a dead ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will suffer from armies and disorder; a ruler will die.

sentences.zh: 又旱饑之應」。

translations.literal: It is also the response of drought and famine."
translations.idiomatic: It is also the omen of drought and famine."

sentences.zh: 丙子，有大流星出危南，入羽林。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, a large meteor emerged south of Rooftop and entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, a large meteor emerged south of Rooftop and entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 占曰「兵起，負海國與王師合戰」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies rise; a sea-facing state battles the royal army."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armies rise; a sea-facing state will join battle with the imperial army."

sentences.zh: 是歲，自三月至十月，太白再犯歲星，月又犯之。

translations.literal: That year, from the third month through the tenth month, Venus twice transgressed Jupiter, and the moon also transgressed it.
translations.idiomatic: That year, from the third month through the tenth month, Venus twice transgressed Jupiter, and the moon transgressed it as well.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有國之君或罹兵刑之難者，且歲饉」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Rulers of existing states may suffer the ordeal of arms and punishment, and there will also be famine that year."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The rulers of existing states may suffer military punishment, and famine will strike that year."

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，流星首如甕，長二十餘丈，大如數十斛船，色正赤，光燭人面，自天船及河，抵奎大星，及于壁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day bingxu, a meteor's head was like a jar, more than twenty zhang long, as large as a ship of several tens of hu; pure red in color, its light illuminated human faces; from the Celestial Boat and the River it reached the great star of Kui and extended to Wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day bingxu, a meteor with a head like a jar streaked more than twenty zhang long and as broad as a ship of several tens of hu, pure red, its light shining on men's faces; from the Celestial Boat and the River it reached the great star of Kui and extended to Wall.

sentences.zh: 占曰「天船以濟兵車，奎為徐方，東壁，衞也，是為宋師之祥。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The Celestial Boat ferries armies and chariots; Kui is Xu region; Eastern Wall is Wei—these are omens of Song armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Celestial Boat ferries armies and chariots; Kui marks Xu region; Eastern Wall is Wei—these are omens of Song armies.

sentences.zh: 昭盛者，事大也」。

translations.literal: When resplendently bright, the affair is great."
translations.idiomatic: When resplendently bright, the affair is great."

sentences.zh: 是歲六月，宋將到彥之等侵魏，自南鄙清水入河，泝流而西，列屯二千餘里。

translations.literal: That year, sixth month, Song generals Dao Yanzhi and others invaded Wei, entering the River from the Qingshui on the southern marches, traveling upstream westward, establishing camps in a line more than two thousand li long.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the sixth month, Song generals Dao Yanzhi and others invaded Wei, entering the Yellow River from the Qingshui on the southern frontier, traveling upstream westward, and establishing camps in a line more than two thousand li long.

sentences.zh: 九月，帝用崔浩策，行幸統萬，遂擊赫連定於平涼。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the emperor following Cui Hao's strategy toured to Tongwan, then struck Helian Ding at Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, following Cui Hao's strategy, the emperor marched to Tongwan and struck Helian Ding at Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，克之，悉定三秦地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, they captured it and fully settled the three Qin lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, they captured it and fully pacified the three Qin regions.

sentences.zh: 明年，大師涉河，攻滑臺，屠之，宋人宵遁。

translations.literal: The following year, the great army crossed the River, attacked Huatai, sacked it, and Song troops fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, the grand army crossed the River, attacked Huatai, sacked it, and Song troops fled under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 是時，赫連定轉攻西秦，戮其君乞伏慕末。

translations.literal: At this time Helian Ding turned to attack Western Qin and executed its ruler Qifu Mumo.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Helian Ding turned to attack Western Qin and executed its ruler Qifu Mumo.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾慕容璝又襲擊定，虜之，以強死者，再君焉。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun Murong Wei also attacked and struck Ding, captured him—though severely wounded near death—and thereby there were two rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun Murong Wei also attacked Ding and captured him, though he was near death from his wounds—and thus Xia had two rulers in succession.

sentences.zh: 是歲二月，定州大饉，詔開倉賑乏。

translations.literal: That year, second month, Ding Province suffered great famine; an edict ordered granaries opened to relieve the destitute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the second month, Ding Province suffered severe famine; an edict ordered granaries opened to relieve the destitute.

sentences.zh: 或曰：奎星羽獵，理兵象也；

translations.literal: Some say: Kui's star plumes and hunts—an image of marshaling armies;
translations.idiomatic: Some hold that Kui's star with plumes and hunting marks an image of marshaling armies;

sentences.zh: 流星抵之而著大，是為大人之事。

translations.literal: The meteor reaching it and becoming great—this is an affair of great men.
translations.idiomatic: The meteor striking it and blazing forth signifies an affair of great men.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，上大閱于漠南，甲騎五十萬，旌旗二千餘里，又明盛之徵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the emperor held a grand review south of the desert: five hundred thousand armored horsemen, banners and flags for more than two thousand li—again a sign of resplendent greatness.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, the emperor held a grand military review south of the desert: five hundred thousand armored horsemen, with banners and flags stretching more than two thousand li—again a sign of resplendent might.

sentences.zh: 〈四年，金、火入東井，火又犯天戶；

translations.literal: 〈In the fourth year, metal and fire entered the Eastern Well; fire again transgressed the Celestial Household;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the fourth year, Venus and Mars entered the Eastern Well; Mars again transgressed the Celestial Household;

sentences.zh: 明年正月，又犯鬼。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, it again transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, it again transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰「秦有兵喪」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Qin has armies and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will suffer armies and mourning."

sentences.zh: 而至秦夏出夷威，[13]沮渠蒙遜又死，氐主楊難當陷宋之漢中地云。〉

translations.literal: And thereafter Qin and Xia sent forth barbarian might; [13] Juqu Mengxun also died; the Di chieftain Yang Nandang seized Song's Hanzhong lands."〉
translations.idiomatic: And thereafter Qin and Xia sent forth barbarian might; [13] Juqu Mengxun also died, and the Di chieftain Yang Nandang seized Song's Hanzhong lands.〉

sentences.zh: 四年三月，有大流星東南行，光燭地，長六七丈，食頃乃滅，後有聲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, third month, a large meteor moved southeast; its light illuminated the earth; it was six or seven zhang long; after the time it takes to eat a meal it vanished; afterward there was a sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the third month, a large meteor streaked southeast, its light illuminating the ground, six or seven zhang long; after the span of a meal it vanished, and afterward a sound was heard.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大兵從之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "A great army follows it."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "A great army follows in its wake."

sentences.zh: 是時諸將方逐宋師，至歷城不及。

translations.literal: At this time the generals were pursuing Song armies but reached Licheng without catching them.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the generals were pursuing the Song armies but reached Licheng without overtaking them.

sentences.zh: 有聲，駿奔之象也。

translations.literal: The sound—an image of swift flight.
translations.idiomatic: The sound was an image of swift flight.

sentences.zh: 四月辛未，太白晝見于胃。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, day xinwei, Venus was visible during the day at Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day xinwei, Venus was visible during the day at Stomach.

sentences.zh: 胃為趙分。

translations.literal: Stomach is Zhao's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Stomach is Zhao's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 五月，太白犯天關；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Venus transgressed the Celestial Gate;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Venus transgressed the Celestial Gate;

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，月又掩之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day bingchen, the moon again concealed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day bingchen, the moon again concealed it.

sentences.zh: 天關外主勃、碣，山河之險窮焉。

translations.literal: Beyond the Celestial Gate governs Bo and Jie—the extreme of mountains and rivers'peril.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Celestial Gate governs Bo and Jie—the farthest reaches of mountain and river defenses.

sentences.zh: 占曰「兵革起」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Arms and warfare rise."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Arms and warfare rise."

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，有流星大如斗，赤色，發太微，至北斗而滅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day bingyin, a meteor as large as the Dipper, red in color, issued from the Supreme Palace Enclosure, reached the Northern Dipper and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day bingyin, a meteor as large as the Dipper, red in color, issued from the Supreme Palace Enclosure, reached the Northern Dipper, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 太微，禮樂之庭，且有昭德之舉，而述宣王命，是以帝車受之。

translations.literal: The Supreme Palace Enclosure is the court of rites and music; moreover there are acts of displaying virtue and proclaiming the king's commands—therefore the Emperor's Chariot received it.
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Palace Enclosure is the court of rites and music; it signifies acts of displaying virtue and proclaiming the royal command—and so the Emperor's Chariot received it.

sentences.zh: 是月壬申，有詔徵范陽盧玄等三十六人，郡國察秀、孝數百人，且命以禮宣喻，申其出處之節。

translations.literal: That month, day renshen, an edict summoned thirty-six men including Lu Xuan of Fanyang; the commanderies and districts recommended several hundred men of cultivated talent and filial piety; moreover they were ordered to proclaim by rites and instruct, setting forth the propriety of entering or leaving office.
translations.idiomatic: That month, on the day renshen, an edict summoned thirty-six men including Lu Xuan of Fanyang; the commanderies and districts recommended several hundred men of cultivated talent and filial piety; they were moreover ordered to proclaim the rites and clarify the proprieties of entering and leaving office.

sentences.zh: 明年六月，上伐北燕，舉燕十餘郡，進圍和龍，徙豪傑三萬餘家以歸。

translations.literal: The following year, sixth month, the emperor attacked Northern Yan, seized more than ten Yan commanderies, advanced to besiege Helong, and relocated more than thirty thousand eminent households back.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the sixth month, the emperor attacked Northern Yan, seized more than ten Yan commanderies, advanced to besiege Helong, and relocated more than thirty thousand eminent households home.

sentences.zh: 〈四年八月，金入太微，亦君自將兵象。

translations.literal: 〈In the fourth year, eighth month, metal entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure—also a sign of the ruler leading armies personally.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the fourth year, in the eighth month, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure—also a sign of the ruler leading armies in person.

sentences.zh: 明年正月庚午，火入鬼。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, day gengwu, fire entered Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, on the day gengwu, Mars entered Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰「秦有死君」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Qin has a dead ruler."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will lose its ruler."

sentences.zh: 四月己丑，太白晝見，為不臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, day jichou, Venus was visible during the day—a sign of disloyal ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day jichou, Venus was visible during the day—a sign of disloyal ministers.

sentences.zh: 其後秦王赫連昌叛走伏誅之應也。〉

translations.literal: Afterward the King of Qin, Helian Chang, rebelled and fled—the response corresponding to execution by decapitation.〉
translations.idiomatic: This corresponded to Helian Chang, King of Xia, rebelling and fleeing to his execution.〉

sentences.zh: 二年五月壬申，有星孛于房。

translations.literal: In the second year, fifth month, day renshen, a broom star appeared at Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the fifth month, on the day renshen, a comet appeared at Chamber.

sentences.zh: 占曰「名山崩，有亡國」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Famous mountains collapse; there is a perished state."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Famous mountains collapse; a state perishes."

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，木入鬼，守積尸；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day dinghai, wood entered Ghost and stationed at Heap of Corpses;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day dinghai, Jupiter entered Ghost and stationed at Heap of Corpses;

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，又犯鬼。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day xinhai, it again transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day xinhai, it again transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 鬼秦分，天戒若曰：涼君淫奢無度，財力窮矣，將喪國，身為戮焉。

translations.literal: Ghost is Qin's allotted region; heaven's warning seemed to say: The ruler of Liang is profligate beyond measure; wealth and power are exhausted; he will lose his state and himself be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Ghost is Qin's allotted region; heaven seemed to warn: The ruler of Liang is profligate beyond measure, his wealth and power exhausted—he will lose his state and die by the sword.

sentences.zh: 〈二年正月、四年十一月，月皆犯井，亦為秦有兵刑。〉

translations.literal: 〈In the first month of the second year and the eleventh month of the fourth year, the moon both transgressed Well—also meaning Qin has arms and punishment.〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the first month of the second year and the eleventh month of the fourth year, the moon transgressed Well both times—also meaning Qin would suffer arms and punishment.〉

sentences.zh: 四年十月壬戌，大流星出文昌，入紫宮，聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, tenth month, day renxu, a large meteor emerged from Literary Glory, entered the Purple Palace, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the tenth month, on the day renxu, a large meteor emerged from Literary Glory, entered the Purple Palace, with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：將相或以全師禦衞帝宮者，其事密近，有震驚之象焉。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: A general or minister may with his full army defend the imperial palace—the affair is close and intimate, with a sign of shock and alarm.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to say: A general or minister would defend the imperial palace with his full army—the matter was close at hand, and there was a sign of shock and alarm.

sentences.zh: 明年六月，帝西征，詔大將軍嵇敬等帥眾二萬屯漠南，[15]以備暴寇。

translations.literal: The following year, sixth month, the emperor marched west on campaign; an edict ordered Grand General Ji Jing and others to lead twenty thousand troops to encamp south of the desert, [15] to guard against sudden raiders.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the sixth month, the emperor marched west on campaign; an edict ordered Grand General Ji Jing and others to lead twenty thousand troops to encamp south of the desert, [15] to guard against sudden raiders.

sentences.zh: 九月，蠕蠕乘虛犯塞，遂至七介山，京師大駭，司空長孫道生等并力拒之，虜乃退走。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Rouran seized the opportunity to raid the border, reaching as far as Qijie Mountain; the capital was greatly alarmed; Minister of Works Chunyu Daosheng and others jointly resisted them, and the barbarians then withdrew in flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Rouran seized the opportunity to raid the border and advanced as far as Qijie Mountain; the capital was thrown into alarm; Minister of Works Chunyu Daosheng and others joined forces to repel them, and the barbarians retreated.

sentences.zh: 是月壬午，有大流星出紫微，入貫索，長六丈餘。

translations.literal: That month, day renwu, a large meteor emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, entered the Coiled Thong, more than six zhang in length.
translations.idiomatic: That month, on the day renwu, a large meteor emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, entered the Coiled Thong, and streaked more than six zhang long.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有大君之命」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There is the fate of a great lord."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The fate of a great lord is at hand."

sentences.zh: 貫索，賤人牢也。

translations.literal: Coiled Thong is the prison of base people.
translations.idiomatic: Coiled Thong is the prison of the lowly.

sentences.zh: 明年，帝命侍臣行郡國，觀風俗，問其所疾苦云。

translations.literal: The following year, the emperor ordered attendant ministers to travel the commanderies and kingdoms, observe customs, and inquire into their hardships.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, the emperor ordered attendant ministers to tour the commanderies and kingdoms, observe local customs, and inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 真君二年七月壬寅，填星犯鉞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenjun, seventh month, day renyin, Saturn transgressed the Battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenjun, in the seventh month, on the day renyin, Saturn transgressed the Battle-axe.

sentences.zh: 鎮者，國家所安危，而為之綱紀者也，其嬰鈇鉞之戮而君及焉。

translations.literal: The Sentinel is what the state's safety and peril depend upon, and what maintains its order; one who meets the axe and halberd of execution—the ruler will share in it.
translations.idiomatic: The Sentinel is what the state's safety and peril depend upon, the keeper of its order; when one meets the axe and halberd of execution, the ruler will share in the blow.

sentences.zh: 自元年十一月至此月，歲星三犯房上相。

translations.literal: From the eleventh month of the first year to this month, Jupiter thrice transgressed the prime minister star of the Fang lodging.
translations.idiomatic: From the eleventh month of the first year through this month, Jupiter thrice transgressed the prime minister star of the Fang lodging.

sentences.zh: 歲星為人君，今反覆由之，循省鈎鈐之備也。

translations.literal: Jupiter is the emblem of the ruler; now going back and forth through it—examine the defenses of the Hook and Seal.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter is the emblem of the ruler; now it goes back and forth through that region—a warning to review the defenses of the Hook and Seal.

sentences.zh: 天若戒輔臣曰：涼邦卒滅，敵國殫矣，而猶挾震主之威，負百勝之計，盍思盈亢之戒乎？

translations.literal: Heaven seemed to warn the chief ministers: The Liang state has utterly perished, the enemy states are exhausted—yet you still wield authority that awes the ruler and trust in plans of a hundred victories; why not heed the warning of fullness and excess?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven seemed to warn the chief ministers: The Liang state is utterly destroyed, the enemy states exhausted—yet you still wield authority that terrifies the ruler and trust in plans of a hundred victories; why not heed the warning of fullness and excess?

sentences.zh: 是時，司徒崔浩方持國鈞，且有寵於上。

translations.literal: At this time Minister over the Masses Cui Hao was holding the balance of the state and was favored by the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Minister over the Masses Cui Hao held the balance of the state and enjoyed the ruler's favor.

sentences.zh: 明年，安西李順備五刑之誅，而由浩鍛成之。

translations.literal: The following year, Anxi Li Shun suffered execution by the five punishments, and Hao forged it into being.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Li Shun of the western campaign suffered execution by the five punishments, and Hao was the one who forged his downfall.

sentences.zh: 後八年，竟族滅無後。

translations.literal: Eight years later, his clan was exterminated to the last, with no descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Eight years later, his clan was exterminated to the last, leaving no descendants.

sentences.zh: 夫天哀賢良而示以明訓夙矣，罕能省躬以先覺，豈不悲哉！

translations.literal: Heaven has long pitied the worthy and shown them clear admonitions, yet few can examine themselves and awaken beforehand—how sad!
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has long pitied the worthy and shown them clear admonitions, yet few can examine themselves and awaken beforehand—how lamentable!

sentences.zh: 浩誅之明年，卒有景穆之禍，後年而亂作。

translations.literal: The year after Hao's execution, the calamity of Jingmu finally came; the year after that, rebellion broke out.
translations.idiomatic: The year after Hao's execution, the calamity of Jingmu finally struck; two years on, rebellion broke out.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，太白、熒惑、歲星聚于東井。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter gathered at the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter gathered at the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰「三星合，是為驚立絕行，其國內外有兵與喪，改立王公」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When three stars conjoin, this is startling establishment and severed movement; within and without the state there are armies and mourning, and princes and kings are replaced."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When three stars conjoin, this is startling establishment and severed movement; within and without the state there will be armies and mourning, and princes and kings will be replaced."

sentences.zh: 九月，盧水胡蓋吳據杏城反，僭署百官，雜虜皆響從，關內大震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Gai Wu of the Lu River Hu seized Xingcheng and rebelled, arrogated offices and installed officials; various barbarians all responded and followed; Within the Passes was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Gai Wu of the Lu River Hu seized Xingcheng and rebelled, arrogated offices and installed officials; various barbarian groups all rallied to him, and the region Within the Passes was thrown into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 十一月，將軍叔孫拔敗吳師于渭北。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, General Shusun Ba defeated Wu's army north of the Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, General Shusun Ba defeated Gai Wu's army north of the Wei River.

sentences.zh: 至七年正月，太白犯熒惑。

translations.literal: By the first month of the seventh year, Venus transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: By the first month of the seventh year, Venus transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 占曰「兵起，有大戰」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies rise; there is a great battle."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armies rise; a great battle follows."

sentences.zh: 時上討吳黨於河東，屠之，遂幸長安。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor campaigned against Wu's faction in Hedong, slaughtered them, and then toured to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the emperor campaigned against Gai Wu's faction in Hedong, slaughtered them, and then proceeded to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 二月，吳軍敗績于杏城，棄馬遁去，復收合餘燼。

translations.literal: In the second month, Wu's army suffered a great defeat at Xingcheng, abandoned their horses and fled, then gathered the embers again.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Gai Wu's army suffered a crushing defeat at Xingcheng, abandoned their horses and fled, then regathered the scattered remnants.

sentences.zh: 八月乃夷之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month they were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they were exterminated.

sentences.zh: 〈五年五月，月犯心；

translations.literal: 〈In the fifth year, fifth month, the moon transgressed Heart;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the fifth year, in the fifth month, the moon transgressed Heart;

sentences.zh: 六年四月，又如之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 占曰「兵犯宋邦」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Arms offend the state of Song."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Arms will strike the state of Song."

sentences.zh: 是月，太白入軒轅。

translations.literal: That month, Venus entered Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Venus entered Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有反臣」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There is a rebellious minister."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be a rebellious minister."

sentences.zh: 是冬，宋太子詹事范曄謀反，誅。

translations.literal: That winter, Fan Ye, Steward of the Heir Apparent of Song, plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Fan Ye, Steward of the Heir Apparent of Song, plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 詔高涼王那徇淮泗，徙其人河北焉。〉

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince Na of Gaoliang to campaign along the Huai and Si, relocating the people north of the River.〉
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Prince Na of Gaoliang to campaign along the Huai and Si and relocate the people north of the River.〉

sentences.zh: 九年正月，火、水皆入羽林。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, fire and water both entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, Mars and Mercury both entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 占曰「禁兵大起」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The forbidden armies rise greatly."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The imperial guard armies rise in great force."

sentences.zh: 四月，太白晝見經天。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Venus was visible during the day crossing the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Venus was visible during the day as it crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，彗星出于昴北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year, a comet emerged north of Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year, a comet emerged north of Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 此天所以滌除天街而禍髦頭之國也。

translations.literal: This was heaven's means of cleansing the Celestial Street and bringing calamity upon the helmet-headed state.
translations.idiomatic: This was heaven's means of cleansing the Celestial Street and bringing calamity upon the helmet-headed state.

sentences.zh: 時間歲討蠕蠕。

translations.literal: During this period, year after year, they campaigned against the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: During this period, year after year, they campaigned against the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 是秋九月，上復自將征之，所捕虜凡百餘萬矣。

translations.literal: That autumn, ninth month, the emperor again led personally on campaign against them; captives taken numbered more than a million in all.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the ninth month, the emperor again led the campaign in person; captives taken numbered more than a million in all.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲七月，太白犯哭星。

translations.literal: 〈In the seventh month of that year, Venus transgressed the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the seventh month of that year, Venus transgressed the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 占曰「天子有哭泣事」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The Son of Heaven has matters of weeping."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will have cause to weep."

sentences.zh: 明年春，皇子真薨。〉

translations.literal: The following spring, Prince Zhen died.〉
translations.idiomatic: The following spring, Prince Zhen died.〉

sentences.zh: 十年十月辛巳，彗星見于太微。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the tenth year, day xinsi, a comet appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the tenth year, on the day xinsi, a comet appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰「兵喪並興，國亂易政，臣賊主」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies and mourning rise together; the state falls into disorder and government changes; ministers become traitors to the ruler."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armies and mourning rise together; the state falls into disorder and government changes; ministers turn traitor against the ruler."

sentences.zh: 至十一年正月甲子，太白晝見，經天；

translations.literal: By the first month of the eleventh year, day jiazi, Venus was visible during the day, crossing the meridian;
translations.idiomatic: By the first month of the eleventh year, on the day jiazi, Venus was visible during the day as it crossed the meridian;

sentences.zh: 四月，又如之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 占曰「中歲而再干明，兵事尤大，且革人更王之應也」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Mid-year twice assaulting the bright light—military affairs especially great, and the response of changing men and replacing kings."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Twice within the year assaulting the bright light—military affairs especially grave, and the omen of changing rulers and replacing kings."

sentences.zh: 是歲十月甲辰，熒惑入太微；

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year, day jiachen, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year, on the day jiachen, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure;

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，又犯之；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day xinwei, it transgressed it again;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day xinwei, it transgressed it again;

sentences.zh: 癸卯，又如之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 占曰「臣將戮主，君將惡之，仍犯事荐也」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Ministers will slaughter the ruler; the ruler will be troubled—offenses will follow in succession."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Ministers will slaughter the ruler; the ruler will be troubled—repeated offenses will follow."

sentences.zh: 先是，八年正月庚午，月犯心大星；

translations.literal: Previously, in the first month of the eighth year, day gengwu, the moon transgressed the great star of Heart;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the first month of the eighth year, on the day gengwu, the moon transgressed the great star of Heart;

sentences.zh: 九年正月，犯歲星；

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, it transgressed Jupiter;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, it transgressed Jupiter;

sentences.zh: 是歲九月，太白又犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of that year, Venus again transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of that year, Venus again transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 至正平元年五月，彗星見卷舌，入太微。

translations.literal: By the fifth month of the first year of Zhengping, a comet appeared at Rolled Tongue and entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month of the first year of Zhengping, a comet appeared at Rolled Tongue and entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 卷舌，讒言之戒。

translations.literal: Rolled Tongue—the warning of slander.
translations.idiomatic: Rolled Tongue is the warning of slander.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，彗星進逼帝坐；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day xinyou, the comet advanced and pressed upon the Emperor's Seat;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, the comet advanced and pressed upon the Emperor's Seat;

sentences.zh: 七月乙酉，犯上相，拂屏，出端門，滅于翼、軫；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day yiyou, it transgressed the senior minister, brushed the Screen, exited the Duan Gate, and vanished at Wings and Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day yiyou, it transgressed the senior minister star, brushed the Screen, exited the Duan Gate, and vanished at Wings and Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 辛酉，直陰國。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, it pointed directly toward the yin state.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, it pointed directly toward the yin-aligned state.

sentences.zh: 翼、軫為楚邦，于屏者，蕭牆之亂也。

translations.literal: Wings and Chariot Shaft are the state of Chu; at the Screen—disorder within the screen wall.
translations.idiomatic: Wings and Chariot Shaft mark the state of Chu; at the Screen lies the disorder of rebellion within the palace walls.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：夫膚受之譖實為亂階，卒至芟夷主相，而專其大號，雖南國之君由遷及焉。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Slander received at first hand is truly the stairway to rebellion; ultimately ministers and chancellors are cut down, and someone monopolizes the great title—even the southern state's ruler is caught up in the cascade.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that slander taken in at first hand is truly the stairway to rebellion; in the end ministers and chancellors are cut down and one party monopolizes the imperial title—even the southern state's ruler is swept up in the cascade.

sentences.zh: 先是，去年十月，上南征絕河。

translations.literal: Previously, in the tenth month of the previous year, the emperor marched south, crossing the River.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the tenth month of the previous year, the emperor marched south and crossed the River.

sentences.zh: 十二月，六師涉淮，登瓜步山觀兵，騎士六十萬，列屯三千餘里，宋人兇懼，饋百牢焉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the six armies crossed the Huai, ascended Guabu Mountain to review the troops—six hundred thousand horsemen, encamped in a line more than three thousand li; the Song people were terrified in fear and presented a hundred sets of sacrificial animals.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the imperial armies crossed the Huai, ascended Guabu Mountain to review the troops—six hundred thousand horsemen encamped in a line more than three thousand li long; the Song people were terrified and presented a hundred sets of sacrificial animals.

sentences.zh: 是年正月，盡舉淮南地，俘之以歸，所夷滅甚眾。

translations.literal: In the first month of that year, they took all the lands of Huainan, captured the people and returned with them; those exterminated were very many.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of that year, they took all the lands of Huainan, carried off captives, and returned—the number slaughtered was very great.

sentences.zh: 六月，帝納宗愛之言，皇太子以強死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the emperor accepted Zong Ai's words; the Crown Prince died a violent death.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the emperor accepted Zong Ai's counsel; the Crown Prince died a violent death.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，愛殺帝于永安宮，左僕射蘭延等以建議不同見殺。

translations.literal: In the second month of the following year, Ai killed the emperor at Yong'an Palace; Left Deputy Director Lan Yan and others were killed for differing in counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the following year, Zong Ai killed the emperor at Yong'an Palace; Left Deputy Director Lan Yan and others were executed for dissenting from his counsel.

sentences.zh: 愛立吳王余為主，尋又賊之。

translations.literal: Ai installed Wu Wang Yu as ruler, then soon murdered him as well.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Ai installed Wu Wang Yu as ruler, then soon murdered him as well.

sentences.zh: 荐災之驗也。

translations.literal: The verification of successive calamities.
translations.idiomatic: The fulfillment of successive calamities.

sentences.zh: 間歲，宋太子劭坐蠱事泄，亦殺其君而僭立，劭弟武陵王駿以上流之師討平之。

translations.literal: A year later, Song Crown Prince Shao, his sorcery affair exposed, also killed his ruler and usurped the throne; Shao's younger brother Prince Jun of Wuling, with armies from the upper reaches, campaigned and suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, Song Crown Prince Shao, his sorcery plot exposed, also killed his ruler and usurped the throne; Shao's younger brother Prince Jun of Wuling, leading armies from the upper reaches, campaigned and put him down.

sentences.zh: 滅於翼軫之徵也。

translations.literal: The fulfillment of the omen in Wings and Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: The fulfillment of the omen in Wings and Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 〈先是，七年八月，月犯熒惑；

translations.literal: 〈Previously, in the eighth month of the seventh year, the moon transgressed Mars;
translations.idiomatic: 〈Previously, in the eighth month of the seventh year, the moon transgressed Mars;

sentences.zh: 八月至十一月，又犯軒轅。

translations.literal: From the eighth month through the eleventh month, it again transgressed Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: From the eighth month through the eleventh month, it again transgressed Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 是歲正月，太白經天。

translations.literal: In the first month of that year, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of that year, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 九月火犯太微。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, fire transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十月，宗愛等伏誅，高宗踐阼。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Zong Ai and others were executed; Emperor Gaozong ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zong Ai and others were executed, and Emperor Gaozong ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 至十一月，錄尚書元壽、尚書令長孫渴侯以爭權賜死，太尉黎、司徒弼又忤旨左遷。

translations.literal: By the eleventh month, Director of the Secretariat Yuan Shou and Director of the Masters of Writing Chunyu Kehou were granted death for struggling over power; Grand Commander Li and Minister over the Masses Bi were also demoted for offending imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: By the eleventh month, Director of the Secretariat Yuan Shou and Director of the Masters of Writing Chunyu Kehou were ordered to die for struggling over power; Grand Commander Li and Minister over the Masses Bi were also demoted for offending the throne.

sentences.zh: 孛于屏相之應。

translations.literal: The response to the comet at the Screen minister star.
translations.idiomatic: The fulfillment of the comet at the Screen minister star.

sentences.zh: 出明年五月，太后崩。〉

translations.literal: The following year, fifth month, the Empress Dowager died.〉
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the fifth month, the Empress Dowager died.〉

sentences.zh: 太安元年六月辛酉，有星起河鼓，東流，有尾跡，光明燭地。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Tai'an, day xinyou, a star rose at River Drum, flowed eastward, had a tail trail, and its brilliance illuminated the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Tai'an, on the day xinyou, a star rose at River Drum and streamed eastward with a tail trail, its brilliance illuminating the ground.

sentences.zh: 河鼓為履險之兵，負海之象也。

translations.literal: River Drum is armies treading peril—a sea-facing emblem.
translations.idiomatic: River Drum marks armies treading peril—a sea-facing emblem.

sentences.zh: 昭盛為人君之事，星之所往，君且從之。

translations.literal: Resplendent brilliance is an affair of the ruler; where the star goes, the ruler will follow.
translations.idiomatic: Resplendent brilliance signifies an affair of the ruler; whither the star goes, the ruler will follow.

sentences.zh: 間二歲，帝幸遼西，登碣石以臨滄海，復所過郡國一年，又尾迹之徵。

translations.literal: Two years later, the emperor toured Liaoxi, ascended Jieshi to overlook the blue sea, and remitted one year's taxes in the commanderies and kingdoms he passed through—again a sign of the tail trail.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, the emperor toured Liaoxi, ascended Jieshi to overlook the blue sea, and remitted one year's taxes in the commanderies and kingdoms he passed through—again the omen of the tail trail.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲五月，火入斗。

translations.literal: 〈In the fifth month of that year, fire entered the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the fifth month of that year, Mars entered the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 斗主形命之養。

translations.literal: The Dipper governs the nourishment of form and life.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper governs the nourishment of form and life.

sentences.zh: 其後三吳荐饑，仍歲疾疫。〉

translations.literal: Afterwards the Three Wu regions suffered repeated famine, and plague struck year after year.〉
translations.idiomatic: Afterwards the Three Wu regions suffered repeated famine, and plague ravaged them year after year.〉

sentences.zh: 三年十一月，熒惑犯房鈎鈐星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, Mars transgressed the Hook and Seal stars of the Fang lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year, Mars transgressed the Hook and Seal stars of the Fang lodging.

sentences.zh: 是謂強臣不御，王者憂之。

translations.literal: This means a powerful minister is uncontrolled—the king is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: This means a powerful minister goes unchecked—the king is troubled.

sentences.zh: 至四年正月，月入太微，犯西蕃；

translations.literal: By the first month of the fourth year, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and transgressed the western enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: By the first month of the fourth year, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and transgressed the western enclosure;

sentences.zh: 三月，又犯五諸侯。

translations.literal: In the third month, it again transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, it again transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.

sentences.zh: 占曰「諸侯大臣有謀反伏誅者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Among feudal lords and great ministers there are those who plot rebellion and are executed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Among feudal lords and great ministers there will be those who plot rebellion and are executed."

sentences.zh: 是月，太白犯房，月入南斗。

translations.literal: That month, Venus transgressed Fang; the moon entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Venus transgressed Fang, and the moon entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 皆宋分。

translations.literal: All are Song's allotted regions.
translations.idiomatic: All are Song's allotted regions.

sentences.zh: 占曰「國有變，臣為亂」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The state has change; ministers become rebels."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state will undergo change; ministers will rebel."

sentences.zh: 十一月，長星出於奎，色白，蛇行，有尾跡，既滅，變為白雲。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, a long star emerged from Kui, white in color, moving serpent-like, with a tail trail; once it vanished, it changed into white clouds.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, a long star emerged from Kui, white in color, moving serpent-like with a tail trail; once it vanished, it changed into white clouds.

sentences.zh: 奎為徐方，又魯分也。

translations.literal: Kui is Xu region; it is also Lu's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Kui marks Xu region; it is also Lu's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 占曰「下有流血積骨」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Below there is flowing blood and heaped bones."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Below there will be flowing blood and heaped bones."

sentences.zh: 明年，宋兗州刺史竟陵王誕據廣陵作亂，宋主親戎，自夏涉秋，無日不戰，及城陷，悉屠之。

translations.literal: The following year, Prince Dan of Jingling, Inspector of Yan Province of Song, seized Guangling and rebelled; the Song ruler personally took command; from summer through autumn, not a day passed without battle; when the city fell, all were slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Prince Dan of Jingling, Inspector of Yan Province of Song, seized Guangling and rebelled; the Song ruler personally took command; from summer through autumn, not a day passed without battle; when the city fell, all were slaughtered.

sentences.zh: 二年三月辛巳，有長星出天津，色赤，長匹餘，滅而復出，大小百數。

translations.literal: In the second year, third month, day xinsi, a long star emerged from the Celestial Ford, red in color, more than a match in length; it vanished and re-emerged, numbering a hundred or so in size.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the third month, on the day xinsi, a long star emerged from the Celestial Ford, red in color and more than a match in length; it vanished and re-emerged, with a hundred or so stars large and small.

sentences.zh: 天津，帝之都，船所以渡，神通四方，光大且眾，為人君之事。

translations.literal: The Celestial Ford is the emperor's capital—the ferry by which boats cross; spirit connects the four directions; brilliance is great and multitudinous—an affair of the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Ford is the emperor's capital—the ferry by which boats cross; its spirit connects the four directions; its brilliance is great and multitudinous—an affair of the ruler.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：是將有千乘萬騎之舉，而絕逾大川矣。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: There will be a mobilization of a thousand chariots and ten thousand horsemen, crossing great rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that there would be a mobilization of a thousand chariots and ten thousand horsemen, crossing great rivers.

sentences.zh: 是月，發卒五千餘，通河西獵道。

translations.literal: That month, more than five thousand conscript laborers were dispatched to open the hunting road west of the River.
translations.idiomatic: That month, more than five thousand conscript laborers were dispatched to open the hunting road west of the River.

sentences.zh: 後年八月，帝校獵于河西，宋主亦大閱舟師，巡狩江右云。

translations.literal: Two years later, eighth month, the emperor conducted a hunting expedition west of the River; the Song ruler also held a grand review of the naval forces, touring and hunting on the river's right bank.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, in the eighth month, the emperor conducted a hunting expedition west of the River; the Song ruler also held a grand naval review, touring and hunting south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: In the second year, ninth month, the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the ninth month, Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 斗，吳分。

translations.literal: The Dipper is Wu's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is Wu's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 占曰「君死更政，大臣有誅者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The ruler dies and the government changes; among great ministers there are those who will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will die and the government will change; great ministers will be executed."

sentences.zh: 十一月，太白犯填。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Great White transgressed the Filler.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Venus transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 填，女君也，且曰有內兵、白衣會。

translations.literal: The Filler is the lady ruler; it also says there will be internal warfare and a white-robed assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn is the lady ruler; the omen also indicates internal warfare and a white-robed assembly.

sentences.zh: 至三年九月，火犯積尸。

translations.literal: By the third year, ninth month, fire transgressed Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: By the third year, in the ninth month, Mars transgressed Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 占曰「貴人憂之，斧鉞用」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Noble persons will grieve over it; battle-axes will be employed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Noble persons will grieve; battle-axes will be employed."

sentences.zh: 十月，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Great White transgressed the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 歲為人君，而以兵喪干之，且有死君篡殺之禍。

translations.literal: The Year Star is the human ruler; yet military calamity assails it—moreover there is the disaster of a dead ruler and usurpation through assassination.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter represents the human ruler; to assail it with military calamity portends a dead ruler and usurpation through assassination.

sentences.zh: 是月，熒惑守軒轅。

translations.literal: That month, the Sparkling Deluder stationed at Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Mars stationed at Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 占曰「女主憂之，宮中兵亂」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The lady sovereign will grieve over it; there will be armed disorder in the palace."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The lady sovereign will grieve; there will be armed disorder in the palace."

sentences.zh: 十一月，歲入氐。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Year Star entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Jupiter entered Di.

sentences.zh: 氐為正寢，歲為有國之君。

translations.literal: Di is the proper sleeping quarters; the Year Star is the ruler of a state.
translations.idiomatic: Di is the proper sleeping quarters; Jupiter is the ruler of a state.

sentences.zh: 占曰「諸侯王有來入宮者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Among feudal lords and princes there will be one who comes to enter the palace."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Among feudal lords and princes there will be one who enters the palace."

sentences.zh: 五年二月，月入南斗魁中，犯第四星。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, second month, the moon entered the head of the Southern Dipper and transgressed the fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the second month, the moon entered the head of the Southern Dipper and transgressed the fourth star.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大人憂，太子傷，宮中有自賊者；

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great persons will grieve; the heir will be harmed; within the palace there will be self-inflicted treachery;
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great persons will grieve; the heir will be harmed; within the palace there will be self-inflicted treachery;

sentences.zh: 又大赦」。

translations.literal: and also a great amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: and also a general amnesty."

sentences.zh: 既而宋孝武及宋后相繼崩殂，少主荐誅輔臣，釁連戚屬，羣下相與殺之，而立宋明帝。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Emperor Xiaowu of Song and the Song empress died in succession; the young ruler repeatedly executed assisting ministers; trouble spread to kinsmen; the assembled subordinates together killed him and installed Emperor Ming of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Emperor Xiaowu of Song and the Song empress died in succession; the young ruler repeatedly executed his assisting ministers, trouble spread to kinsmen, the assembled officials together killed him, and installed Emperor Ming of Song.

sentences.zh: 江南大饑，且仍，有肆眚之令焉。

translations.literal: South of the Yangtze suffered great famine, and it continued year after year; there was an edict of general amnesty for misdeeds.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Yangtze suffered great famine, year after year, and there was an edict of general amnesty for accumulated offenses.

sentences.zh: 〈先是，三年六月，太白犯東井；

translations.literal: 〈Previously, in the sixth month of the third year, the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well;
translations.idiomatic: 〈Previously, in the sixth month of the third year, Venus transgressed the Eastern Well;

sentences.zh: 七月，火入井；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, fire entered the Well;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Mars entered the Well;

sentences.zh: 四年五月，金、火皆犯上相；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, metal and fire both transgressed the Senior Minister;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Venus and Mars both transgressed the Senior Minister;

sentences.zh: 五年六月，火又入井。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, fire again entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, Mars again entered the Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大臣憂，斧鉞用」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great ministers will grieve; battle-axes will be employed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will grieve; battle-axes will be employed."

sentences.zh: 六年七月，月犯心前星。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, the moon transgressed the anterior star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year, the moon transgressed the anterior star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋殺少主，其後有乙渾之難。〉

translations.literal: That month, Song killed the young ruler; afterward came the calamity of Yi Hun.〉
translations.idiomatic: That month, Song killed the young ruler; afterward came the calamity of Yi Hun.〉

sentences.zh: 五年七月丁未，歲星守心。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, seventh month, day dingwei, the Year Star stationed at Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the seventh month, on the day dingwei, Jupiter stationed at Heart.

sentences.zh: 心為明堂，歲為諸侯，為長子入而守之，立君之象。

translations.literal: Heart is the Bright Hall; the Year Star is feudal lords—the eldest son entering and stationing there is an image of establishing a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Heart is the Bright Hall; Jupiter represents feudal lords—the eldest son entering and stationing there is an image of establishing a ruler.

sentences.zh: 占曰「凡五星守心，皆為宮中亂賊，羣下有謀立天子者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Whenever any of the five planets stations at Heart, all signify palace rebels; among the assembled subordinates there are those who plot to install the Son of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Whenever any of the five planets stations at Heart, all signify palace rebels; among the assembled subordinates there are those who plot to install the Son of Heaven."

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，有流星長丈餘，入紫微，經北辰第三星而滅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day jiyou, there was a meteor more than a zhang in length; it entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, passed the third star of the Northern Pole, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day jiyou, a meteor more than a zhang in length entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, passed the third star of the Northern Pole, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有大喪」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be great mourning."

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，火入軒轅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day dingyou, fire entered Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day dingyou, Mars entered Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 十一月，長星出織女，色正白，彗之象也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, a long star emerged from Weaver Girl, pure white in color—the image of a comet.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, a long star emerged from Weaver Girl, pure white in color—the image of a comet.

sentences.zh: 女主專制，將由此始，是以天視由之。

translations.literal: The lady sovereign's exclusive control would begin from this; therefore Heaven's gaze passed through it.
translations.idiomatic: The lady sovereign's exclusive control would begin from this; therefore Heaven's gaze passed through it.

sentences.zh: 長星，彗之著，易政之漸焉。

translations.literal: A long star is the conspicuous form of a comet—the gradual onset of change in government.
translations.idiomatic: A long star is the conspicuous form of a comet—the gradual onset of change in government.

sentences.zh: 冬，熒惑入太微，犯上將；
