translations.literal: In winter, the Sparkling Deluder entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and transgressed the Senior General;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and transgressed the Senior General;

sentences.zh: 十二月，遂守之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, it then stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, it then stationed there.

sentences.zh: 占曰「公侯謀上，且有斬臣」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Nobles and feudal lords will plot against the ruler, and there will be executed ministers."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Nobles and feudal lords will plot against the ruler, and there will be executed ministers."

sentences.zh: 六年正月乙未，有流星長丈餘，自五車抵紫宮西蕃乃滅。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month, day yimao, there was a meteor more than a zhang in length; from Five Chariots it reached the western portion of the Purple Palace and then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the first month, on the day yimao, a meteor more than a zhang in length streaked from Five Chariots to the western portion of the Purple Palace and vanished.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：羣臣或修霸刑，而干蕃輔之任矣。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: ministers may impose hegemonic punishments and encroach upon the duties of border guardians and assistants.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that ministers might impose hegemonic punishments and encroach upon the duties of border guardians and assistants.

sentences.zh: 且占曰「政亂有奇令」。

translations.literal: Moreover the prognostication says: "When government is disordered there are extraordinary edicts."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the prognostication reads: "When government is disordered there are extraordinary edicts."

sentences.zh: 四月，太白犯五諸侯。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the Great White transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Venus transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有專殺諸侯者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be one who kills feudal lords on his own authority."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be one who kills feudal lords on his own authority."

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，上崩于太華殿，車騎大將軍乙渾矯詔殺尚書楊寶年等于禁中。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day guimao, the emperor died at Taihua Hall; Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry Yi Hun forged an edict and killed Director of the Masters of Writing Yang Baonian and others within the Forbidden Quarter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day guimao, the emperor died at Taihua Hall; Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry Yi Hun forged an edict and killed Director of the Masters of Writing Yang Baonian and others within the Forbidden Quarter.

sentences.zh: 戊申，又害司徒、平原王陸麗。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, he further killed Minister over the Masses, Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, he further killed Minister over the Masses, Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li.

sentences.zh: 明年，皇太后定策誅之。

translations.literal: The following year, the Empress Dowager resolved on a plan and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, the Empress Dowager resolved on a plan and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 太后臨朝，自馮氏始也。

translations.literal: An empress dowager holding court began with the Feng clan.
translations.idiomatic: An empress dowager holding court began with the Feng clan.

sentences.zh: 或曰：心為宋分。

translations.literal: Some say: Heart is Song's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Some say: Heart is Song's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 是歲六月，歲星晝見于南斗。

translations.literal: That year, sixth month, the Year Star was visible during daytime at the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the sixth month, Jupiter was visible during daytime at the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 斗為天祿，吳分也。

translations.literal: The Dipper is Heaven's salary; it is also Wu's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is Heaven's salary; it is also Wu's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：或以諸侯干君而代奪之。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: perhaps feudal lords will encroach upon the ruler and seize power in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that feudal lords might encroach upon the ruler and seize power in his stead.

sentences.zh: 是冬，宋明帝以皇弟踐阼，孝武諸子舉兵攻之，四方響應，尋皆伏誅。

translations.literal: That winter, Emperor Ming of Song ascended the throne as the emperor's younger brother; the sons of Emperor Xiaowu raised armies to attack him; the four quarters responded; soon all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Emperor Ming of Song ascended the throne as the emperor's younger brother; the sons of Emperor Xiaowu raised armies to attack him, the four quarters responded, and soon all were executed.

sentences.zh: 有太白之刑與歲星之祐焉。

translations.literal: There were Venus's punishment and Jupiter's protection in it.
translations.idiomatic: There were Venus's punishment and Jupiter's protection in it.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲三月，有流星西行，不可勝數，至明乃止。

translations.literal: 〈That year, third month, there were meteors streaming westward beyond counting, ceasing only at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: 〈That year, in the third month, meteors streamed westward beyond counting, ceasing only at dawn.

sentences.zh: 至六月己卯，又有流星，多西南行。

translations.literal: By the sixth month, day jimao, there were again meteors, mostly heading southwest.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth month, on the day jimao, there were again meteors, mostly heading southwest.

sentences.zh: 星眾而小，庶人象也，星之所首，人將從之。

translations.literal: The stars were numerous and small—the emblem of commoners; whither the stars lead, people will follow.
translations.idiomatic: The stars were numerous and small—the emblem of commoners; whither the stars lead, people will follow.

sentences.zh: 及宋討孝武諸子，大兵首自尋陽，進平荊雍。

translations.literal: When Song campaigned against the sons of Xiaowu, the great army first set out from Xunyang and advanced to pacify Jing and Yong.
translations.idiomatic: When Song campaigned against the sons of Xiaowu, the great army first set out from Xunyang and advanced to pacify Jing and Yong.

sentences.zh: 其後張永之師敗績于呂梁，魏師盡舉淮右，俘其人，又西流之效也。〉

translations.literal: Afterward Zhang Yong's army was defeated at Lüliang; Wei forces fully mobilized on the Huai's right bank and captured his men—again the effect of the westward flow.〉
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Zhang Yong's army was defeated at Lüliang; Wei forces fully mobilized on the Huai's right bank and captured his men—again the effect of the westward flow.〉

sentences.zh: 顯祖天安元年正月戊子，[22]太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tian'an under Emperor Xianzu, day wuzi, [22] the Great White transgressed the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Tian'an under Emperor Xianzu, on the day wuzi, [22] Venus transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 歲，農事也，肅殺干之，是為稼穡不登。

translations.literal: The Year Star is agricultural affairs; stern slaughter assails it—this means crops fail to ripen.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter governs agricultural affairs; when stern slaughter assails it, crops fail to ripen.

sentences.zh: 六月，熒惑犯鬼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Sparkling Deluder transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Mars transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰「旱饑疾疫，金革用」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Drought, famine, and pestilence; metal and weapons will be employed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Drought, famine, and pestilence; metal and weapons will be employed."

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，太白犯房。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day dinghai, the Great White transgressed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day dinghai, Venus transgressed Fang.

sentences.zh: 占曰「霜雨失節，馬牛多死」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Frost and rain out of season; horses and oxen will mostly die."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Frost and rain out of season; horses and oxen will mostly die."

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，熒惑犯上將，太白犯南斗第三星。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day jiayin, the Sparkling Deluder transgressed the Senior General; the Great White transgressed the third star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiayin, Mars transgressed the Senior General, and Venus transgressed the third star of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰「貴人將相有誅者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Among nobles, generals, and ministers there will be those who are executed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Among nobles, generals, and ministers there will be those who are executed."

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，太白又犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day jiyou, the Great White again transgressed the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day jiyou, Venus again transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 或曰歲為諸侯，太白主兵刑之政，再干之，事洊也。

translations.literal: Some say the Year Star is feudal lords; the Great White governs military punishment—assailing it twice means events recur.
translations.idiomatic: Some say Jupiter represents feudal lords and Venus governs military punishment; assailing it twice means events will recur.

sentences.zh: 是歲九月，州鎮十一旱饑。

translations.literal: That year, ninth month, eleven provincial garrisons suffered drought and famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the ninth month, eleven provincial garrisons suffered drought and famine.

sentences.zh: 十月，宋氏六王皆戮死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the six princes of the Song house were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the six princes of the Song house were all executed.

sentences.zh: 明年，宋師敗于呂梁，江南阻饑，牛且大疫。

translations.literal: The following year, Song armies were defeated at Lüliang; south of the Yangtze famine blocked the land; cattle suffered great pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Song armies were defeated at Lüliang; south of the Yangtze famine blocked the land, and cattle suffered great pestilence.

sentences.zh: 其後，東平王道符擅殺副將及雍州刺史，據長安反，詔司空和其奴討滅之。

translations.literal: Afterward, Prince of Dongping Dao Fu unauthorizedly killed the deputy general and Inspector of Yong Province, seized Chang'an and rebelled; an edict ordered Minister of Works He Qinu to campaign and destroy him.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Prince of Dongping Dao Fu unauthorizedly killed the deputy general and Inspector of Yong Province, seized Chang'an and rebelled; an edict ordered Minister of Works He Qinu to campaign and destroy him.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔賜六鎮孤貧布帛，宋主以後宮服御賜征北將士。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict granted cloth and silk to the orphaned and poor of the Six Garrisons; the Song ruler bestowed inner-palace robes and gear upon the northern campaign troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, an edict granted cloth and silk to the orphaned and poor of the Six Garrisons; the Song ruler bestowed inner-palace robes and gear upon the northern campaign troops.

sentences.zh: 後歲夏，旱，河決，州鎮二十七皆饑，尋又天下大疫。

translations.literal: The summer of the year after, there was drought; the river burst its banks; twenty-seven provincial garrisons all suffered famine; soon afterward a great pestilence spread across the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The summer of the year after brought drought; the river burst its banks; twenty-seven provincial garrisons all suffered famine; soon afterward a great pestilence spread across the realm.

sentences.zh: 〈元年六月，太白犯左執法；

translations.literal: 〈In the first year, sixth month, the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the first year, in the sixth month, Venus transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: 十月，火又犯之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, fire again transgressed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Mars again transgressed it.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大臣有憂，霸者之刑用」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great ministers will grieve; the hegemon's punishments will be employed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will grieve; the hegemon's punishments will be employed."

sentences.zh: 是歲六月，月犯井；

translations.literal: That year, sixth month, the moon transgressed the Well;
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the sixth month, the moon transgressed the Well;

sentences.zh: 十月，又掩之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, it again concealed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, it again concealed it.

sentences.zh: 皇興元年正月，月犯井北轅第二星；

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangxing, first month, the moon transgressed the second star of the northern axle of the Well;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangxing, in the first month, the moon transgressed the second star of the northern axle of the Well;

sentences.zh: 八月，又蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, it again eclipsed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, it again eclipsed it.

sentences.zh: 占曰「貴人當之，有將死，水旱祥也」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Noble persons will be struck; generals will die—it is an omen of flood and drought."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Noble persons will be struck; generals will die—it is an omen of flood and drought."

sentences.zh: 道符作亂之明年，司空和其奴、太宰李峻皆薨。〉

translations.literal: The year after Dao Fu's rebellion, Minister of Works He Qinu and Grand Mentor Li Jun both died.〉
translations.idiomatic: The year after Dao Fu's rebellion, Minister of Works He Qinu and Grand Mentor Li Jun both died.〉

translations.literal: Footnote 23.
translations.idiomatic: See editorial note 23.

sentences.zh: 高祖延興元年十月庚子，月入畢口。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Yanxing under Emperor Gaozu, day gengzi, the moon entered the mouth of Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Yanxing under Emperor Gaozu, on the day gengzi, the moon entered the mouth of Net.

sentences.zh: 畢，魏分。

translations.literal: Net is Wei's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Net is Wei's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「小人罔上，大人易位，國有拘主反臣。」

translations.literal: The prognostication says: 「Petty men deceive their superiors; great persons change places; the state has a captive ruler and rebellious ministers.」
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: 「Petty men deceive their superiors; great persons change places; the state has a captive ruler and rebellious ministers.」

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，火犯鈎鈐。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day xinmao, fire transgressed the Hook and Seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day xinmao, Mars transgressed the Hook and Seal.

sentences.zh: 鈎鈐以統天駟，火為內亂。

translations.literal: The Hook and Seal governs the Celestial Team of Four; fire signifies internal disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The Hook and Seal governs the Celestial Team of Four; fire signifies internal disorder.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：人君失馭，或以亂政乘之矣。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: the human ruler lost control, and someone may have seized power through disorderly government.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that the ruler had lost control, and someone might seize power through disorderly government.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，鎮星犯井。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Quelling Star transgressed the Well.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, Saturn transgressed the Well.

sentences.zh: 夫井者，天下之平也，而女君以干之，是為后竊刑柄。

translations.literal: The Well is the balance of all under Heaven; yet the lady ruler assailed it—this signifies the empress seizing the handles of punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Well is the balance of all under Heaven; yet the lady ruler assailed it—this signifies the empress seizing the handles of punishment.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下無主，大人憂之，有過賞之事焉。」

translations.literal: The prognostication says: 「All under Heaven has no master; great persons will grieve; there will be matters of excessive reward.」
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: 「All under Heaven has no master; great persons will grieve; there will be matters of excessive reward.」

sentences.zh: 二年正月，月犯畢；

translations.literal: In the second year, first month, the moon transgressed Net;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month, the moon transgressed Net;

sentences.zh: 丙子，月犯東井；

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the moon transgressed the Eastern Well;
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, the moon transgressed the Eastern Well;

sentences.zh: 庚子，又如之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下有變，令貴人多死者。」

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "All under Heaven has upheaval; many nobles among those holding command will die."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "All under Heaven has upheaval; many nobles among those holding command will die."

sentences.zh: 三年八月，月犯太微。

translations.literal: In the third year, eighth month, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 又羣陰不制之象也。

translations.literal: It is also an image of the manifold yin forces left unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: It is also an image of the manifold yin forces left unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 是時馮太后宣淫于朝，昵近小人而附益之，所費以鉅萬億計，天子徒尸位而已。

translations.literal: At this time Empress Dowager Feng flaunted licentious conduct at court, drew close to petty men and enriched them; expenditures ran to tens of millions—the Son of Heaven held office in name alone.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Empress Dowager Feng flaunted licentious conduct at court, drew close to petty men and enriched them; expenditures ran to tens of millions—the Son of Heaven held office in name alone.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，河間王閭虎皮以貪殘賜死。

translations.literal: In the second year, ninth month, Prince of Hejian Lü Hupi was granted death for greed and cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the ninth month, Prince of Hejian Lü Hupi was granted death for greed and cruelty.

sentences.zh: 其後，司空、東平郡王陸麗坐事廢為兵，既而宮車晏駕。

translations.literal: Afterward, Minister of Works and Prince of Dongping Lu Li, punished for his offense, was degraded to common soldier; soon afterward the imperial carriage halted at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Minister of Works and Prince of Dongping Lu Li, punished for his offense, was degraded to common soldier; soon afterward the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 〈或曰月入畢口為赦令。

translations.literal: 〈Some say the moon's entering the mouth of Net signifies an amnesty decree.
translations.idiomatic: 〈Some say the moon's entering the mouth of Net signifies an amnesty decree.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，曲赦京師及秦涼諸鎮。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month, a partial amnesty was granted to the capital and the Qin-Liang garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month, a partial amnesty was granted to the capital and the Qin-Liang garrisons.

sentences.zh: 星及月犯井，皆為水災，且旱祥也。

translations.literal: Stars and the moon transgressing the Well—all signify flood disasters, and also omens of drought.
translations.idiomatic: Stars and the moon transgressing the Well—all signify flood disasters, and also omens of drought.

sentences.zh: 是歲九月，州鎮十一水旱，詔免其田租，開倉賑乏。〉

translations.literal: That year, ninth month, eleven provincial garrisons suffered flood and drought; an edict remitted their field taxes and opened granaries to relieve the destitute.〉
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the ninth month, eleven provincial garrisons suffered flood and drought; an edict remitted their field taxes and opened granaries to relieve the destitute.〉

sentences.zh: 四年九月己卯，月犯畢。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, ninth month, day jimao, the moon transgressed Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the ninth month, on the day jimao, the moon transgressed Net.

sentences.zh: [26]七月丙申，太白犯歲星，在角。

translations.literal: [26] In the seventh month, day bingshen, the Great White transgressed the Year Star at Horn.
translations.idiomatic: [26] In the seventh month, on the day bingshen, Venus transgressed Jupiter at Horn.

sentences.zh: [27]丁卯，太白又入氐。

translations.literal: [27] On the day dingmao, the Great White again entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: [27] On the day dingmao, Venus again entered Di.

sentences.zh: [28]太白有母后之幾，主兵喪之政，以干君於外朝而及其宿宮，是將有劫殺之虞矣。

translations.literal: [28] The Great White bears the omen of an empress dowager; it governs military mourning affairs—assailing the ruler in the outer court and reaching his dwelling palace—there will soon be fear of robbery and slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: [28] Venus bears the omen of an empress dowager; it governs military mourning affairs—assailing the ruler in the outer court and reaching his dwelling palace—there will soon be fear of robbery and slaughter.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，月犯軒轅；

translations.literal: In the second month, day guichou, the moon transgressed Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day guichou, the moon transgressed Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 甲寅，又犯歲星。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, it again transgressed the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, it again transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 月為強大之臣，為主女之象，[29]始由后妃之府而干少陽之君，示人主以戒敬之備也。

translations.literal: The moon is a powerful minister, the image of the ruler's daughter; [29] beginning from the quarters of empress and consorts it assails the Lesser Yang ruler, showing the human sovereign the need for vigilance and reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The moon is a powerful minister, the image of the ruler's daughter; [29] beginning from the quarters of empress and consorts it assails the youthful yang ruler, showing the sovereign the need for vigilance and reverence.

sentences.zh: 五年三月甲戌，月掩填星。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, third month, day jiaxu, the moon concealed the Quelling Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the third month, on the day jiaxu, the moon concealed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：是又僻行不制而棄其紀綱矣。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: This is again deviant movement left unrestrained, abandoning its cords and net.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that this was again deviant movement left unrestrained, abandoning its cords and net.

sentences.zh: 且占曰「貴人強死，天下亂」。

translations.literal: Moreover the prognostication says: "Nobles will die violently; all under Heaven will fall into disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the prognostication reads: "Nobles will die violently; all under Heaven will fall into disorder."

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，金、火皆入羽林。

translations.literal: In the third month, day guiwei, metal and fire both entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day guiwei, Venus and Mars both entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 占曰「臣欲賊主，諸侯之兵盡發」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Ministers wish to murder their lord; the armies of the feudal lords will all be mobilized."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Ministers wish to murder their lord; the armies of the feudal lords will all be mobilized."

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，月掩畢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day yihai, the moon concealed Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day yihai, the moon concealed Net.

sentences.zh: 十一月，月入軒轅，食第二星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the moon entered Chariot Shaft and eclipsed the second star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the moon entered Chariot Shaft and eclipsed the second star.

sentences.zh: 至承明元年四月，月食尾。

translations.literal: By the fourth month of Chenming year 1, the moon eclipsed Tail.
translations.idiomatic: By the fourth month of Chenming year 1, the moon eclipsed Tail.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，金、火皆入軒轅；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day jihai, metal and fire both entered Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jihai, Venus and Mars both entered Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 庚子，相逼同光。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, they pressed close sharing the same light.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, they pressed close sharing the same light.

sentences.zh: 皆后妃之謫也。

translations.literal: All were punishments upon empress and consorts.
translations.idiomatic: All were punishments upon empress and consorts.

sentences.zh: 天若言曰：母后之釁幾貫盈矣，人君忘祖考之業，慕匹夫之孝，其如宗祀何？

translations.literal: Heaven seemed to say: The empress dowager's offense is nearly full to overflowing; the human ruler has forgotten his ancestors' enterprise and cherishes a commoner's filial piety—what will become of the ancestral sacrifices?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven seemed to say: The empress dowager's offense is nearly full to overflowing; the ruler has forgotten his ancestors' enterprise and cherishes a commoner's filial piety—what will become of the ancestral sacrifices?

sentences.zh: 是時，獻文不悟，至六月暴崩，實有酖毒之禍焉。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Xianwen did not perceive the warning; by the sixth month he died suddenly—truly there was the calamity of poisoned wine.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Xianwen did not perceive the warning; by the sixth month he died suddenly—truly there was the calamity of poisoned wine.

sentences.zh: 由是言之，皇天有以覩履霜之萌，而為之成象久矣。

translations.literal: From this perspective, August Heaven had already discerned the sprout of frost underfoot and long since manifested it in completed signs.
translations.idiomatic: From this perspective, August Heaven had already discerned the sprout of frost underfoot and long since manifested it in completed signs.

sentences.zh: 其後，文明皇太后崩，孝文皇帝方修諒陰之儀，篤孺子之慕，竟未能述宣春秋之義，而懲供人之黨，是以胡氏循之，卒傾魏室，豈不哀哉！

translations.literal: Afterward, Empress Dowager Wenming died; Emperor Xiaowen was just observing mourning rites and cherished childlike grief for his parents—yet in the end he could not proclaim and enact the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals and punish the faction of palace attendants; thus the Hu clan followed in their course, and at last the Wei house was overturned—how pitiful!
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Empress Dowager Wenming died; Emperor Xiaowen was just observing mourning rites and cherished childlike grief for his parents—yet in the end he could not proclaim and enact the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals and punish the faction of palace attendants; thus the Hu clan followed in their course, and at last the Wei house was overturned—how pitiful!

sentences.zh: 或曰：太白犯歲於天門，以臣伐君之象；

translations.literal: Some say: The Great White transgressing the Year Star at the Celestial Gate is the image of a minister attacking his ruler;
translations.idiomatic: Some say: Venus transgressing Jupiter at the Celestial Gate is the image of a minister attacking his ruler;

sentences.zh: 金、火同光，又兵亂之徵。

translations.literal: Metal and fire sharing the same light is likewise a sign of military disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Venus and Mars sharing the same light is likewise a sign of military disorder.

sentences.zh: 時宋主昏狂，公侯近戚冤死相繼。

translations.literal: At that time the Song ruler was maddened and reckless; among dukes, marquises, and close kin wrongful deaths followed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Song ruler was maddened and reckless; among dukes, marquises, and close kin wrongful deaths followed one after another.

sentences.zh: 既而桂陽、建平王並稱兵內侮，矢及宮闕，僅乃戡之。

translations.literal: Soon the Princes of Guiyang and Jianping both raised armies and insulted the court from within; arrows reached the palace gates—they were barely suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Princes of Guiyang and Jianping both raised armies and insulted the court from within; arrows reached the palace gates—they were barely suppressed.

sentences.zh: 尋為左右楊玉夫等所殺。

translations.literal: Before long he was killed by his attendants Yang Yufu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was killed by his attendants Yang Yufu and others.

sentences.zh: 〈或曰：月犯歲、鎮，金、火入軒轅，皆饉祥也。

translations.literal: 〈Some say: The moon transgressing the Year Star and Quelling Star, and metal and fire entering Chariot Shaft—all are famine omens.
translations.idiomatic: 〈Some say: The moon transgressing Jupiter and Saturn, and Venus and Mars entering Chariot Shaft—all are famine omens.

sentences.zh: 月掩畢，主邊兵。

translations.literal: The moon concealing Net governs frontier armies.
translations.idiomatic: The moon concealing Net governs frontier armies.

sentences.zh: 四年，州鎮十三饑；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, thirteen provincial garrisons suffered famine;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, thirteen provincial garrisons suffered famine;

sentences.zh: 又比歲蝗旱。

translations.literal: And for successive years there were locusts and drought.
translations.idiomatic: And for successive years there were locusts and drought.

sentences.zh: 太和元年，雲中又饑，開倉賑之。

translations.literal: In Taihe year 1, Yunzhong again suffered famine; granaries were opened to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taihe, Yunzhong again suffered famine; granaries were opened to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 先是，四年四月丙午，有大星西流，殷殷有聲；

translations.literal: Previously, in the fourth year, fourth month, day bingwu, a great star flowed westward, rumbling with sound;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the fourth year, in the fourth month, on the day bingwu, a great star flowed westward, rumbling with sound;

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，又如之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day xinwei, it happened again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day xinwei, it happened again.

sentences.zh: 是歲五月，宋桂陽王反于江州，間歲，沈攸之反于江陵，皆為大兵西伐。

translations.literal: That year, fifth month, the Song Prince of Guiyang rebelled at Jiang Province; the year after, Shen Youzhi rebelled at Jiangling—both drew great armies on western campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the fifth month, the Song Prince of Guiyang rebelled at Jiang Province; the year after, Shen Youzhi rebelled at Jiangling—both drew great armies on western campaigns.

sentences.zh: 時以江南內攜，又詔五將伐蜀。〉

translations.literal: At the time, with the lands south of the Yangtze torn by internal strife, an edict also ordered five generals to campaign against Shu.〉
translations.idiomatic: At the time, with the lands south of the Yangtze torn by internal strife, an edict also ordered five generals to campaign against Shu.〉

sentences.zh: 太和元年五月庚子，太白犯熒惑，在張，南國之次也。

translations.literal: In Taihe year 1, fifth month, day gengzi, the Great White transgressed the Sparkling Deluder at Spread—the station of the southern state.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taihe, in the fifth month, on the day gengzi, Venus transgressed Mars at Spread—the station of the southern state.

sentences.zh: 占曰「其國兵喪並興，有軍大戰，人主死」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "That state will see armies and mourning rise together; there will be a great battle; the ruler will die."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "That state will see armies and mourning rise together; there will be a great battle; the ruler will die."

sentences.zh: 壬申，水、土合于翼，皆入太微，主令不行之象也。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, water and earth conjoined at Wings—both entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure—the image of commands not being executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Mercury and Saturn conjoined at Wings—both entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure—the image of commands not being executed.

sentences.zh: 占曰「女主持政，大夫執綱，國且內亂，羣臣相殺」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "A woman sovereign holds power; great officers grasp the cords of rule; the state will soon fall into internal disorder; ministers will slaughter one another."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "A woman sovereign holds power; great officers grasp the cords of rule; the state will soon fall into internal disorder; ministers will slaughter one another."

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，太白晝見，經天，光色尤盛，更姓之祥也。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day dinghai, the Great White was visible during the day crossing the meridian, its light and color exceptionally bright—an omen of changed surname.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day dinghai, Venus was visible during the day as it crossed the meridian, its light and color exceptionally bright—an omen of changed surname.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，火犯鬼。

translations.literal: In the second year, ninth month, fire transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the ninth month, Mars transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰「主以淫泆失政，相死之」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The ruler loses government through debauchery; the minister will die for it."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The ruler loses government through debauchery; the minister will die for it."

sentences.zh: 三年三月，月犯心。

translations.literal: In the third year, third month, the moon transgressed Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the third month, the moon transgressed Heart.

sentences.zh: 心為天王，又宋分。

translations.literal: Heart is the Heavenly King; it is also Song's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Heart is the Heavenly King; it is also Song's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 三月，填星逆行入太微，留左掖門內。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Quelling Star moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace Enclosure, remaining within the Left Rear Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Saturn moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace Enclosure, remaining within the Left Rear Gate.

sentences.zh: 占曰「土守南宮，必有破國易代。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Earth guards the Southern Palace—there will surely be a broken state and change of dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Earth guards the Southern Palace—there will surely be a broken state and change of dynasty.

sentences.zh: 逆行者，事逆也」。

translations.literal: Retrograde motion means events run counter."
translations.idiomatic: Retrograde motion means events run counter."

sentences.zh: 自元年三月至二年六月，月行五犯太微，與劉氏篡晉同占。

translations.literal: From the first year, third month through the second year, sixth month, the moon five times transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure—the same prognostication as when the Liu house usurped Jin.
translations.idiomatic: From the first year, third month through the second year, sixth month, the moon five times transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure—the same prognostication as when the Liu house usurped Jin.

sentences.zh: 又自元年八月至三年五月，月行六犯南斗，入魁中。

translations.literal: Also from the first year, eighth month through the third year, fifth month, the moon six times transgressed the Southern Dipper, entering the Dipper head.
translations.idiomatic: Also from the first year, eighth month through the third year, fifth month, the moon six times transgressed the Southern Dipper, entering the Dipper head.

sentences.zh: 斗為大人壽命，且吳分。

translations.literal: The Dipper is the great person's lifespan; moreover it is Wu's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is the great person's lifespan; moreover it is Wu's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 是時馮太后專政，而宋將蕭道成亦擅威福之權，方圖劉氏。

translations.literal: At this time Empress Dowager Feng monopolized government, while the Song general Xiao Daocheng also arrogated the power of grace and punishment, plotting against the Liu house.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Empress Dowager Feng monopolized government, while the Song general Xiao Daocheng also arrogated the power of grace and punishment, plotting against the Liu house.

sentences.zh: 宋司徒袁粲起兵石頭，沈攸之起兵江陵，將誅之，不克，皆為所殺。

translations.literal: Song Minister over the Masses Yuan Can raised troops at Stone City; Shen Youzhi raised troops at Jiangling—they intended to execute him but failed, and both were killed by him.
translations.idiomatic: Song Minister over the Masses Yuan Can raised troops at Stone City; Shen Youzhi raised troops at Jiangling—they intended to execute him but failed, and both were killed by him.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，竟篡其君而自立，是為齊帝。

translations.literal: In the third year, fourth month, he at last usurped his ruler and installed himself—this was the Qi emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the fourth month, he at last usurped his ruler and installed himself—this was the Qi emperor.

sentences.zh: 是年五月，又害宋君于丹陽宮。

translations.literal: That year, fifth month, he again killed the Song ruler at Danyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the fifth month, he again killed the Song ruler at Danyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 〈又元年十月，月犯昴，為刑獄事。

translations.literal: 〈Also in the first year, tenth month, the moon transgressed Hairy Head—matters of punishment and prisons.
translations.idiomatic: 〈Also in the first year, in the tenth month, the moon transgressed Hairy Head—matters of punishment and prisons.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，月犯房。

translations.literal: In the second year, sixth month, the moon transgressed Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the sixth month, the moon transgressed Chamber.

sentences.zh: 占曰「貴人有誅者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Among nobles there will be those who are executed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Among nobles there will be those who are executed."

sentences.zh: 或曰「月犯斗，亦大臣之謫也」。

translations.literal: Some say: "The moon transgressing the Dipper is likewise the demotion of great ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Some say: "The moon transgressing the Dipper is likewise the demotion of great ministers."

sentences.zh: 其後李惠伏誅，宜都、長樂王並賜死。

translations.literal: Afterward Li Hui was executed at the place of punishment; the Princes of Yidu and Changle were both granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Li Hui was executed; the Princes of Yidu and Changle were both granted death.

sentences.zh: 又元年二月壬戌，月在井，暈參、畢、兩河、五車。

translations.literal: Also in the first year, second month, day renxu, the moon was in the Well, with halos around Shen, Net, the Two Rivers, and the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Also in the first year, in the second month, on the day renxu, the moon was in the Well, with halos around Shen, Net, the Two Rivers, and the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大赦」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great amnesty."

sentences.zh: 至八月，大赦天下。

translations.literal: By the eighth month, a great amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: By the eighth month, a great amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬子，又暈觜、參、昴、畢、五車、東井。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, day renzi, halos again around Turtle Beak, Shen, Hairy Head, Net, the Five Chariots, and the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month, on the day renzi, halos again appeared around Turtle Beak, Shen, Hairy Head, Net, the Five Chariots, and the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 至十月，大赦天下。〉

translations.literal: By the tenth month, a great amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.〉
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month, a great amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.〉

sentences.zh: 三年，自五月至十二月，月三入斗魁中；

translations.literal: In the third year, from the fifth month through the twelfth month, the moon thrice entered the head of the Southern Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, from the fifth month through the twelfth month, the moon thrice entered the head of the Southern Dipper;

sentences.zh: 四年五月庚戌、七月己巳，又如之；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, fifth month day gengxu and seventh month day jisi, it did so again;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the days gengxu of the fifth month and jisi of the seventh month, it did so again;

sentences.zh: 六年二月，又犯斗魁第二星。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, second month, it again transgressed the second star of the Dipper head.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the second month, it again transgressed the second star of the Dipper head.

sentences.zh: 占曰「其國大人憂，不出三年」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "That state's great persons will grieve; within three years."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "That state's great persons will grieve; within three years."

sentences.zh: 七月丁未，十月丙申，月再犯心大星；

translations.literal: In the seventh month day dingwei and tenth month day bingshen, the moon again transgressed the great star of Heart;
translations.idiomatic: On the days dingwei of the seventh month and bingshen of the tenth month, the moon again transgressed the great star of Heart;

sentences.zh: 自四年正月至六年二月，又五干之。

translations.literal: From the fourth year, first month through the sixth year, second month, it assailed it five times more.
translations.idiomatic: From the fourth year, first month through the sixth year, second month, it assailed it five times more.

sentences.zh: 斗為爵祿之柄，心為布政之宮，月行干而轥之，亦以荐矣。

translations.literal: The Dipper is the handle of rank and emolument; Heart is the palace of distributing government—the moon's movement assailing and treading upon it likewise recurred repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is the handle of rank and emolument; Heart is the palace of distributing government—the moon's movement assailing and treading upon it likewise recurred repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 其占曰「月犯心，亂臣在側，有亡君之戒，人主以善事除殃」。

translations.literal: Its prognostication says: "The moon transgressing Heart—rebellious ministers at the ruler's side; warning of a lost ruler; the human sovereign removes calamity through good deeds."
translations.idiomatic: Its prognostication reads: "The moon transgressing Heart—rebellious ministers at the ruler's side; warning of a lost ruler; the sovereign removes calamity through good deeds."

sentences.zh: 是時，馮太后將危少主者數矣，帝春秋方富，而承事孝敬，動無違禮，故竟得無咎。

translations.literal: At this time Empress Dowager Feng several times would have endangered the young ruler; the emperor's years were still abundant, yet in serving her he was filial and reverent, his conduct never violating ritual—thus in the end he escaped blame.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Empress Dowager Feng several times would have endangered the young ruler; the emperor's years were still abundant, yet in serving her he was filial and reverent, his conduct never violating ritual—thus in the end he escaped blame.

sentences.zh: 至六年三月，而齊主殂焉。

translations.literal: By the third month of the sixth year, the Qi ruler died.
translations.idiomatic: By the third month of the sixth year, the Qi ruler died.

sentences.zh: 或曰：月犯斗，其國兵憂。

translations.literal: Some say: The moon transgressing the Dipper means military alarm for that state.
translations.idiomatic: Some say: The moon transgressing the Dipper means military alarm for that state.

sentences.zh: 心又豫州也。

translations.literal: Heart is also Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Heart is also Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 時比歲連兵南討，五年二月大破齊師于淮陽，又擊齊下蔡軍，大敗之。

translations.literal: At that time for successive years armies campaigned south in succession; in the fifth year, second month, they routed Qi forces at Huaiyang, then struck the Qi army at Xiacai and defeated it utterly.
translations.idiomatic: At that time for successive years armies campaigned south in succession; in the fifth year, in the second month, they routed Qi forces at Huaiyang, then struck the Qi army at Xiacai and defeated it utterly.

sentences.zh: 〈先是三年八月，金犯軒轅；

translations.literal: 〈Previously, in the third year, eighth month, metal transgressed Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: 〈Previously, in the third year, in the eighth month, Venus transgressed Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 四年二月，又犯軒轅第二星；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, second month, it again transgressed the second star of Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the second month, it again transgressed the second star of Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 六年正月，又犯軒轅大星；

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month, it again transgressed the great star of Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the first month, it again transgressed the great star of Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 八月，又犯軒轅左角。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, it again transgressed the left horn of Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, it again transgressed the left horn of Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 左角，后宗也。

translations.literal: The Left Horn is the empress dowager's lineage.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Horn is the empress dowager's lineage.

sentences.zh: 是時太后淫亂，而幽后之姪娣，又將薄德。

translations.literal: At that time the empress dowager was licentious, and the niece and younger sister of Empress You would likewise prove wanting in virtue.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the empress dowager was licentious, and the niece and younger sister of Empress You would likewise prove wanting in virtue.

sentences.zh: 天若言曰：是無周南之風，不足訓也，故月、太白驟于之。〉

translations.literal: Heaven seemed to say: This is devoid of the ethos of Zhou Nan—not worth taking as instruction—thus the moon and the Great White repeatedly hastened to it.〉
translations.idiomatic: Heaven seemed to say: This is devoid of the ethos of Zhou Nan—not worth taking as instruction—thus the moon and Venus repeatedly hastened to it.〉

sentences.zh: 三年九月庚子，太白犯左執法；

translations.literal: In the third year, ninth month, day gengzi, the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the ninth month, on the day gengzi, Venus transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，月犯之；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day bingxu, the moon transgressed it;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day bingxu, the moon transgressed it;

sentences.zh: [30]四年二月辛巳，[31]月又犯之；

translations.literal: [30] In the fourth year, second month, day xinsi, [31] the moon again transgressed it;
translations.idiomatic: [30] In the fourth year, in the second month, on the day xinsi, [31] the moon again transgressed it;

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，太白又犯之；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day renxu, the Great White again transgressed it;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, Venus again transgressed it;

sentences.zh: 五年二月癸卯，月犯太微西蕃上將；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, second month, day guimao, the moon transgressed the senior general of the western enclosure of the Supreme Palace;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the second month, on the day guimao, the moon transgressed the senior general of the western enclosure of the Supreme Palace;

sentences.zh: 至六年十月乙酉，熒惑又犯之。

translations.literal: By the sixth year, tenth month, day yiyou, the Sparkling Deluder again transgressed it.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth year, in the tenth month, on the day yiyou, Mars again transgressed it.

sentences.zh: 夫南宮執法，所以糾淫忒，成肅雍；

translations.literal: The Enforcement Officer of the Southern Palace exists to correct debauchery and bring about solemn harmony;
translations.idiomatic: The Enforcement Officer of the Southern Palace exists to correct debauchery and bring about solemn harmony;

sentences.zh: 而上將朝庭之輔也。

translations.literal: while the Senior General is the court's support.
translations.idiomatic: while the Senior General is the court's support.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：王化將㢮，淫風幾興，固不足以令天下矣，而廷臣莫之糾弼，安用之！

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Royal civilization is about to collapse; licentious winds are nearly rising—it plainly cannot command all under Heaven—yet court ministers do not correct and assist; of what use are they!
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that royal civilization was about to collapse, licentious winds were nearly rising—it plainly could not command all under Heaven—yet court ministers did not correct and assist; of what use were they!

sentences.zh: 文明太后雖獨厚幸臣，而公卿坐受榮賜者費亦巨億，蓋近乎素餐焉。

translations.literal: Although Empress Dowager Wenming alone favored her cherished ministers, the ministers and nobles who sat receiving honors and gifts also spent sums reaching hundreds of millions—nearly approaching eating salary without working.
translations.idiomatic: Although Empress Dowager Wenming alone lavished favor on her cherished ministers, the ministers and nobles who merely sat receiving honors and gifts also consumed sums reaching hundreds of millions—nearly holding office in name alone.

sentences.zh: 其三年九月，安樂王長樂下獄死，隴西王源賀薨；

translations.literal: In the third year, ninth month, the Prince of Anle Chang Le died in prison; Yuan He, Prince of Longxi, passed away;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the ninth month, the Prince of Anle Chang Le died in prison; Yuan He, Prince of Longxi, passed away;

sentences.zh: 四年正月，廣川王略薨，襄城王韓頹徙邊；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month, the Prince of Guangchuan Lue passed away; Han Tui, Prince of Xiangcheng, was banished to the frontier;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first month, the Prince of Guangchuan Lue passed away; Han Tui, Prince of Xiangcheng, was banished to the frontier;

sentences.zh: 七月，頓丘王李鍾葵賜死；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Li Zhongkui, Prince of Dunqiu, was ordered to die;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Li Zhongkui, Prince of Dunqiu, was ordered to take his own life;

sentences.zh: 其後任城王雲、中山王叡又薨。

translations.literal: Afterward the Prince of Rencheng Yun and the Prince of Zhongshan Rui also passed away.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the Prince of Rencheng Yun and the Prince of Zhongshan Rui also passed away.

sentences.zh: 比年死黜相繼，蓋天謫存焉。

translations.literal: In successive years deaths and dismissals followed one after another—surely Heaven's rebuke was at work.
translations.idiomatic: Year after year deaths and dismissals followed in succession—surely Heaven's rebuke was manifest.

sentences.zh: 〈四年春月，又掩火，亦大臣死黜之祥也。

translations.literal: 〈In the spring month of the fourth year, Mars was again concealed—likewise an omen of ministers dying and being dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the spring month of the fourth year, Mars was again concealed—likewise an omen of ministers dying and being dismissed.

sentences.zh: 又比年，月再犯昴，亦為獄事與白衣之會也。〉

translations.literal: Also in successive years the moon twice transgressed Hairy Head—again signifying prison affairs and the white-robed assembly.〉
translations.idiomatic: Also in successive years the moon twice transgressed Hairy Head—again signifying prison affairs and the white-robed assembly.〉

sentences.zh: 五年九月辛巳，填犯辰星于軫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, ninth month, day xinsi, Saturn transgressed Mercury at Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the ninth month, on the day xinsi, Saturn transgressed Mercury at Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 占曰「為饑，為內亂，且有壅川溢水之變」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be famine and internal disorder, and moreover changes of rivers blocked and waters overflowing."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be famine and internal disorder, and moreover changes of rivers blocked and waters overflowing."

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師大霖雨，州鎮十二饑。

translations.literal: That year the capital saw great torrential rains; twelve provinces and garrisons suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital saw torrential rains; twelve provinces and garrisons suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 至六年七月丙申，又大流星起東壁，光明燭地，尾長二丈餘。

translations.literal: By the sixth year, seventh month, day bingshen, a great meteor again rose from Eastern Wall, its light illuminating the ground, its tail more than two zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth year, in the seventh month, on the day bingshen, a great meteor again rose from Eastern Wall, its light illuminating the ground, its tail more than two zhang long.

sentences.zh: 東壁，土功之政也。

translations.literal: Eastern Wall is the administration of earthworks.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wall governs earthworks and public construction.

sentences.zh: 是月發卒五萬，通靈丘道。

translations.literal: That month fifty thousand conscript laborers were dispatched to open the Lingqiu Road.
translations.idiomatic: That month fifty thousand conscript laborers were dispatched to open the Lingqiu Road.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉，有流星入翼，尾長五丈餘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day jiyou, a meteor entered Wings, its tail more than five zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day jiyou, a meteor entered Wings, its tail more than five zhang long.

sentences.zh: 七星，中州之羽儀；

translations.literal: Seven Stars is the ceremonial regalia of the central provinces;
translations.idiomatic: Seven Stars is the ceremonial regalia of the central provinces;

sentences.zh: 翼，南國也。

translations.literal: Wings is the southern state.
translations.idiomatic: Wings is the southern state.

sentences.zh: 天象若曰：將擇文明之士，使于楚邦焉。

translations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Worthies of cultivation and refinement will be chosen and sent as envoys to the state of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare: Cultivated worthies would be chosen and sent as envoys to the state of Chu.

sentences.zh: 明年，員外散騎常侍李彪使齊，始通二國之好焉。

translations.literal: The next year Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Li Biao was sent as envoy to Qi, and friendly relations between the two states were first established.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Li Biao was sent as envoy to Qi, and friendly relations between the two states were first established.

sentences.zh: 〈四年正月丁未，月在畢，暈參、井、五車，赦祥也。

translations.literal: 〈In the fourth year, first month, day dingwei, the moon was at Net, with halos around Three Stars, the Well, and the Five Chariots—an omen of amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the fourth year, in the first month, on the day dingwei, the moon was at Net, with halos around Three Stars, the Well, and the Five Chariots—an omen of amnesty.

sentences.zh: 四月，幸廷尉獄，錄囚徒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the emperor visited the Minister of Justice's prison and reviewed the convicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the emperor visited the Minister of Justice's prison and reviewed the convicts.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，大赦。

translations.literal: In the second month of the next year a great amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the next year a great amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 是月，月在翼，有偏日暈，[32]侵五車、東井、軒轅、北河、鬼，至北斗、紫垣、攝提。

translations.literal: That month the moon was at Wings; there was a partial solar halo, [32] encroaching upon the Five Chariots, Eastern Well, Chariot Shaft, North River, and Ghost, reaching the Northern Dipper, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and Sieve.
translations.idiomatic: That month the moon was at Wings; there was a partial solar halo, [32] encroaching upon the Five Chariots, Eastern Well, Chariot Shaft, North River, and Ghost, reaching the Northern Dipper, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and Sieve.

sentences.zh: 六年正月癸亥，月在畢，暈參兩肩、五車、胃、昴、畢。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month, day guihai, the moon was at Net, with halos around the two shoulders of Three Stars, the Five Chariots, Stomach, Hairy Head, and Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the first month, on the day guihai, the moon was at Net, with halos around the two shoulders of Three Stars, the Five Chariots, Stomach, Hairy Head, and Net.

sentences.zh: 至甲戌，天下大赦。

translations.literal: By the day jiaxu a great amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: By the day jiaxu a great amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 江南嗣君即位，亦大赦改元。〉

translations.literal: The successor ruler south of the Yangtze also ascended the throne, granting a great amnesty and changing the reign title.〉
translations.idiomatic: The successor ruler south of the Yangtze also ascended the throne, granting a great amnesty and changing the reign title.〉

sentences.zh: 七年六月庚午辰時，東北有流星一，大如太白，北流破為三段。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, sixth month, day gengwu at the chen hour, in the northeast there was one meteor, as large as Venus, streaming northward and breaking into three segments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, in the sixth month, on the day gengwu at the chen hour, in the northeast there was one meteor, as large as Venus, streaming northward and breaking into three segments.

sentences.zh: 十月己亥，星隕如虹。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day jihai, stars fell like a rainbow.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day jihai, stars fell like a rainbow.

sentences.zh: 是時，太后專朝，且多外嬖，雖天子由倚附之，故有干明之謫焉。

translations.literal: At this time the empress dowager monopolized the court and had many outside favorites; though the Son of Heaven still relied upon her, therefore there was the punishment of assaulting the ruler's light.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the empress dowager monopolized the court and kept many outside favorites; though the Son of Heaven still relied upon her, there was the punishment of assaulting the ruler's light.

sentences.zh: 破而為三，席勢者眾也。

translations.literal: Breaking into three means those who rely on power are many.
translations.idiomatic: Breaking into three means those who rely on power are many.

sentences.zh: 昔春秋星隕如雨，而羣陰起霸。

translations.literal: In antiquity during the Spring and Autumn period stars fell like rain, and the multitude of yin forces rose to hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity during the Spring and Autumn period stars fell like rain, and the multitude of yin forces rose to hegemony.

sentences.zh: 其後漢成帝時，旰日晦冥，眾星行隕，燿燿如雨，而王氏之禍萌。

translations.literal: Afterward in the time of Emperor Cheng of Han, at midday the sky grew dark, many stars moved and fell, blazing like rain—and the calamity of the Wang clan sprouted.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward in the time of Emperor Cheng of Han, at midday the sky grew dark, many stars moved and fell, blazing like rain—and the calamity of the Wang clan sprouted.

sentences.zh: 至是天妖復見，又與元后同符矣。

translations.literal: Now the celestial prodigy appeared again, matching the omen of the Primary Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Now the celestial prodigy appeared again, matching the omen of Empress Yuan.

sentences.zh: 十年八月辰時，有星落如流火三道；

translations.literal: In the tenth year, eighth month at the chen hour, stars fell like three streaks of flowing fire;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the eighth month at the chen hour, stars fell like three streaks of flowing fire;

sentences.zh: 戊寅，又有流星出日西南一丈所，西北流，大如太白，至午西破為二段，尾長五尺，復分為二，入雲間。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, another meteor emerged about one zhang southwest of the sun, streaming northwest, as large as Venus; by noon in the west it broke into two segments, its tail five chi long, then split again into two and entered the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, another meteor emerged about one zhang southwest of the sun, streaming northwest, as large as Venus; by noon in the west it broke into two segments, its tail five chi long, then split again into two and entered the clouds.

sentences.zh: 仍見者，事荐也，後代其踵而行之，以至於分崩離析乎？

translations.literal: When it appears again, affairs recur; will later ages follow in its footsteps, until disintegration and collapse?
translations.idiomatic: When it appears again, affairs recur; will later ages follow in its footsteps, until disintegration and collapse?

sentences.zh: 先是，七年十月，有客星大如斗，在參東，似孛。

translations.literal: Previously, in the seventh year, tenth month, there was a guest star as large as the Dipper, east of Three Stars, resembling a broom star.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the seventh year, in the tenth month, there was a guest star as large as the Dipper, east of Three Stars, resembling a broom star.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大臣有執主之命者，且歲旱糴貴」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "A great minister will usurp his lord's command, and moreover the year will be drought-stricken with grain dear."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "A great minister will usurp his lord's command, and moreover the year will be drought-stricken with grain dear."

sentences.zh: 十年九月，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, ninth month, Mars transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the ninth month, Mars transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 歲主農事，火星以亂氣干之，五稼旱傷之象也。

translations.literal: Jupiter governs agricultural affairs; Mars with its disorderly qi assails it—the image of the five grains stricken by drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter governs agricultural affairs; Mars with its disorderly qi assails it—the image of the five grains stricken by drought.

sentences.zh: 占曰「元陽以饉，[33]人不安」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The primal yang is exhausted by famine, [33] and the people are unsettled."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The primal yang is exhausted by famine, [33] and the people are unsettled."

sentences.zh: 自八年至十一年，黎人阻饑，且仍歲災旱。

translations.literal: From the eighth year through the eleventh year the common people were beset by famine, and year after year disaster and drought continued.
translations.idiomatic: From the eighth year through the eleventh year the common people were beset by famine, and year after year disaster and drought continued.

sentences.zh: 〈八年正月辛巳，月在畢，暈井、歲星、觜、參、五車。

translations.literal: 〈In the eighth year, first month, day xinsi, the moon was at Net, with halos around the Well, Jupiter, Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the eighth year, in the first month, on the day xinsi, the moon was at Net, with halos around the Well, Jupiter, Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有赦，糴貴」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be an amnesty, and grain will be dear."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be an amnesty, and grain will be dear."

sentences.zh: 其年六月，大赦。

translations.literal: That year, sixth month, a great amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the sixth month, a great amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 冬，州鎮十五水旱，人饑。

translations.literal: In winter fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; the people went hungry.
translations.idiomatic: In winter fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; the people went hungry.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，月在參，暈觜、參兩肩、五車，為大赦，為水。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, first month, the moon was at Three Stars, with halos around Turtle Beak, the two shoulders of Three Stars, and the Five Chariots—signifying great amnesty and water.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first month, the moon was at Three Stars, with halos around Turtle Beak, the two shoulders of Three Stars, and the Five Chariots—signifying great amnesty and water.

sentences.zh: 戊申，月犯井，為水祥也。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the moon transgressed the Well—an omen of water.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen the moon transgressed the Well—an omen of water.

sentences.zh: 是歲，冀定數州大水，人有鬻男女者，京師及州鎮十三水旱傷稼。

translations.literal: That year several prefectures in Ji and Ding suffered great floods; people sold sons and daughters; the capital and thirteen provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: That year several prefectures in Ji and Ding suffered great floods; people sold sons and daughters; the capital and thirteen provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought damaging the crops.

sentences.zh: 明年，大赦。〉

translations.literal: The next year a great amnesty was granted.〉
translations.idiomatic: The next year a great amnesty was granted.〉

sentences.zh: 十一年三月丁亥，火、土合于南斗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, third month, day dinghai, Mars and Saturn conjoined at the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the day dinghai, Mars and Saturn conjoined at the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 填為履霜之漸，斗為經始之謀，而天視由之，所以為大人之戒也。

translations.literal: Saturn is the gradual tread upon frost; the Dipper is the founding plans—and Heaven's regard proceeds through them; this is why they serve as a warning to great persons.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn is the gradual tread upon frost; the Dipper is the founding plans—and Heaven's regard proceeds through them; this is why they serve as a warning to great persons.

sentences.zh: 占曰「其國內亂，不可舉事用兵」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "That state will have internal disorder; one must not undertake affairs or deploy armies."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "That state will have internal disorder; one must not undertake affairs or deploy armies."

sentences.zh: 是時齊主持諸侯王酷甚，雖酒食之饋，猶裁之有司。

translations.literal: At this time the Qi ruler treated the feudal princes with extreme harshness; even gifts of food and drink were trimmed by officials.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Qi ruler treated the feudal princes with extreme harshness; even gifts of food and drink were rationed by officials.

sentences.zh: 故天若言曰：非所以保根固本，以貽長代之謀也，內亂由是興焉。

translations.literal: Therefore Heaven seemed to say: This is not the way to preserve roots and strengthen the foundation, to bequeath plans for long generations—internal disorder arose from this.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Heaven seemed to say: This is not the way to preserve roots and strengthen the foundation, to bequeath plans for long generations—internal disorder arose from this.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，太白經天，晝見，庚子遂犯畢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day dingyou, Venus crossed the meridian and was visible during the day; on the day gengzi it then transgressed Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day dingyou, Venus crossed the meridian and was visible during the day; on the day gengzi it then transgressed Net.

sentences.zh: 畢又邊兵也。

translations.literal: Net also governs frontier armies.
translations.idiomatic: Net also governs frontier armies.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕寇邊。

translations.literal: That year the Rouran raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Rouran raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 明年，齊將陳達伐我南鄙，陷澧陽。

translations.literal: The next year the Qi general Chen Da attacked our southern frontier and captured Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Qi general Chen Da attacked our southern frontier and captured Liyang.

sentences.zh: 間歲而齊君子子響為有司所御，遂憤怒而反，伏誅。

translations.literal: A year later the Qi noble's son Zi Xiang was resisted by officials; enraged, he rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the Qi noble's son Zi Xiang was resisted by officials; enraged, he rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 及齊主殂而西昌侯篡之，高、武子孫所在棊布，皆拱手就戮，亦齊君自為之焉。

translations.literal: When the Qi ruler died the Marquis of Xichang usurped the throne; descendants of the Gao and Wu clans were scattered everywhere like chess pieces, all going to slaughter with hands folded—it was the Qi ruler's own doing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qi ruler died the Marquis of Xichang usurped the throne; descendants of the Gao and Wu clans were scattered everywhere like chess pieces, all going submissively to slaughter—it was the Qi ruler's own doing.

sentences.zh: 〈十一年六月乙丑，月犯斗；

translations.literal: 〈In the eleventh year, sixth month, day yichou, the moon transgressed the Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: 〈In the eleventh year, in the sixth month, on the day yichou, the moon transgressed the Dipper;

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遂犯建星。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin it then transgressed Establishment.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin it then transgressed Establishment.

sentences.zh: 亦圖始之謀也。

translations.literal: This too is the planning of founding beginnings.
translations.idiomatic: This too is the planning of founding beginnings.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月，月犯牛；

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, seventh month, the moon transgressed Ox;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the seventh month, the moon transgressed Ox;

sentences.zh: 十三年六月，又掩之；

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, sixth month, it concealed it again;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, in the sixth month, it concealed it again;

sentences.zh: 明年八月，又犯之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the next year it transgressed it again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the next year it transgressed it again.

sentences.zh: 牛主吳分。

translations.literal: Ox governs Wu's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Ox governs Wu's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 占曰「國有憂，大將戮」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The state will have grief; a great general will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state will have grief; a great general will be executed."

sentences.zh: 亦江南兵饉之徵也。〉

translations.literal: It is also a sign of armies and famine south of the Yangtze.〉
translations.idiomatic: It is also a sign of armies and famine south of the Yangtze.〉

sentences.zh: 七月癸丑，太白犯軒轅大星；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day guichou, Venus transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day guichou, Venus transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft;

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，又犯之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day jiayin, it transgressed it again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jiayin, it transgressed it again.

sentences.zh: 皆女君之謫也，天象若曰：軒轅以母萬物，由后妃之母兆人也，是固多穢，復將安用之？

translations.literal: All were punishments upon the female sovereign; the celestial signs seemed to say: Chariot Shaft nurtures the myriad things—through empress and consorts it nurtures the people; there is indeed much filth—how then will it be put to use?
translations.idiomatic: All were punishments upon the female sovereign; the heavens seemed to declare: Chariot Shaft nurtures the myriad things—through empress and consorts it nurtures the people; there is indeed much filth—how then will it be put to use?

sentences.zh: 其物類之感，又稼穡之不滋候也。

translations.literal: Its resonance with things and species is again the sign that grain crops will not flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Its resonance with things and species is again the sign that grain crops will not flourish.

sentences.zh: 是歲年穀不登，聽人出關就食。

translations.literal: That year the year's grain did not ripen; people were permitted to leave the passes to seek food.
translations.idiomatic: That year the harvest failed; people were permitted to leave the passes to seek food.

sentences.zh: 明年，州鎮十五皆大饑，詔開倉賑乏。

translations.literal: The next year fifteen provinces and garrisons all suffered great famine; an edict opened the granaries to relieve the destitute.
translations.idiomatic: The next year fifteen provinces and garrisons all suffered great famine; an edict opened the granaries to relieve the destitute.

sentences.zh: 間歲，太后崩。

translations.literal: A year later the empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲月三入井，金又犯之。

translations.literal: 〈That year the moon thrice entered the Well, and Venus again transgressed it.
translations.idiomatic: 〈That year the moon thrice entered the Well, and Venus again transgressed it.

sentences.zh: 占曰「陰陽不和，不為水患且大旱」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Yin and yang are not in harmony—not water calamity but great drought."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Yin and yang are not in harmony—not water calamity but great drought."

sentences.zh: 其後連年亢陽，而吳中比歲霖雨傷稼也。〉

translations.literal: Afterward drought continued year after year, while in Wu torrential rains year after year damaged the crops.〉
translations.idiomatic: Afterward drought continued year after year, while in Wu torrential rains year after year damaged the crops.〉

sentences.zh: 十二年三月甲申，歲星逆行入氐。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, third month, day jiashen, Jupiter moved retrograde and entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the third month, on the day jiashen, Jupiter moved retrograde and entered Di.

sentences.zh: 甲、申，皆齊分也。

translations.literal: Jia and shen are both Qi's allotted regions.
translations.idiomatic: Jia and shen are both Qi's allotted regions.

sentences.zh: 占曰「諸侯王而升為天子者」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "A feudal prince who ascends to become Son of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "A feudal prince who ascends to become Son of Heaven."

sentences.zh: 逆行者，其事逆也。

translations.literal: Retrograde motion means the affair runs counter.
translations.idiomatic: Retrograde motion means the affair runs counter.

sentences.zh: 先是，去年十月，歲、辰、太白合于氐。

translations.literal: Previously, in the tenth month of the previous year, Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus conjoined at Di.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the tenth month of the previous year, Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus conjoined at Di.

sentences.zh: 是謂驚立絕行，[34]改立王公。

translations.literal: This is called startled establishment and severed course, [34] changing and installing kings and dukes.
translations.idiomatic: This is called startled establishment and severed course, [34] changing and installing kings and dukes.

sentences.zh: 是歲四月，月犯氐，與歲同舍；

translations.literal: That year, fourth month, the moon transgressed Di and shared the same lodging with Jupiter;
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the fourth month, the moon transgressed Di and shared the same lodging with Jupiter;

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，月又入氐，犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day dingsi, the moon again entered Di and transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day dingsi, the moon again entered Di and transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 月為強大之臣，歲為少君也，與歲同心內宮而干犯之，強宗擅命，逼奪其君之象也。

translations.literal: The moon is the powerful minister; Jupiter is the young ruler; sharing the same intent within the inner palace yet assailing and transgressing it—the image of a powerful clan arrogating command and forcing its lord aside.
translations.idiomatic: The moon is the powerful minister; Jupiter is the young ruler; sharing the same intent within the inner palace yet assailing and transgressing it—the image of a powerful clan arrogating command and forcing its lord aside.

sentences.zh: 再干之，其事荐至。

translations.literal: Assailing it twice—the affair recurred repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Assailing it twice—the affair recurred repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月癸丑，月、火、金會于井；

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, fourth month, day guichou, the moon, Mars, and Venus gathered at the Well;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the fourth month, on the day guichou, the moon, Mars, and Venus gathered at the Well;

sentences.zh: 辛酉，金犯火；

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Venus transgressed Mars;
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou Venus transgressed Mars;

sentences.zh: 甲戌，火、水又俱入井。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Mars and Mercury both entered the Well again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Mars and Mercury both entered the Well again.

sentences.zh: 皆雨暘失節，萬物不成候也。

translations.literal: All are signs that rain and sunshine are out of season and the myriad things will not come to fruition.
translations.idiomatic: All are signs that rain and sunshine are out of season and the myriad things will not come to fruition.

sentences.zh: 且曰王業將易，諸侯貴人多死。

translations.literal: Moreover it signifies that royal enterprise will change hands, and many among the feudal lords and nobles will die.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover it signifies that royal enterprise will change hands, and many among the feudal lords and nobles will die.

sentences.zh: 是歲，月行四入氐；

translations.literal: That year the moon's course four times entered Di;
translations.idiomatic: That year the moon's course four times entered Di;

sentences.zh: 十月，辰星入之；

translations.literal: In the tenth month Mercury entered it;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Mercury entered it;

sentences.zh: 閏月丁丑，火犯氐；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, day dingchou, Mars transgressed Di;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the day dingchou, Mars transgressed Di;

sentences.zh: 乙卯，又入之。

translations.literal: On the day yimao it entered again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao it entered again.

sentences.zh: 占曰「大旱歲荒，人且相食，國易政，君失宮，遠期五年」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great drought and year of famine; people will even devour one another; the state will change its government; the ruler will lose his palace—within five years in the distant future."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great drought and year of famine; people will even devour one another; the state will change its government; the ruler will lose his palace—within five years in the distant future."

sentences.zh: 氐，又女君之府也。

translations.literal: Di is also the palace of the lady ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Di is also the lodging of the lady sovereign.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩雍及豫州旱饑。

translations.literal: That year both Yong provinces and Yuzhou suffered drought and famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year both Yong provinces and Yuzhou suffered drought and famine.

sentences.zh: 明年，州鎮十五大饉。

translations.literal: The following year fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: The following year fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 至十四年，太后崩。

translations.literal: By the fourteenth year the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: By the fourteenth year the Empress Dowager passed away.

sentences.zh: 時江南北連歲災雨，至十七年，有劫殺之禍，誅死相踵焉。

translations.literal: At this time south of the Yangtze suffered disaster rains year after year; by the seventeenth year there came the calamity of pillage and killing, and executions followed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the lands south of the Yangtze suffered disastrous rains year after year; by the seventeenth year the calamity of pillage and slaughter arrived, and executions followed in succession.

sentences.zh: 〈是歲月三犯房；

translations.literal: 〈That year the moon thrice transgressed Fang;
translations.idiomatic: 〈That year the moon thrice transgressed Fang;

sentences.zh: 十三年四月，又犯之；

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, fourth month, it transgressed it again;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, in the fourth month, it transgressed it again;

sentences.zh: 七月至十月，再犯鍵閉。

translations.literal: From the seventh month to the tenth month it twice transgressed Key and Lock.
translations.idiomatic: From the seventh month through the tenth month it twice transgressed Key and Lock.

sentences.zh: 占曰「有亂臣，不出三年伐其主」。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be rebellious ministers; within three years they will attack their ruler."
