translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be rebellious ministers; within three years they will attack their lord."

sentences.zh: 自十二年七月至十四年八月，月再犯牛，又再掩之，凡六犯牛且掩之。

translations.literal: From the seventh month of the twelfth year through the eighth month of the fourteenth year, the moon twice transgressed Ox and twice concealed it—in all six transgressions and concealments of Ox.
translations.idiomatic: From the seventh month of the twelfth year through the eighth month of the fourteenth year, the moon twice transgressed Ox and twice concealed it—in all six transgressions and concealments of Ox.

sentences.zh: 牛為吳越，饉祥也，畢，魏分。

translations.literal: Ox corresponds to Wu and Yue; it is a famine omen; Net is Wei's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Ox corresponds to Wu and Yue—it is a famine omen; Net is Wei's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 且曰貴人多死免者。

translations.literal: Moreover it signifies that many nobles will die or be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover it signifies that many among the nobility will die or be removed from office.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月，司徒、淮南王他薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, ninth month, the Minister Over the Masses, the Prince of Huainan Ta, passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the ninth month, the Minister Over the Masses, Prince of Huainan Ta, passed away.

sentences.zh: 十三年，光州人王泰反，章武、汝陰、南安三王皆坐贓廢，安豐王猛、司空荀頹並薨。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Wang Tai of Guangzhou rebelled; the three princes of Zhangwu, Ruyin, and Nan'an were all dismissed for corruption; the Prince of Anfeng Meng and Minister of Works Xun Tui both passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Wang Tai of Guangzhou rebelled; the princes of Zhangwu, Ruyin, and Nan'an were all deposed for corruption; Prince Anfeng Meng and Minister of Works Xun Tui both passed away.

sentences.zh: 十四年，地豆于及庫莫奚頻犯塞，京兆王廢為庶人。〉

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Didouyu and Kumo Xi repeatedly violated the frontier; the Prince of Jingzhao was deposed as a commoner.〉
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the Didouyu and Kumo Xi repeatedly raided the frontier passes; the Prince of Jingzhao was degraded to commoner status.〉

translations.idiomatic: Textual notes

sentences.zh: 〈殿本入考證〉

translations.literal: 〈Entered under textual verification in the Palace Edition〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Entered under textual verification in the Palace Edition〉

sentences.zh: 「魏收書天象志第一卷載天及日變，第二卷載月變，第三、第四卷應載星變。

translations.literal: "Wei Shou's text: Celestial Phenomena Treatise juan 1 records changes of heaven and the sun; juan 2 records lunar changes; juan 3 and juan 4 should record stellar changes.
translations.idiomatic: "Wei Shou's original: Celestial Phenomena Treatise juan 1 records changes of heaven and the sun; juan 2 records lunar changes; juan 3 and juan 4 should record stellar changes.

sentences.zh: 今此二卷，天、日、月、星變編年總繫魏及南朝禍咎。

translations.literal: Now these two juan chronologically tie together changes of heaven, sun, moon, and stars with calamities of Wei and the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: These two scrolls now chronologically tie together changes of heaven, sun, moon, and stars with calamities afflicting Wei and the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 蓋魏收志第三、第四卷亡，後人取他人所撰志補足之。

translations.literal: Presumably juan 3 and juan 4 of Wei Shou's treatise are lost; later persons took treatises written by others to fill the gap.
translations.idiomatic: Presumably juan 3 and juan 4 of Wei Shou's treatise are lost; later hands supplemented the lacuna with treatises written by others.

sentences.zh: 魏澹書世已無本，據目錄作西魏帝紀，而元善見、司馬昌明、劉裕、蕭道成皆入列傳。

translations.literal: Wei Dan's Book of Wei no longer survives; according to its table of contents it placed the Western Wei emperors in annals, yet Yuan Shanjian, Sima Changming, Liu Yu, and Xiao Daocheng all appear in biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Dan's Book of Wei no longer survives; according to its table of contents it placed the Western Wei emperors in annals, yet Yuan Shanjian, Sima Changming, Liu Yu, and Xiao Daocheng all appear in biographies.

sentences.zh: 此志主東魏，而晉、宋、齊、梁君皆稱帝號，亦非魏澹書明矣。

translations.literal: This treatise chiefly concerns Eastern Wei, yet rulers of Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang are all addressed by imperial titles—this plainly is not Wei Dan's text either.
translations.idiomatic: This treatise chiefly concerns Eastern Wei, yet rulers of Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang are all addressed by imperial titles—this plainly is not Wei Dan's text either.

sentences.zh: 唐書經籍志有張太素魏書一百卷，故世人疑此二卷為太素書志。

translations.literal: The Jingji zhi of the Tang Annals lists Zhang Taisu's Book of Wei in one hundred juan; hence people suspect these two juan are Zhang Taisu's treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The bibliographic treatise of the Tang Annals lists Zhang Taisu's Book of Wei in one hundred juan; hence scholars suspect these two scrolls are Zhang Taisu's astronomical treatise.

sentences.zh: 崇文總目有張太素魏書天文志二卷，今亦亡矣。

translations.literal: The Chongwen zongmu lists Zhang Taisu's Astronomical Treatise of the Book of Wei in two juan—it too is now lost.
translations.idiomatic: The Chongwen zongmu lists Zhang Taisu's Astronomical Treatise of the Book of Wei in two juan—it too is now lost.

sentences.zh: 惟昭文館有史館舊本魏書志第三卷，前題朝議郎、行著作郎修國史張太素撰。

translations.literal: Only the Zhao Library held an old History Bureau copy of Book of Wei Treatise juan 3, prefaced: "Composed by Court Gentleman for Consultation, Acting Author at the Bureau of Authorship revising national history, Zhang Taisu."
translations.idiomatic: Only the Zhao Library held an old History Bureau copy of Book of Wei Treatise juan 3, prefaced: "Composed by Court Gentleman for Consultation, Acting Author at the Bureau of Authorship revising national history, Zhang Taisu."

sentences.zh: 太素唐人，故諱『世』『民』等字。」

translations.literal: Taisu was a Tang man; hence he tabooed characters such as "shi" and "min."
translations.idiomatic: Taisu was a Tang author; hence he observed taboo against characters such as shi and min.

sentences.zh: 按天象志三及四非魏書原文甚明，其中記月變即採志二所載，記星變似兼採已亡之魏書志三、四和宋書天文志。

translations.literal: Examining: Celestial Phenomena Treatises 3 and 4 are plainly not original Book of Wei text; the lunar changes recorded therein are drawn from what Treatise 2 contains, while the stellar changes seem drawn both from the lost Book of Wei treatises 3 and 4 and from the Astronomical Treatise of the Song Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the matter: Celestial Phenomena Treatises 3 and 4 are plainly not original Book of Wei text; the lunar changes recorded therein are taken from Treatise 2, while the stellar changes seem drawn both from the lost Book of Wei treatises 3 and 4 and from the Astronomical Treatise of the Song Annals.

sentences.zh: 元年十月至二年五月月再掩東蕃上相 按志二天興元年十一月丁丑，月掩東上相。

translations.literal: From the tenth month of year 1 through the fifth month of year 2 the moon twice concealed the prime minister of the eastern enclosure — Examining Treatise 2: in Tianxing year 1, eleventh month, day dingchou, the moon concealed the eastern prime minister.
translations.idiomatic: From the tenth month of year 1 through the fifth month of year 2 the moon twice concealed the prime minister of the eastern enclosure — Treatise 2 records that in Tianxing first year, eleventh month, day dingchou, the moon concealed the eastern prime minister.

sentences.zh: 這裏「十」下當脫「一」字。

translations.literal: Here under "ten" the character "one" must be missing.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character "one" is missing after "ten."

sentences.zh: 是歲秀容胡帥亦聚眾反 諸本「帥」訛「師」，今據志二天興四年三月甲子條改。

translations.literal: That year a Xiurong chieftain also gathered followers in rebellion — In various editions "commander" is written erroneously as "master"; now emended according to Treatise 2, Tianxing year 4, third month, day jiazi entry.
translations.idiomatic: That year a Xiurong chieftain also gathered followers in rebellion — in various editions shuai (commander) is written erroneously as shi (master); emended according to Treatise 2, Tianxing fourth year, third month, day jiazi entry.

sentences.zh: 又「是歲」承上文是四年，據志二事在五年十一月。

translations.literal: Also, "that year" continues from above as the fourth year; according to Treatise 2 the event was in the eleventh month of the fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: Also, "that year" continues from above as the fourth year; according to Treatise 2 the event occurred in the eleventh month of the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 二年八月火犯斗丁亥又犯建 按天賜二年八月庚戌朔，無丁亥。

translations.literal: Second year, eighth month, fire transgressed Dipper; on dinghai it again transgressed Establishment — Examining: in Tianci year 2, eighth month, the first day gengxu, there is no dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, eighth month, Mars transgressed Dipper; on dinghai it again transgressed Establishment — in Tianci second year, eighth month, the first day is gengxu; there is no dinghai.

sentences.zh: 宋志是年不載，而次年

translations.literal: The Song Annals does not record this for that year, but the following year
translations.idiomatic: The Song Annals does not record this for that year, but the following year

sentences.zh: 〈義熙二年，即魏天賜三年〉

translations.literal: 〈Yixi year 2, which is Wei Tianci year 3〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Yixi year 2, which is Wei Tianci year 3〉

sentences.zh: 記八月癸亥，熒惑犯斗第五星；

translations.literal: records: eighth month, day guihai, Mars transgressed the fifth star of Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: records that in the eighth month, on the day guihai, Mars transgressed the fifth star of Dipper;

sentences.zh: 丁巳，犯建星。

translations.literal: On dingsi it transgressed Establishment star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi it transgressed Establishment star.

sentences.zh: 是年八月甲辰朔，丁巳是十四日。

translations.literal: That year the eighth month began on jiachen; dingsi was the fourteenth day.
translations.idiomatic: That year the eighth month began on jiachen; dingsi was the fourteenth day.

sentences.zh: 疑這裏抄宋志，誤以義熙二年為天賜二年，又訛「丁巳」為「丁亥」。

translations.literal: It is suspected that this copied from the Song Annals, mistaking Yixi year 2 for Tianci year 2, and also writing "dingsi" erroneously as "dinghai."
translations.idiomatic: This likely copied from the Song Annals, mistaking Yixi year 2 for Tianci year 2 and writing dingsi erroneously as dinghai.

sentences.zh: 斗

translations.literal: Dipper
translations.idiomatic: Dipper

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑熒惑犯執法 按天賜四年八月戊辰朔，無辛丑。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou, Mars transgressed the Enforcement Officer — Examining: in Tianci year 4, eighth month, first day wuchen, there is no xinchou.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, day xinchou, Mars transgressed the Enforcement Officer — in Tianci fourth year, eighth month, the first day is wuchen; there is no xinchou.

sentences.zh: 宋志在義熙三年

translations.literal: The Song Annals in Yixi year 3
translations.idiomatic: The Song Annals in Yixi year 3

sentences.zh: 〈魏天賜四年〉

translations.literal: 〈Wei Tianci year 4〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Tianci year 4〉

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，乃二十四日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao — the twenty-fourth day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, day xinmao — the twenty-fourth day.

sentences.zh: 是歲八月壬子太白犯軒轅大星 按永興二年八月辛巳朔，無壬子。

translations.literal: That year, eighth month, day renzi, the Great White transgressed the great star of Chariot Shaft — Examining: in Yongxing year 2, eighth month, first day xinsi, there is no renzi.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the eighth month, on the day renzi, Venus transgressed the great star of Chariot Shaft — in Yongxing second year, eighth month, the first day is xinsi; there is no renzi.

sentences.zh: 宋志在義熙六年

translations.literal: The Song Annals in Yixi year 6
translations.idiomatic: The Song Annals in Yixi year 6

sentences.zh: 〈魏永興二年〉

translations.literal: 〈Wei Yongxing year 2〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Yongxing year 2〉

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，是二日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renwu — the second day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, day renwu — the second day.

sentences.zh: 此志「壬子」當是「壬午」之訛。

translations.literal: In this treatise "renzi" should be the erroneous writing of "renwu."
translations.idiomatic: In this treatise renzi should be the erroneous writing of renwu.

sentences.zh: 至泰常二年正月晉荊州刺史司馬休之雍州刺史魯宗之為劉裕所襲皆出奔走 按劉裕攻司馬休之，休之出奔，據宋書卷二武帝紀二在義熙十一年

translations.literal: To Taichang year 2, first month: Jin Governor of Jing Province Sima Xiuzhi and Governor of Yong Province Lu Zongzhi were attacked by Liu Yu and both fled — Examining: Liu Yu attacked Sima Xiuzhi; Xiuzhi fled; according to Song shu juan 2, Gaozu Annals part 2, this was in Yixi year 11
translations.idiomatic: Through Taichang second year, first month: Jin Governor of Jing Province Sima Xiuzhi and Governor of Yong Province Lu Zongzhi were attacked by Liu Yu and both fled — Liu Yu attacked Sima Xiuzhi and Xiuzhi fled; according to Song shu juan 2, Gaozu Annals part 2, this was in Yixi year 11

sentences.zh: 〈魏神瑞二年〉，

translations.literal: 〈Wei Shenrui year 2〉;
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Shenrui year 2〉;

sentences.zh: 次年魏改年泰常。

translations.literal: the following year Wei changed the era name to Taichang.
translations.idiomatic: the following year Wei changed the era name to Taichang.

sentences.zh: 志二誤「神瑞」為「泰常」，這裏又承其誤。

translations.literal: Treatise 2 mistakenly wrote "Shenrui" as "Taichang"; here the error is repeated.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 2 mistakenly wrote Shenrui as Taichang; here the error is repeated.

sentences.zh: 參志二校記[一]。

translations.literal: See Treatise 2 collation note [1].
translations.idiomatic: See Treatise 2 collation note [1].

sentences.zh: 十月又犯之在斗 按志二在泰常三年十一月庚申，這裏「十」下當脫「一」字。

translations.literal: Tenth month it again transgressed it at Dipper — Examining Treatise 2: this was in Taichang year 3, eleventh month, day gengshen; here under "ten" the character "one" must be missing.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month it again transgressed it at Dipper — Treatise 2 places this in Taichang third year, eleventh month, day gengshen; here the character "one" is missing after "ten."

sentences.zh: 七月雁門河內大水 按卷三太宗紀在泰常三年八月，疑這裏作「七月」誤。

translations.literal: Seventh month: great floods in Yanmen and Henei — Examining juan 3, Taizong Annals: this is in Taichang year 3, eighth month; it is suspected that writing "seventh month" here is an error.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: great floods in Yanmen and Henei — juan 3 of the Taizong Annals places this in Taichang third year, eighth month; "seventh month" here is likely an error.

sentences.zh: 明年正月又犯鬼

translations.literal: The first month of the following year it again transgressed Ghost
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year it again transgressed Ghost

translations.literal: 〈To〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To〉

sentences.zh: 而至秦夏出夷威 諸本「正月」作「五月」，獨百衲本作「正月」。

translations.literal: And yet reaching Qin and Xia, came forth Yi and Wei — In various editions "first month" is written "fifth month"; only the Patchwork Edition has "first month."
translations.idiomatic: And yet reaching Qin and Xia, came forth Yi and Wei — in various editions "first month" is written "fifth month"; only the Patchwork Edition reads "first month."

sentences.zh: 按宋志元嘉九年正月庚午，熒惑入輿鬼，此志之明年乃魏神䴥五年，亦即宋元嘉九年

translations.literal: Examining: the Song Annals records Yuanjia year 9, first month, day gengwu, Mars entered the Celestial Chariot and Ghost; "the following year" in this treatise is Wei Shengui year 5, which is likewise Song Yuanjia year 9
translations.idiomatic: The Song Annals records Yuanjia ninth year, first month, day gengwu, Mars entered the Celestial Chariot and Ghost; "the following year" in this treatise is Wei Shengui year 5, which is likewise Song Yuanjia year 9

sentences.zh: 〈四三二〉，
知百衲本獨是，今從之。

translations.literal: knowing the Patchwork Edition alone is correct, now follow it.
translations.idiomatic: the Patchwork Edition alone is correct; adopted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 又「而至秦夏出夷威」，語不可解。

translations.literal: Also, "And yet reaching Qin and Xia, came forth Yi and Wei" — the language is inexplicable.
translations.idiomatic: Also, "And yet reaching Qin and Xia, came forth Yi and Wei" — the language is inexplicable.

sentences.zh: 「而至」下疑有脫文。

translations.literal: Under "and yet reaching" text is suspected to be missing.
translations.idiomatic: Text is suspected to be missing after "and yet reaching."

sentences.zh: 「威」當是「滅」之訛。

translations.literal: "Wei" should be the erroneous writing of "mie" (destroy).
translations.idiomatic: Wei should be the erroneous writing of mie (destroy).

sentences.zh: 「出」字非字訛即衍文。

translations.literal: The character "chu" is either a written error or a superfluous character.
translations.idiomatic: The character chu is either a written error or a superfluous character.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰月又掩之 諸本無「月」字。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingchen, the moon again concealed it — Various editions lack the character "moon."
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, day bingchen, the moon again concealed it — various editions lack the character "moon."

sentences.zh: 按志二神䴥四年十月丙辰，月掩天關，宋志同。

translations.literal: Examining Treatise 2: Shengui year 4, tenth month, day bingchen, the moon concealed Heavenly Pass; the Song Annals agrees.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 2 records Shengui fourth year, tenth month, day bingchen, the moon concealed Heavenly Pass; the Song Annals agrees.

sentences.zh: 這裏「又」上脫「月」字，承上文，便似太白又掩之。

translations.literal: Here above "again" the character "moon" is missing; continuing from above, it would seem the Great White again concealed it.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character "moon" is missing before "again"; continuing from above, it would seem Venus again concealed it.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplemented accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Supplemented accordingly.

sentences.zh: 詔大將軍嵇敬等帥眾二萬屯漠南 諸本「嵇」訛「黎」，今據卷四上世祖紀上太延五年六月條、卷一０三蠕蠕傳

translations.literal: Edict ordering Grand General Ji Jing and others to lead twenty thousand troops to encamp south of the desert — In various editions "Ji" is written erroneously as "Li"; now emended according to juan 4a Gaozu Annals part 1, Taiyuan year 5, sixth month entry, and juan 103 Rouran biography
translations.idiomatic: Edict ordering Grand General Ji Jing and others to lead twenty thousand troops to encamp south of the desert — in various editions Ji is written erroneously as Li; emended according to juan 4a Gaozu Annals part 1, Taiyuan fifth year, sixth month entry, and juan 103 Rouran biography

translations.literal: 〈Supplemented〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Supplemented〉

sentences.zh: 改正。

translations.literal: Corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected.

sentences.zh: 追至頓根河 殿本考證云：「頓根河，本書蠕蠕傳作『頞根河』。」

translations.literal: Pursued to Dundun River — The Palace Edition textual verification says: "Dundun River: in this book's Rouran biography it is written 'Yegen River.'
translations.idiomatic: Pursued to Dundun River — the Palace Edition notes: "Dundun River: in this book's Rouran biography it is written Yegen River."

sentences.zh: 按「頓」字疑訛。

translations.literal: Examining: the character 'dun' is suspected to be erroneous."
translations.idiomatic: Examining the matter: the character dun is suspected to be erroneous.

sentences.zh: 是月太白犯房月入南斗 按志二「月入南斗」在太安四年八月。

translations.literal: That month the Great White transgressed Fang and the moon entered the Southern Dipper — Examining Treatise 2: "the moon entered the Southern Dipper" is in Tai'an year 4, eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: That month Venus transgressed Fang and the moon entered the Southern Dipper — Treatise 2 places "the moon entered the Southern Dipper" in Tai'an fourth year, eighth month.

sentences.zh: 疑「月入南斗」上脫「八月」二字。

translations.literal: It is suspected that above "the moon entered the Southern Dipper" the two characters "eighth month" are missing.
translations.idiomatic: The two characters "eighth month" are likely missing before "the moon entered the Southern Dipper."

sentences.zh: 占曰小流星百數四面行者庶人遷之象 按上文稱「流星數萬西行」，這裏「四」當是「西」之訛。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: Small meteors in the hundreds going in the four directions—an image of commoners relocating — Examining: above it says "tens of thousands of meteors going west"; here "four" should be the erroneous writing of "west."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Small meteors in the hundreds going in the four directions—an image of commoners relocating" — above it says "tens of thousands of meteors going west"; here si (four) should be the erroneous writing of xi (west).

sentences.zh: 二年三月熒惑入鬼 按宋志在大明六年

translations.literal: Second year, third month, Mars entered Ghost — Examining: the Song Annals places this in Daming year 6
translations.idiomatic: Second year, third month, Mars entered Ghost — the Song Annals places this in Daming year 6

sentences.zh: 〈魏和平三年〉

translations.literal: 〈Wei Heping year 3〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Heping year 3〉

sentences.zh: 三月。

translations.literal: Third month.
translations.idiomatic: Third month.

sentences.zh: 此志下文說「是歲，詔諸將討雍州叛氐」，據卷五高宗紀，事在和平三年六月，則這裏「二年」當是「三年」之訛。

translations.literal: This treatise below says "That year an edict ordered the generals to suppress the rebel Di of Yong Province"; according to juan 5, Emperor Gaozong Annals, the event was in Heping year 3, sixth month—therefore here "second year" should be the erroneous writing of "third year."
translations.idiomatic: This treatise below says "That year an edict ordered the generals to suppress the rebel Di of Yong Province"; according to juan 5 of the Gaozong Annals the event was in Heping third year, sixth month—therefore "second year" here should be the erroneous writing of "third year."

sentences.zh: 但下又云「宋雍州刺史海陵王休茂亦稱兵作亂」，據宋書卷六孝武帝紀，事在大明五年

translations.literal: But below it also says "Song Governor of Yong Province, Prince of Hailing Xiu Mao, also raised troops in rebellion"; according to Song shu juan 6, Emperor Xiaowu Annals, the event was in Daming year 5
translations.idiomatic: But below it also says "Song Governor of Yong Province, Prince of Hailing Xiu Mao, also raised troops in rebellion"; according to Song shu juan 6, Emperor Xiaowu Annals, the event was in Daming year 5

sentences.zh: 〈魏和平二年〉，

translations.literal: 〈Wei Heping year 2〉;
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Heping year 2〉;

sentences.zh: 又不合。

translations.literal: this also does not agree.
translations.idiomatic: this also does not agree.

sentences.zh: 是月熒惑守軒轅 按是月承上文乃和平三年

translations.literal: That month Mars stationed at Chariot Shaft — Examining: "that month" continuing from above is Heping year 3
translations.idiomatic: That month Mars stationed at Chariot Shaft — "that month" continuing from above is Heping year 3

sentences.zh: 〈四六二〉
十月，據宋志「熒惑守軒轅」和下文「十一月，歲入氐」都在大明七年

translations.literal: Tenth month; according to the Song Annals both "Mars stationed at Chariot Shaft" and below "eleventh month, the Year Star entered Di" are in Daming year 7
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month; according to the Song Annals both "Mars stationed at Chariot Shaft" and below "eleventh month, Jupiter entered Di" are in Daming year 7

sentences.zh: 〈魏和平四年、四六三〉，

translations.literal: 〈Wei Heping year 4, 463〉;
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Heping year 4, 463〉;

sentences.zh: 此志提早一年。

translations.literal: this treatise is one year too early.
translations.idiomatic: this treatise is one year too early.

sentences.zh: 此條下注文和下五年條正文和注中記載的星變，見於宋志者，比對紀年，此志皆提前一年，必是雜抄宋志而於宋、魏紀年的必定有誤。

translations.literal: The annotation to this entry, the main text of the entry five years below, and the stellar changes recorded in annotations—all those found in the Song Annals, when era names are compared, are one year too early in this treatise; this must be a haphazard copying from the Song Annals with errors certainly in the Song and Wei chronologies.
translations.idiomatic: The annotation to this entry, the main text of the entry five years below, and the stellar changes recorded in annotations—all those found in the Song Annals—when era names are compared, are one year too early in this treatise; this must be a haphazard copying from the Song Annals with errors in the Song and Wei chronologies.

sentences.zh: 今不逐條列舉。

translations.literal: They are not listed entry by entry here.
translations.idiomatic: They are not listed entry by entry here.

sentences.zh: 顯祖天安元年正月戊子 按天安元年正月己丑朔，無「戊子」。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzu, Tian'an year 1, first month, day wuzi — Examining: Tian'an year 1, first month, first day jichou; there is no wuzi.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzu, Tian'an first year, first month, day wuzi — Tian'an first year, first month begins on jichou; there is no wuzi.

sentences.zh: 道符作亂之明年司空和其奴太宰李峻皆薨 按卷六顯祖紀，拓跋道符起兵在皇興元年正月，和其奴及李峻死於皇興三年正月和十一月，卷四四和其奴傳同紀。

translations.literal: The year after Daofu's rebellion the Minister of Works He Qinu and Grand Mentor Li Jun both passed away — Examining juan 6, Xianzu Annals: Tuoba Daofu raised troops in Huangxing year 1, first month; He Qinu and Li Jun died in Huangxing year 3, first and eleventh months; juan 44, He Qinu biography agrees with the annals.
translations.idiomatic: The year after Daofu's rebellion the Minister of Works He Qinu and Grand Mentor Li Jun both passed away — juan 6 of the Xianzu Annals records that Tuoba Daofu raised troops in Huangxing first year, first month; He Qinu and Li Jun died in Huangxing year 3, first and eleventh months; juan 44, He Qinu biography agrees with the annals.

sentences.zh: 這裏作「明年」誤。

translations.literal: Writing "the following year" here is an error.
translations.idiomatic: Writing "the following year" here is an error.

sentences.zh: 丙子月犯東井庚子又如之 按此承上文乃延興二年正月，志二在是年閏月，疑「丙子」上脫「閏月」二字。

translations.literal: On bingzi the moon transgressed Eastern Well; on gengzi it did so again — Examining: continuing from above this is Yanxing year 2, first month; Treatise 2 places this in the intercalary month of that year; it is suspected that above "bingzi" the two characters "intercalary month" are missing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the moon transgressed Eastern Well; on gengzi it did so again — continuing from above this is Yanxing second year, first month; Treatise 2 places this in the intercalary month of that year; the two characters "intercalary month" are likely missing before bingzi.

sentences.zh: 但是年閏六月，壬子朔，無「庚子」，志二亦誤。

translations.literal: But that year had an intercalary sixth month beginning on renzi; there is no gengzi; Treatise 2 is also in error.
translations.idiomatic: But that year had an intercalary sixth month beginning on renzi; there is no gengzi; Treatise 2 is also in error.

sentences.zh: 〈正月甲寅朔，亦無庚子。〉

translations.literal: 〈First month begins on jiayin; there is no gengzi either.〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈First month begins on jiayin; there is no gengzi either.〉

sentences.zh: 二年正月曲赦京師及秦涼諸鎮 諸本「涼」作「梁」。

translations.literal: Second year, first month: partial amnesty for the capital and the garrisons of Qin and Liang — In various editions "Liang" (cool) is written "Liang" (beam).
translations.idiomatic: Second year, first month: partial amnesty for the capital and the garrisons of Qin and Liang — in various editions Liang (cool) is written Liang (beam).

sentences.zh: 按志二及卷七上高祖紀上作「涼州諸鎮」。

translations.literal: Examining Treatise 2 and juan 7a, Gaozu Annals part 1: it reads "the garrisons of Liang Province."
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 2 and juan 7a of the Gaozu Annals part 1 read "the garrisons of Liang Province."

sentences.zh: 「梁」字訛，今改正。

translations.literal: The character "Liang" is erroneous; it is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The character for "Liang" was erroneous and has been corrected here.

sentences.zh: 四年九月己卯月犯畢 志二「九月」作「正月」。

translations.literal: Fourth year, ninth month, day jimao, the moon transgressed Net. Treatise 2 reads "ninth month" as "first month."
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, ninth month, day jimao, the moon transgressed Net. Treatise 2 has "ninth month" written as "first month."

sentences.zh: 按下稱「七月丙申」，不應「九月」在前，「九」當是「正」之訛。

translations.literal: Below it says "seventh month, day bingshen"; "ninth month" ought not to come before it—"nine" must be an error for "first."
translations.idiomatic: The text below reads "seventh month, day bingshen," so "ninth month" should not appear earlier; "nine" must be a corruption of "first."

sentences.zh: 七月丙申太白犯歲星在角 此承上文乃延興四年

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingshen, the Great White transgressed the Year Star in Horn—this continues from above and is the fourth year of Yanxing.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, day bingshen, Venus transgressed Jupiter in Horn—this continues from above and refers to the fourth year of Yanxing.

sentences.zh: 〈宋元徽二年四七四〉，

translations.literal: 〈Song Yuanhui year 2, 474 CE〉,
translations.idiomatic: 〈Song Yuanhui year 2, 474 CE〉,

sentences.zh: 據宋志在元徽三年

translations.literal: according to the Song Annals in Yuanhui year 3
translations.idiomatic: according to the Song Annals, this occurred in Yuanhui year 3

sentences.zh: 〈魏延興五年〉，

translations.literal: 〈Wei Yanxing year 5〉,
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Yanxing year 5〉,

sentences.zh: 當是抄宋志誤前一年。

translations.literal: this must be a copyist's error from copying the Song Annals one year too early.
translations.idiomatic: this must be a copyist's error from copying the Song Annals one year too early.

sentences.zh: 丁卯太白又入氐 此承上文乃延興四年七月。

translations.literal: Day dingmao, the Great White again entered Di—this continues from above and is the seventh month of Yanxing year 4.
translations.idiomatic: Day dingmao, Venus again entered Di—this continues from above and refers to the seventh month of Yanxing year 4.

sentences.zh: 按是年七月庚午朔，無丁卯。

translations.literal: Examining that year: the seventh month began on day gengwu; there is no dingmao.
translations.idiomatic: Examining that year, the seventh month began on day gengwu; there is no dingmao.

sentences.zh: 宋志在元徽三年

translations.literal: The Song Annals in Yuanhui year 3
translations.idiomatic: The Song Annals records Yuanhui year 3

sentences.zh: 〈魏延興五年〉

translations.literal: 〈Wei Yanxing year 5〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Wei Yanxing year 5〉

sentences.zh: 七月丁巳。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, day dingsi.

sentences.zh: 是年七月甲午朔，丁巳是二十四日。

translations.literal: That year the seventh month began on day jiawu; dingsi is the twenty-fourth day.
translations.idiomatic: That year the seventh month began on day jiawu; dingsi is the twenty-fourth day.

sentences.zh: 這裏誤前一年，又「丁卯」乃「丁巳」之訛。

translations.literal: Here the year is one year too early, and "dingmao" is an error for "dingsi."
translations.idiomatic: Here the year is one year too early, and "dingmao" is a corruption of "dingsi."

sentences.zh: 為主女之象 按「主女」當是「女主」誤倒。

translations.literal: It is the image of a ruling woman. Examining the text, "ruling woman" (zhu nü) should be "female ruler" (nü zhu) with the order reversed in error.
translations.idiomatic: It is the image of a female ruler. The text's "ruling woman" should be "female ruler" with the characters reversed in error.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌月犯之 諸本「十二月」作「十一月」。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu, the moon transgressed it. Various editions read "twelfth month" as "eleventh month."
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, day bingxu, the moon transgressed it. Various editions have "twelfth month" written as "eleventh month."

sentences.zh: 按志二太和三年十二月丙戌，月犯太微左執法。

translations.literal: Examining Treatise 2: Taihe year 3, twelfth month, day bingxu, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 2 records that in Taihe third year, twelfth month, day bingxu, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 是年十一月己亥朔，無丙戌，十二月戊辰朔，丙戌是十九日。

translations.literal: That year the eleventh month began on day jihai—there is no bingxu; the twelfth month began on day wuchen, and bingxu is the nineteenth day.
translations.idiomatic: That year the eleventh month began on day jihai, so there is no bingxu; the twelfth month began on day wuchen, and bingxu is the nineteenth day.

sentences.zh: 這裏「十一月」乃「十二月」之訛。

translations.literal: Here "eleventh month" is an error for "twelfth month."
translations.idiomatic: Here "eleventh month" is a corruption of "twelfth month."

sentences.zh: 今據改。

translations.literal: It is now corrected accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The text has been corrected accordingly.

sentences.zh: 四年二月辛巳 諸本「月」訛「年」，今據志二改。

translations.literal: Fourth year, second month, day xinsi. Various editions have "month" erroneous for "year"; it is now corrected according to Treatise 2.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, second month, day xinsi. Various editions erroneously read "month" for "year"; the text is now corrected according to Treatise 2.

sentences.zh: 有偏日暈 按志二太和五年二月甲辰條「日」作「白」，當是。

translations.literal: There was a partial solar halo. Examining Treatise 2, the Taihe year 5, second month, day jiachen entry reads "sun" as "white"—this is correct.
translations.idiomatic: There was a partial solar halo. Treatise 2's Taihe fifth year, second month, day jiachen entry reads "sun" as "white," which is correct.

sentences.zh: 元陽以饉 殿本考證云：「『元』應作『亢』。」

translations.literal: Primordial yang thereby famished. The Palace Edition textual verification says: "'Yuan' should read 'Kang'."
translations.idiomatic: Primordial yang thereby famished. The Palace Edition textual verification notes: "'Yuan' should read 'Kang'."

sentences.zh: 是謂驚立絕行 諸本「立」作「亡」。

translations.literal: This is called startled establishment and severed course. Various editions read "establish" as "perish."
translations.idiomatic: This is called startled establishment and severed course. Various editions have "establish" written as "perish."

sentences.zh: 按這是說歲、辰、太白三星聚氐。

translations.literal: Examining the text, this refers to the Year Star, Chronogram Star, and Great White—the three stars gathering at Di.
translations.idiomatic: This refers to Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus—the three stars gathering at Di.

sentences.zh: 志四武定八年三月甲午，歲、鎮、太白在虛，云「是為驚立絕行」。

translations.literal: Treatise 4, Wuding year 8, third month, day jiawu: the Year Star, Sentinel Star, and Great White were at Empty, stating "this is startled establishment and severed course."
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 4 records that in Wuding eighth year, third month, day jiawu, Jupiter, Saturn, and Venus were at Empty, stating "this is startled establishment and severed course."

sentences.zh: 隋書卷二０天文志中云：「三星若合，是謂驚立絕行。」

translations.literal: The Sui shu, juan 20, Treatise on Astronomy, part 2, says: "When three stars conjoin, this is called startled establishment and severed course."
translations.idiomatic: The Sui shu, juan 20, Treatise on Astronomy, part 2, says: "When three stars conjoin, this is called startled establishment and severed course."

sentences.zh: 知這裏「亡」字訛，今改正。

translations.literal: From this it is known that "perish" here is erroneous; it is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: From this it is known that "perish" here is a corruption; the text has been corrected.
